chapters.title: Chapter 1201: Meeting Bilad and Avotha
paragraphs: "Welcome to Nex Morbus," an Immortal Lord said, welcoming Uncle Drew into the city.
This time around, they did not try to challenge him to another duel. This shows they had learned their lessons.
What he had shown them was enough to send a deafening message to everyone. None would want to rechallenge him, not when they had just witnessed a complete display of combat power and experience.
Uncle Drew had, from start to finish, displayed his combat prowess as someone who can bridge the gap regardless of cultivation differences.
The gap between him and the immortals he had defeated was very vast — extremely vast.
They are immortals with control over immortal Qi/energy. Naturally, they are far superior to Uncle Drew, who is a mere mortal. However, in combat, sometimes cultivation level is not everything.
Sometimes, it is one’s experience as a warrior that matters.
Kael Duskbane was known as the greatest warrior ever to live, not because he was the strongest or the best swordsman, but because of his experience and understanding of combat.
Kael was a true warrior simply because he had principles he lived by. He was someone who learned from his failures and never repeated the same mistake twice.
He adapts in combat.
He learned from his opponent.
...and as long as he drew breath, he was never defeated.
In his battle against the five immortals, he had proven to everyone his discipline and his extensive experience as a warrior.
He is merely a Death Stage warrior, but he was now seen as a god as he walked through the gate into the city. All who saw him wore respectful looks.
The sixth level of hell, where Kent had been conquered back then, is called Nex Morbus. It had fourteen powerful cities ruled by powerful City Lords.

Initially, the main palace of the Hell King was located in Draemora, the City of Nightmares. However, after Bilad was made the acting Hell King by Kent, he built a 15th city where only he and his immediate subordinates live.
In this city, only 21,000 Hell demons live, and every last one of them is an immortal. There are also demigods, but their number is limited.
All 21,000 of them are elite warrior units Bilad had personally raised to aid their King whenever he needed help.
Uncle Drew was led straight to the palace, which was made from the skull of a Hell Dragon. It was large enough to house many rooms and a rather large meeting hall.
Uncle Drew was led to this hall
Inside the hall, Bilad sat on a throne made from bones. He was clad in a casual robe made from the skin of a Hell demon killed several years ago by him when he went training in the Damned Hell Sea.
Many years ago, Kent dominated that sea. However, back then, all Hell demons were suppressed to the peak of the Heavenly Ascension stage.
If he were to venture in today, he wouldn’t even be able to cross the outer layer. Back then, he made it to the core layer where he met Avotha, the Abyss Dragon.
Avotha is seated on the side, his expression calm as he looks at Uncle Drew walk into the hall.
"Welcome to Nex Morbus, Night Rider," Bilad said just when Uncle Drew sat down.
"Thank you. But you can just call me Uncle Drew or Kael. Whichever you prefer." Bilad nodded.
"I am Bilad, the acting Hell King of Nex Morbus, and this is my friend Avotha." Uncle Drew turned and looked at Avotha, who gave him a slight nod.
He returned the nod before turning back to Bilad, who was ready to know more about why Uncle Drew came to hell.
"I was told Lord Kent sent you. How is he doing, by the way?"
"He is doing well. He would have come here himself if he had the means; however, because of some setbacks, he sent me and his regards."
Bilad nodded, happy to hear his benefactor is well. It was just too bad that he couldn’t come in person and had to send Uncle Drew.
Kent would have loved to come to hell himself. However, to get to hell, he had to travel to a place located in the Immortal World and acquire an item that Gaia would use to build a hell gate for him.
Of course, he can also go to the Abyss Dragons and ask for their help since they are the Death Dragons, and they have a way to access hell.
However, since Avotha hates them for what they did to his mother, Kent knew that, one way or another, he would have to clash with them and get revenge for his pal.
So asking them for help is not something he can or would want to do.
Of course, there are other families he can visit who can send him there. However, he knew most of them would demand something he could not give.
So for now, he will remain in the land of the living, and once he manages to find a path to hell, he wouldn’t hesitate.
In fact, getting to the Underworld is much easier than getting to hell. However, since Uncle Drew can easily go there, he asked him to travel in his stead.
"I believe you didn’t come here just to tell me how Lord Kent is doing."
"That is true. He sent me here to get him." Uncle Drew turns to Avotha. "The young master needs help with something, and so he asks for your assistance."
"When do we leave?" Avotha asked immediately, causing Bilad to smirk. He and Avotha had gotten close over the years. They are training partners and occasional hunters in the Damned Hell Sea.
Since he was born at the core of the Damned Hell Sea, he was able to stay there for years. However, he was only able to leave when Kent’s hell road suppressed everyone.
At the core of the Damned hell sea, there are many overlords, each having their own domain. The overlords can interfere with each other. They can only go against outsiders.
Avotha inherited his mother’s domain, and for years, he hid there. However, with Kent’s help, he was able to leave.
After Kent left and the suppression was lifted, he couldn’t return again. The creatures hidden in the Damned Hell Sea are monsters he can’t contend against.
However, with Bilad’s assistance, they fought their way to the inner layer. Naturally, through the near-death moments, the two of them had gotten closer.
So Bilad was a little betrayed to hear that Avotha was ready to abandon him in hell. Avotha didn’t even bat an eye and decided to leave when Kent came calling.
Uncle Drew smiled and responded:
"We will leave once Bilad gets me this." He handed a scroll to Bilad, who nodded and called a demigod.
"Get me all the stuff on this list." The demigod nodded and left with the list.
"So, tell me more about Lord Kent’s life in the land of the living," Bilad asked.
Since the items Kent needed are now being collected, he wants to know more about the man who gave him a chance to become stronger and a King of Hell, even if he is just an interim Hell King.
Uncle Drew didn’t mind the request, so he started telling him all about Kent. Of course, he wouldn’t reveal his many lives to them. If Kent wanted, he would tell them himself.
He only told them about his current life. About 5 hours later, the items on the list were collected, and so Uncle Drew and Avotha were ready to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 1202: Leaving Hell
paragraphs: [Nex Morbus]
Uncle Drew stood facing Laziel, the overlord of hell, and the rest of his Night Rider teammates. Standing behind Uncle Drew are the brute Vargus, the quiet Lene, and the abyss dragon, Avotha.
Laziel suddenly started to speak.
"I learned the Chaos Rift mostly sends those brave enough to enter when it opens to worlds that went missing after the Chaos Era.
The last time it opened, an entire planetary system was revealed where millions of people fought bloody battles over treasures.
I was one of those fools.
This time, I don’t know what it will be like, but I have no doubt it will be even bigger. This also means the chances of us meeting in there are slim.
So be careful and be sure to warn the master before he enters," Laziel said.
Uncle Drew is leaving, so he is saying his goodbyes.
"I will be sure to remember that. However, you all should be careful too. I will find a way to reunite with you all before the time to enter the Chaos Rift comes.
However, even if we can’t meet, be careful. Reuniting with the rest of our brothers and sisters is the top priority right now, so take care of yourselves."
They nodded.
"Also, when you bring back those in the Dark City, look for the others. I will also do my best to find the rest."
"Good luck, Captain. Send our greetings to the master."
Uncle Drew nodded. Although Kent doesn’t remember his life where he interacted with the Night Riders, he will be happy to learn Uncle Drew had reunited with some of them.

Laziel looked at Vargus and Lene, the two going with Uncle Drew... "Our mission is to protect the innocent, so use the flames of hell to protect those in need and burn those who dare rise against our master."
"Fear not, Laziel, we will rescue the master’s friend and reduce everyone to ash," Vargus said, his fist striking his chest.
"I know you will, Vargus, I know you will."
After a few more exchanges, Bilad opened the gate leading back to the underworld. "Tell Lord Kent I am doing just fine, so he shouldn’t rush down here."
Uncle Drew smiled... "Don’t worry, you will forever be the king of the level. The Young Master has more important things to worry about."
Bilad nodded and turned to Avotha... "Make sure you don’t do anything stupid when out there. I am too lazy to come to your rescue."
Avotha smirked, "Look after yourself, Bilad. When I return, we will rechallenge the Sea Demon Lady and win this time around."
"Can’t wait."
They are gone the next second.
Soon, they arrived in the underworld, where Nyx was waiting for them.
"Beautiful"
Imagine sitting on the clouds, watching the stars shine brighter and more colourful. Would that be enough to make you never want to leave?
This question can only be answered by Kent and his two virgin wives - Runa and Adina.
One would wonder why such a magical sight hadn’t been discovered until now. Kent had had the tower for a while now, but he had only just found such a place.
Kent, in his attempt to make Runa and Adina happy, may have just discovered the most magical sight in the tower.
Three days ago, when he went looking for them, he found them meditating in a garden somewhere in Nature City.

It was a relaxing atmosphere, one that they found to their liking. Not that they wanted to be there, though. It was their unfortunate situation that led them to seclude themselves far away from their sisters.
When he found them, the sight of them sitting quietly broke his heart. So he took them around the tower, doing his best to cheer them up.
Of course, his presence alone managed to uplift their spirits. However, that wasn’t enough. Kent wanted to do more... He tried to make them more than happy.
So he got creative.
He tapped into his bag of tricks, and for a full day, he looked but couldn’t find anything that could make the two moody virgins super cheerful.
He had tried his best and came out empty.

Of course, nobody could blame him for that. He is but a single man caring for dozens of women. If he had to look for a way to make each of them happy, he would grow gray hair, but wouldn’t even be done.
But then again, nobody asked him to have more women in his life.
Though it broke his heart that two of his wives aren’t happy.
However, just when he was about to give up, a shooting star caught his eye, so he decided to fly up and see what the tower looked like from the clouds.
Safe to say, when he entered the clouds, he saw the most beautiful sight.
In an instant, his worries were washed away, for he had found the perfect spot he had been searching for.
He quickly paid Gaia to build tangible clouds for him. This was so they could sit on it and enjoy the view. Afterwards, he bought wine from the tower shop and brought it there.
Then he came for his two virgins.
"So beautiful..." Runa said, watching a colourful star streak across the sky, leaving a dazzling trail of light behind.

Her head is resting on Kent’s chest, hands brushing across his fine abs. Adina is also in the same posture. The colorful display in the sky had won them over. They wanted nothing more than that at the moment.
"The tower sure has some of the most beautiful things. I am not sure this sight could be enjoyed anywhere else," Adina added, and Kent smiled.
"I only offer the best. Aside from me, nobody else comes close."
Runa and Adina smile.
They couldn’t deny Kent’s words.
From what they had seen so far, none of them could boldly say they would be able to find it somewhere else better than this.
They had been to the tower store, where Lyna even found a god-grade bloodline technique she is currently cultivating.
They have also seen many things that, no matter how they see it, no one else, aside from Kent, could offer them. So his brag does have some substance to it.
"Although having sex with you will be better, this place isn’t too bad. I can get used to this place," said Adina. She looks happy—a much better mood compared to two days ago.
"Me too."
Kent smiled and said, "Don’t worry, ladies, I will be sure to handle my affairs in the high worlds soon and ascend to the immortal world. Then we can be together like the rest of your sisters.
For now, we can only enjoy this moment."
Kent’s hands move, giving their ass a gentle massage.
"Just focus on your mission, Kent. Rescuing Elina is of the highest priority. We don’t know how she is faring, so focus on that; we will be fine."
Kent nodded and let himself relax. He had finally managed to calm his two wives down. Next, he will look for ways to get to Elina much faster.
As they said, she is indeed of utmost priority. Getting to her as early as possible is a must.
Kent let himself be drawn into the stars, letting their dazzling beauty fill his mind. In no time, all three of them became absorbed in the moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1203: Overpowered Goddess
paragraphs: The god realm is just like the mortal realm.
Of course, all mortals born in the god realm can be considered fortunate, for they are among the one percent.
Being born in a realm surrounded by gods not only makes one overprivileged but also leads one to become a powerful cultivator.
Take Kent’s wives, for example.

Because their sister is a goddess, they received high-tier cultivation techniques, treasures, and more. This advantage had propelled them on a path that most, even in god worlds, wouldn’t be able to have.
This, in a way, gave them an unfair advantage.
Mortals who have never seen a god cannot, in their wildest dreams, dare stand against a mortal born and raised in the god world.
Those overprivileged children have high-quality spiritual energies to cultivate. They have super strong spirit roots, physiques, and many more that mere mortals couldn’t dream of.
Even Immortals in the god worlds find it easy to form immortal qi.

Of course, given the abundance of resources there, every person can be considered a powerhouse. But then again, thanks to everyone being overprivileged there, their arrogance is also on another level.
However, unlike the mortal realm, where there are rulers on every planet, city, or two, in the god realm, most gods prefer to keep to themselves.
Most stay indoors to cultivate, some travel to ruins to explore and seek out opportunities. But of course, other gods like to roam and cause trouble.
In the end, not all gods act godly. Some are just scums that would use any means necessary to get what they wanted.
Vexthra, of course, is one of the secluded gods. She is a domain god.

So unlike some of the gods that go about causing trouble here and there, she always keeps to herself. The number of interactions she had with others over the millions of years she lived as a god wouldn’t be up to ten.
Of the few interactions, she didn’t initiate them, nor did she bother to care about what they said.
So one could only imagine what people will think watching such a person now walk down the street.
Vexthra, clad in her black clothes, walks down the street of Luminous, a city on Planet Spanta. This is the god world of the Space god.
On this planet, every last cultivator cultivates space-type techniques, mainly thanks to their patron god, who provides them with the techniques and methods needed to master the laws of space easily.
Of course, among the limited god worlds out there, Planet Spanta can be counted among the strongest planets. It has many experts.
At the moment, many of the said experts stood in various places, watching Vexthra walk down the street toward a peak where a majestic mansion stood.
Not many recognized the goddess of hatred and resentment. However, they know of her reputation as the coldest goddess in the universe.
She had no friends, and the most she talked to anyone was 30 seconds, saying only two things — okay and leave.
So, despite many not knowing her, her reputation had already spread far and wide. Naturally, that was more than a person should know.
But she is the goddess of hatred and resentment. That counts for something.

"When they call her the coldest goddess, I expected her to be clad in gothic black clothes, her eyes painted black, and her nose pierced in a hundred places. Who would have expected a goddess with a not-so-good reputation to be this beautiful?" A demigod seated 40,000 miles away said to his friend.
"I know. My master, the Dream god, once tried to seek her assistance, but she didn’t even turn to look at him. In fact, she didn’t even allow him entry into her god realm."
"Such a cold goddess. No wonder nobody dares mess with her."
"True. Now, I want to see why she is here."
Vexthra, despite being thousands of miles away, could hear every last word the demigods and many others were saying.
’Looks like I am completely different now.’ She said inwardly, spreading her senses to see what the many are doing.
In the past, even if she were to appear in this city, she wouldn’t let anyone see her. She would storm the palace of the Space god like she owned the place. However, she seems more down-to-earth now.
She is grounded now, and that alone is enough to tell just how much she has changed.

Suddenly, lightning flashed across the sky, causing billions to raise their heads and look. There, in the clouds, a man with bald hair and a braided beard stood on lightning, his gaze directed at Vexthra.
Lightning danced around his beard.
"Well, well, well, look what the cat drags out," Aerion Vhaldar, the storm god, said, looking coldly at Vexthra. He is among the few gods who hate the goddess of hatred and resentment.
So when he heard that she was in Spanta, he rushed over. Thankfully, he wasn’t deceived.
Vexthra stopped, raised her head, and looked at Aerion.
’Oh, he hates me for sure.’ Being the goddess with her divinity and law powered by hatred, she could sense just how much Aerion hates him.
"I am not here for your nonsense, so move out of the way before I move you."
Aerion’s eyes narrowed when he heard what Vexthra said.
RUMBLE
The weather began to change, prompting millions of people in the city to panic. Two gods clashing is more than an earthquake. They will be erased from existence before they know it.
"Aerion, behave... This is not your playground," a voice came from the mansion that was sitting on the mountain peak, spreading far and wide in many directions.
"Relax, Orion, I will be done in just a minute."
Aerion and Orion are brothers. The two go way back, so despite Orion showing he was reprimanding Aerion, he actually wanted to see some action.
Unfortunately for him, the reason why Vexthra came to Spanta is too important for her to turn around and leave.
Matters concerning Kent and her sisters are of utmost importance to her.
So she wouldn’t take any nonsense from them, even if she was there to ask for a favour.
Aerion looked at Vexthra and sneered... "You called me a dog the last time I asked for your help. Today, I will show you who the dog is."
He extended his hand and formed a ball of lightning. That ball contains the law of the storm, something that can shatter an Immortal world easily.

Vexthra didn’t move; she merely stood there. Suddenly, she felt the space around her sealed. She realised that Orion wanted to protect the city from his brother, so he sealed them in a separate space.
"Feel my law," Aerion, however, used the assurance of safety to throw the ball of storm at Vexthra.
Yet again, despite the danger coming, Vexthra remained standing. The ball rushed toward her, and just when it was about to explode, her hands moved and caught it.
She gave it a gentle squeeze, and the ball shattered.
"What?" Aerion immediately turned pale.
However, before he could retreat or attack again, Vexthra raised her left hand, and Aerion felt his body freeze. She then channeled a small portion of her divine energy and flicked her hand.
"Be gone."
In an instant, as if he were struck by a bus, Aerion’s body was hurled out of the planet and vanished from sight.
He was hurled thousands of light-years in under a second just like that.
But that wasn’t all.
The force that pushed him away was so powerful that the sealed space shattered in an instant, causing Orion to cough up a mouthful of blood, his eyes widening.
His mind went numb, unsure of how to take in what had just happened.

chapters.title: Chapter 1204: Vexthra’s True Strength
paragraphs: Just like how there are eight rankings of immortals, there are also eight ranks of gods.

Once a cultivator ascends to become a god, they enter the God Ascension stage. This is the most basic stage that most demigods pursue for millions of years. Being there qualifies one to be called a god.
Some can go on for eternity, never meeting the requirements to become a god.
However, once a cultivator reaches the God Ascension stage, climbing the ladder becomes a complex process.
No matter what, one would face setbacks.
Most gods had even given up the idea of becoming an Early God or a Real God. They are content with being only at the God Ascension stage.
Unlike the immortal stage, where one can climb the ranking by forming immortal qis, the god stage is entirely different.

A demigod can become a god today, and then tomorrow, they will gain enlightenment and become an Early god. One can also become a god today, but even after a millennium, they wouldn’t even make a quarter of progress.
Some say it takes hard work, dedication, intelligence, and luck to climb the ranking of a god.
Climbing just one rank of godhood is already impossible, much less climbing all eight ranks and becoming a supreme. There, too, there is a whole lot of drama.
Orion is a True God, one of the strong ones.
He had been a True God for the past 15 million years. He had tried everything he could to ascend to the stage of a God King, but no matter how hard he tried, he couldn’t take that one step.
Many gods came after him, but they had long surpassed the rank of a True God. However, he is stuck, and there is no telling when he will finally make the one step.
He mastered the law of space to a much deeper level, but the next stage keeps eluding him.
However, despite his status as a True God, even God Kings and God Emperors come to him for assistance when they face issues pertaining to the law of space.
There aren’t many gods who can use the law of space out there, after all.
So his importance is paramount in the god realm.
He holds the power to command respect from even God-kings. He holds the power to trap even God Kings in space, where, no matter how powerful they are, breaking free will be impossible.
So, imagine his shock when, with just a flick of her finger, his brother was hurled away, and his precious space lock was broken relatively easily.
Of course, he didn’t put much energy into that lock, since he knew Vexthra and Aerion wouldn’t have fought too dangerously.
But the fact that a mere flick on Vexthra’s hand was all it took to break it told Orion all he had to know.
The goddess currently standing at the base of the mountain, but staring at him inside his mansion, is no simple god.
On the surface, Vexthra is just like other gods.
However, she has already reached the rank of a Pseudo-Supreme, a stage that makes her almost a Supreme.
When Vexthra met Kent, she was only a True God who had taken the domain path, inheriting the divinity of hatred and resentment. Basically, she was destined to remain a god forever.
Yet after her True Name awakening, not only did she break through to the peak of godhood, but she even claimed her own law, making her an independent god again.

Thanks to that, she broke through to the Semi-Supreme Law stage, making her a Pseudo-Supreme in the law path. The only thing left for her to do was to take the Supreme Tribulation and become a Supreme.
However, Kent, for some reason, wants his wives to walk both the Law Path and the Ancient Path.
Gods nowadays only walk the Law Path since, to some degree, it is the easiest path. Of course, another reason for that was that the Ancient Path had long been lost to time.
Also, even if it exists today, no sane god will walk that path. It is dangerous, expensive, time-consuming, and complex.
However, Kent managed to recover the long-lost Ancient Path, so Vexthra is now cultivating it. She qualified to walk the Ancient Path when she awakened her Primordial Spirit.
So, while her Law is current, that of a Pseudo-Supreme, she cannot yet rise to the rank of a Supreme.
Even if Orion were to be a Universal God—the peak of godhood—he wouldn’t have stood a chance against her.𝐟𝗿𝐞𝚎𝚠𝐞𝚋𝕟𝐨𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝕔𝕠𝚖
The current Vexthra, unless beseeched by dozens of gods or a supreme, will be next to impossible to hurt, much less force her to retreat.
Orion knew better, and so he wiped the blood off the corner of his lips and teleported to the base of the mountain, wearing a polite smile.
"Welcome to Spanta, Goddess Vexthra."

Vexthra looked at him for a few seconds before nodding. She may have changed thanks to being around mortals for the past year, but when she is in the god realm, some part of her divinity still lingers.
The coldness is just beneath the surface, telling everyone she is still the same.
"I have a favour to ask, so why don’t we sit first?"
"Of course. Please, this way," Orion gestured forward and started walking up the small mountain. Vexthra followed him.
All over Planet Spanta and beyond, news of Vexthra flicking the Storm God, sending him flying into the infinity of space, had already started to spread like wildfire.
It is just too bizarre.
The mere fact that the goddess of hatred and resentment had appeared on a planet instead of hiding in her domain was already too wild.
They know of her reputation, and many had wanted to catch a sight of her majestic self. However, until today, she hadn’t allowed anyone to enter her domain.
Most gods knew of her from memory recordings made by those who had seen her before.
...Yes, gods are weird too.
So, her appearing on Planet Spanta was already too wild. However, by the time most of them rushed to Planet Spanta, Orion had already locked the space around the planet.
He isn’t allowing anyone entry.
He is afraid of what will happen when Vexthra gets mad, so he locked his planet down. Once she leaves, he will open it and answer all their questions.
Of course, this was just his own way of saving his skin.
Although he was leading Vexthra up the mountain, his heart was beating wildly in his chest. He didn’t know much about Vexthra, so he had no idea what she would do next.

The only assurance he has now is that Vexthra is on his planet to ask him for a favour. That is the only reason he is calm. In a way, Vexthra needs his help, so he figured she wouldn’t make things hard for him.
’Goodness gracious, who knew I would be this afraid even after becoming a god?’ Orion laughed at himself inwardly. As a god, becoming afraid wasn’t in his nature, at least when facing other gods.
However, today, he was humbled.
Perhaps, if he learns from today’s lesson, he will finally be able to reach the rank of a God King.
Soon, they settled down under a spirit tree whose air contains divine energy. Just sitting under it is enough to recover lost divine energy.
Orion isn’t joking around.

chapters.title: Chapter 1205: Vexthra’s Favour
paragraphs: "First of all, allow me to apologize on my brother’s behalf. He is too hot-tempered and doesn’t know when to step back. So please forgive him and accept this wine as a token of my sincerity."
Orion waved his hand, and a jade bottle filled with half a litre of wine appeared. Two glasses appeared on the table, and he quickly poured the wine into them.
The smell of the wine instantly cleared Vexthra’s mind, allowing her comprehension speed to surge. Her mind cleared completely.
’A great wine.’ She said inwardly.
"This is the Stardrop Noir. It is a special brew from the Wine God of the Eastern Quadrant, Lord Daevor. He gave it to me as a thank-you for helping him with a crucial matter.
I was saving it for when I step into the rank of a God King, since just a single drop can boost my comprehension by a millionfold."
Vexthra took the wine glass and swirled the red wine inside. The dark red liquid in the glass releases a powerful medicinal essence that quickly makes the mouth go watery.
She looked at Orion and asked, "If it holds so much importance to you, then why pour it for me. You could have just hid it, and I wouldn’t know."
Orion smiled slightly... "Drinking it with a fairy such as yourself is more important than a dream that might as well never happen."
"Don’t sell yourself too short, Orion. I’ve heard even the Supremes ask for your help from time to time."
"I was just privileged to catch their eye, I suppose. After all, I am not the only god that can manipulate the Laws of Space."
"But you are the best I’ve heard. That is more than enough reason for you to keep going and never give up."
Orion swirls the drink in his glass but doesn’t dare drink it, not when Vexthra still hasn’t touched her own. Her words, however, seem to resonate with him.
Being praised by a figure as mighty and majestic as Vexthra felt nice.
The wine in his glass, just a single drop, can cause an entire galaxy in the Immortal Realm to go to war over it. It is a special brew from one of the seven Wine Gods.
Every Wine God has their special brews. One of the finest brews of Wine God Daevor is the Stardrop Noir. It is a wine that holds the power over comprehension/understanding.
Just one drop of it will enhance the drinker’s ability to comprehend things a million times faster. It also lasts for 10,000 years. However, a person can only drink it once in their lifetime.
A ten thousand years is a long time to learn something while under the divine intoxication of a wine.
Orion got this bottle after helping Wine God Daevor navigate a special space accessible only to those with the Space Law, so he could secure an ingredient for a wine he is working on.
This bottle, he had been saving it for millions of years. However, to appease a god, he broke it open now.
It is painful—excruciating even.
However, to show his sincerity, he had no choice but to prove to Vexthra that he meant well.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝚠𝚎𝚋𝗻𝗼𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝚘𝐦
This is just one of three bottles made by the wine god.
Vexthra swirled the wine again, and then she took a sip. In an instant, her mind opened, allowing her to start comprehending so many things at once.
Deep inside her primordial space, her primordial spirit opened her eyes just when Vexthra consumed the wine.
[What is that?] her primordial spirit asked.
’It is a wine I secured from a god who is trying to suck up to me simply because he is afraid I will hurt him or, worse, kill his scum of a brother.’
Because her primordial spirit has been cultivating the Ancient Path for a couple of years now, she isn’t as connected to her mind as she was before.
However, now that she is awake, everything she missed is flooding back into her mind.
[I see. Looks like he cares about his brother to sacrifice such good wine.]
’That is true.’

[In any case, the wine you drank has opened my mind, allowing me to comprehend the Ancient Path much faster now. At this rate, I will step into the ranks of an Immortal in a few years. Once that happens, we can help Kent actively like the rest of our sisters.]
’Good to hear that.’

[It is indeed a great thing. Which is why you should take the rest of the bottle and let our sisters have a taste of greatness. I am sure they will love the effect. Later, we will visit the wine god to see if we can secure another bottle for our sisters who will be joining in the future.]
Vexthra smiles inwardly... ’I am not sure it is going to be that easy. He seems attached to that wine. Although he doesn’t want to show it, I can see he is very sad right now.
The previous me wouldn’t have batted an eye and would have taken the whole bottle. However, I am different now.’
[I know, and I am not asking you to snatch it from him. Just help him with something far more important than the wine, and he will willingly give it to you.
I will prepare a Space Law comprehension technique I saw in the Ancient Path. Give it to him, and I am sure he will be happy and even offer to become your servant for life.]
’You are a flower.’
[I know. You and I are one. We share the same body and bear the same name. I am literally your soul, so no need to praise me. Praise yourself.]
Vexthra smiled again inwardly and took another sip of the wine.
"Good wine," she muttered, causing a pale smile to appear on Orion’s face.
Vexthra sighs, "You don’t have to drink if you don’t want to. After all, I came here to ask you to help someone cross between galaxies in the High World."
Orion set the glass down, using the moment to mask the hesitation to drink the wine. Vexthra noticed it, but she said nothing. She knew he would happily drink it soon.
"High World, huh. Isn’t that the place where one would have to cross the spatial field filled with Space Beasts to travel between galaxies?"
Vexthra said nothing. She merely nodded.
"Hmm. It is going to be a complex request. The laws prohibit intergalactic travel. This is to ensure the locks that prevent the Creatures of the Void from weakening.
If I were to open a spatial channel through it, it would indeed prevent the person from facing too much horror, but it would also weaken the Void Locks. That would be bad for the universe."
"I know. However, this person needs to get to this galaxy, so one way or another, he would have to cross the spatial field."
Orion took a deep sigh and focused his attention on Vexthra. A few seconds later, he sighed again.
"This is a big ask, Goddess Vexthra... It is a big ask that can cost me my divinity. So I am afraid I can’t help you." He took a deep breath and stared at his wine.
"However, there is another way... one that was paved by someone I am sure you are familiar with..."
Orion sighed and then spoke the name many would love to forget... "The Ruthless Bandit."

sentences.text: "First of all, allow me to apologize on my brother’s behalf.
He is too hot-tempered and doesn’t know when to step back.
So please forgive him and accept this wine as a token of my sincerity."
Orion waved his hand, and a jade bottle filled with half a litre of wine appeared.
Two glasses appeared on the table, and he quickly poured the wine into them.
The smell of the wine instantly cleared Vexthra’s mind, allowing her comprehension speed to surge.
Her mind cleared completely.
’A great wine.’ She said inwardly.
"This is the Stardrop Noir.
It is a special brew from the Wine God of the Eastern Quadrant, Lord Daevor.
He gave it to me as a thank-you for helping him with a crucial matter.
I was saving it for when I step into the rank of a God King, since just a single drop can boost my comprehension by a millionfold."
Vexthra took the wine glass and swirled the red wine inside.
The dark red liquid in the glass releases a powerful medicinal essence that quickly makes the mouth go watery.
She looked at Orion and asked, "If it holds so much importance to you, then why pour it for me.
You could have just hid it, and I wouldn’t know."
Orion smiled slightly...
"Drinking it with a fairy such as yourself is more important than a dream that might as well never happen."
"Don’t sell yourself too short, Orion.
I’ve heard even the Supremes ask for your help from time to time."
"I was just privileged to catch their eye, I suppose.
After all, I am not the only god that can manipulate the Laws of Space."
"But you are the best I’ve heard.
That is more than enough reason for you to keep going and never give up."
Orion swirls the drink in his glass but doesn’t dare drink it, not when Vexthra still hasn’t touched her own.
Her words, however, seem to resonate with him.
Being praised by a figure as mighty and majestic as Vexthra felt nice.
The wine in his glass, just a single drop, can cause an entire galaxy in the Immortal Realm to go to war over it.
It is a special brew from one of the seven Wine Gods.
Every Wine God has their special brews.
One of the finest brews of Wine God Daevor is the Stardrop Noir.
It is a wine that holds the power over comprehension/understanding.
Just one drop of it will enhance the drinker’s ability to comprehend things a million times faster.
It also lasts for 10,000 years.
However, a person can only drink it once in their lifetime.
A ten thousand years is a long time to learn something while under the divine intoxication of a wine.
Orion got this bottle after helping Wine God Daevor navigate a special space accessible only to those with the Space Law, so he could secure an ingredient for a wine he is working on.
This bottle, he had been saving it for millions of years.
However, to appease a god, he broke it open now.
It is painful—excruciating even.
However, to show his sincerity, he had no choice but to prove to Vexthra that he meant well.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝚠𝚎𝚋𝗻𝗼𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝚘𝐦
This is just one of three bottles made by the wine god.
Vexthra swirled the wine again, and then she took a sip.
In an instant, her mind opened, allowing her to start comprehending so many things at once.
Deep inside her primordial space, her primordial spirit opened her eyes just when Vexthra consumed the wine.
[What is that?] her primordial spirit asked.
’It is a wine I secured from a god who is trying to suck up to me simply because he is afraid I will hurt him or, worse, kill his scum of a brother.’
Because her primordial spirit has been cultivating the Ancient Path for a couple of years now, she isn’t as connected to her mind as she was before.
However, now that she is awake, everything she missed is flooding back into her mind.
[I see.
Looks like he cares about his brother to sacrifice such good wine.]
’That is true.’
[In any case, the wine you drank has opened my mind, allowing me to comprehend the Ancient Path much faster now.
At this rate, I will step into the ranks of an Immortal in a few years.
Once that happens, we can help Kent actively like the rest of our sisters.]
’Good to hear that.’
[It is indeed a great thing.
Which is why you should take the rest of the bottle and let our sisters have a taste of greatness.
I am sure they will love the effect.
Later, we will visit the wine god to see if we can secure another bottle for our sisters who will be joining in the future.]
Vexthra smiles inwardly... ’I am not sure it is going to be that easy.
He seems attached to that wine.
Although he doesn’t want to show it, I can see he is very sad right now.
The previous me wouldn’t have batted an eye and would have taken the whole bottle.
However, I am different now.’
[I know, and I am not asking you to snatch it from him.
Just help him with something far more important than the wine, and he will willingly give it to you.
I will prepare a Space Law comprehension technique I saw in the Ancient Path.
Give it to him, and I am sure he will be happy and even offer to become your servant for life.]
’You are a flower.’
[I know.
You and I are one.
We share the same body and bear the same name.
I am literally your soul, so no need to praise me.
Praise yourself.]
Vexthra smiled again inwardly and took another sip of the wine.
"Good wine," she muttered, causing a pale smile to appear on Orion’s face.
Vexthra sighs, "You don’t have to drink if you don’t want to.
After all, I came here to ask you to help someone cross between galaxies in the High World."
Orion set the glass down, using the moment to mask the hesitation to drink the wine.
Vexthra noticed it, but she said nothing.
She knew he would happily drink it soon.
"High World, huh.
Isn’t that the place where one would have to cross the spatial field filled with Space Beasts to travel between galaxies?"
Vexthra said nothing.
She merely nodded.
"Hmm.
It is going to be a complex request.
The laws prohibit intergalactic travel.
This is to ensure the locks that prevent the Creatures of the Void from weakening.
If I were to open a spatial channel through it, it would indeed prevent the person from facing too much horror, but it would also weaken the Void Locks.
That would be bad for the universe."
"I know.
However, this person needs to get to this galaxy, so one way or another, he would have to cross the spatial field."
Orion took a deep sigh and focused his attention on Vexthra.
A few seconds later, he sighed again.
"This is a big ask, Goddess Vexthra...
It is a big ask that can cost me my divinity.
So I am afraid I can’t help you." He took a deep breath and stared at his wine.
"However, there is another way... one that was paved by someone I am sure you are familiar with..."
Orion sighed and then spoke the name many would love to forget...
"The Ruthless Bandit."

chapters.title: Chapter 1206: Star Gateways
paragraphs: Vexthra was left stunned.

She had lived for millions of years already and had heard terrifying stories and legends. However, among those stories, the one that scared her the most was the forgotten legend of the Ruthless Bandit.
There are many twisted variations of his story; however, from what she knew of the Ruthless Bandit, he was born a fortunate child.
His bloodline is human, but, as many said, his true lineage traces back to the ancient humans. Legends speak of them as the first humans.
He was the prince of a mighty empire.
He had a loving family, friends, and riches that promised to keep him afloat for years to come. Basically, he had everything.
To him, reaching the peak of cultivation was paved for him, for he had the backing to walk with his shoulder held high.
However, despite his riches, his family made sure he also received a good upbringing. The plan was to mold his character into that of an emperor, for he was destined to sit on the throne one day.
Everyone loved him, and he was on track to become the next emperor.
However, all that was taken from him when their own allies conspired against them. Those his family had protected for eons plotted against them, and overnight, every last one of them was slaughtered.
He was the only one who barely survived by sheer luck.

Homeless and on the run from powerful enemies, he resorted to any means to survive. He was raised as a good and honest person. However, he found himself running for his life simply because of the power of his surname.
Eventually, the gentle and loving prince began to disappear, replaced by a cold and ruthless person.
He was later taken in by a bandit group that had no moral code. They would do anything to survive. No thanks to them, his life was further twisted until he became someone akin to a monster.
He killed without mercy or remorse.
To him, to win a battle, he would use any means necessary. He had no problem using just anyone to get what he wanted.
In his book, the end justifies the means.

In fact, he got to the point that even the bandits he moved with became afraid of him. He only grew more ruthless by the passing of the days until even the bandits with no moral code had to pull themselves away from him.
However, that was when the worst of him was born. She slaughtered his former teammates and went ahead to start wreaking havoc wherever he went.
The slightest thing makes him tick, and when he is angry, blood flows like a river.
Eventually, he was given the name "Ruthless Bandit."
The many powerhouses were too scared of him to dare raise their weapons against him. Of course, some choose not mind him. The last thing they wanted was to invoke his wrath.
However, one day, after vanishing for a hundred years, out of nowhere, the Ruthless Bandit returned as an immortal.

That was the day he was noticed, and also the day immortals learned that the most dangerous thing isn’t the heavenly laws, but the human boy with red hair whose life was turned upside down because some people became greedy.
Immortals fell like flies, and soon, the gods noticed him. However, for someone who didn’t care about anyone, not even the threat of the gods fazed him.
And so for hundreds of thousands of years, they hunted him down, and he killed his fair share of immortals and gods.
The forgotten legend spoke of the day he became a god. It was said that the day he stepped into the realm of godhood, almost all gods ran into hiding, leaving the god realm all to him.
Supremes and Celestials avoided him like a plague.
Even the heavenly laws didn’t dare mess with him, for he was explosive, and whatever he set his mind to, no matter how long or how much he had to sacrifice, until he achieved it, he would never stop.
When the creatures of the Dark arrived, to everyone’s shock, the Ruthless Bandit didn’t run, but faced them with everything he had. In the end, he fell, but not before he cleaved the last Dark Beast.
"If I remember correctly, the Ruthless Bandit was shunned by the universe, his name erased from all existence. I even learned that talking about him carried some karmic debt.
So how does such a person, so ruthless that even the universe chose to erase his name, be of help to me?"
Orion, who suggested the second method to cross over to a different galaxy, waved his hand, and a star map appeared.
He spread it and then pointed at various stars.
"A very long time ago, I found this map in a ruin that came from the Dark Era. From what I learned about this map, it was one used by star travellers, beings who travel between distant stars.
These stars, from what I managed to discern, are gateways between galaxies. Of course, I wasn’t convinced back then, so I further researched and found the truth.
The gateways are indeed real.
They were carved into the Void Locks by the Primordial Chaos Dragon as a way for people to be able to travel between galaxies.
However, perhaps due to miscalculations or the many battles that occurred across the eras, the gateways became corrupted.
Before the corruption, it was as simple as walking along a path from one galaxy to another.
However, it is now littered with abominable creatures.
From the map, I learned that the Ruthless Bandit once used all seven of these gateways, and that was what caused his strength to surge and talent to explode overnight.
Thanks to him, I also learned that while abominations are littering the star gateways, the strongest of them are only Immortal Lords.

I can prepare a special spatial artefact that will allow this person to evade Immortal King and upward. However, they would have to fight their way through several True Immortal stage and below abominations."
Vexthra took a deep breath, feeling her mind reeling.
She came looking for a simple solution since she knew Orion could easily create spatial channels to cross dangerous regions and even link galaxies.
However, she learned that it’s not possible simply because doing so will weaken the fabric of the universe and risk releasing the oldest and most powerful enemies of the universe—the Void Beasts.
That, Vexthra knew, cannot be allowed to happen.
So they had to resort to a method that was made known by the Ruthless Bandit.
Considering the person who discovered it was the Ruthless Bandit, there is no telling just what kind of danger awaits Kent there.
’At least, facing True Immortals is better than demigods and gods.’ She sighed.

"I would then trouble you to help me with a few of those artefacts. In return, I will help you break through to the God King stage and possibly, if you are not lazy, be able to reach the rank of a Universal God one day."
Orion’s eyes widened. However, before he could respond, Vexthra retrieved a manual from her space ring and handed it to him.
"It contains an ancient Space Law cultivation technique that, when you master it, will push you further than you think." She handed it over to him and then leaned back in her chair.
Her Primordial Spirit had sweetened the pot for her.
"Once you are done working on the artefact, add the remaining bottle of wine. You can have the one in your glass."
Orion nodded like a kid, his eyes sparkling as he scanned the first page of the manual.
’I am sorry, Kent, but this is the best I can do. I will leave the rest to you.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1207: Vexthra’s Gift
paragraphs: Vexthra came back to the god realm to find a safe way for Kent to cross from Astralis Veil, where he currently is, to Tenebral Crown, the galaxy the destiny map said Elina lives in.

It is a long journey, one that will be harrowing if she doesn’t get adequate help. Of course, if he had the strength to battle gods, supreme and perhaps even celestial beasts, crossing the Space field would be easy.
However, a long time ago, the Space Field was used to imprison yet another race of harrowing abominable beasts called Space Beasts or Star Beasts.
This prison was then used to divide the various galaxies in the High world. However, there are gateways in the God, Supreme, and Celestial worlds.
This was so that one day, the cultivators would be able to kill all Star Beasts. So the current Kent is like a lamb to the slaughter if he dares venture inside.
So, as a good and loving wife, Vexthra only wanted to protect her man. She wants to make sure her sister, whom she has yet to meet, is rescued and brought home safely.

Of course, while Kent isn’t aware, the mission he had embarked on is one that struck close to home for Vexthra. It reminded her of someone, who is the key reason why she wanted Kent to help her kill the god of Alchemy.
In truth, she wanted many people dead, even celestials. However, the Alchemy god is just the first domino in a long line of dominoes.
This is why she wants this mission completed on good terms, for she genuinely wanted to meet this Elina.
Perhaps this is destiny playing her game, but the Vexthra that Kent met when she appeared in the realm of Hatred and Resentment was actually grieving.
She only became more normal when she met Kent’s wives and started interacting with the others in the tower.
She had yet to tell Kent why she wanted the Alchemy god dead. Of course, Kent didn’t ask her why when she gave him that mission, and she is grateful for that.
However, this mission to rescue Elina is bringing back sad memories, so she wants to use any means necessary to ensure he reaches Tenebral Crown safely.
This also means even if she had to give something as precious as knowledge from the ancient past, to get what she wanted for Kent, she wouldn’t hesitate.
Watching Orion flip through the manual with varying expressions appearing on his face with every flip, she could only smile in her head.
In the past, she would have been annoyed and even smashed his face in. This shows she has changed.
She needed help, so she would do anything as long as it was not below her bottom line to get what she came for.

Orion spent three good hours examining the manual, page by page, line by line. By the time he was done, Vexthra could see the respect, gratitude, and joy in his eyes, on his face, and in his gestures.
"Would that be enough to secure your help in any way I wanted?"
Orion nodded frantically... "This is more than enough. In fact, this is better than enough." He flipped through a couple of pages, his smile brightening.

"The way I saw the stars was utterly wrong. In fact, the way I saw the laws of the stars and space was from the start a fate joke. This is the right method...the one lost to time...the one we tried to copy but failed."
He looked up at Vexthra and said:
"This manual contains so much knowledge that if I manage to comprehend the first page in its entirety, then my understanding of the Space Law will surge far beyond my wildest understanding."
Vexthra didn’t show any reaction, but she was happy that Orion felt that way. This means what she came for can be secured, and she can even get a bonus.
"Thank you, Goddess Vexthra. What you had given me is more than enough to see my rise to the peak of Celestialhood."
This time, Vexthra smiles... "Let’s not get ahead of ourselves, Space God. The journey ahead is complex and much more profound than you think. So you might want to slow down a bit.
Of course, I will be happy to see you rise to the peak one day."
"I will. I will not waste your generosity." He finally stored away the manual not in his space ring, but deep inside his god space.

Every god has a private god space. Though not advanced like the Primordial Space Vexthra and her sisters have, it is good enough to keep the secrets of a god who had just received the best gift of his life.
Once the book was secured, he turned back to Vexthra... "I will quickly recalibrate the artefact since I already have one. It will lead the person to the star gateway closest to them.

Also, when inside the star gateway, it will shield them from Immortal King beasts and above. However, there is a chance they might encounter an Immortal Kin. But there is a one-in-a-hundred-million chance of that happening."
"That is good enough for me. The person who will be using it isn’t exactly an ordinary person." Vexthra smiled again. However, she quickly returned to normal and looked carefully at Orion.
"I honestly don’t know what will result from today’s meeting; however, should something big that is related to today’s meeting happen, you will do your best not to speak a word of it to anyone.
In fact, going into a million years of seclusion will be ideal. I know you have a place where time is accelerated.
You can even go into a hundred million years’ seclusion because trust me, you would love not to be on the wrong side of this person."

Orion smiled and shook his head... "Today never happened. As far as I am concerned, I was visited by the goddess of Hatred and Resentment, who heard I had secured a bottle of Stardrop Noir, and she came to ask for it politely for the whole bottle."
"I like smart people." Vexthra smiles slyly.
Orion wiped an invisible sweat off his forehead and quickly went back to calibrating the artefact.
Vexthra chuckles inwardly, knowing Orion is handled.
She wants Kent to be safe, and so she made sure Orion knows his place.
Although she had no idea Kent was once known as the Ruthless Bandit, a part of her couldn’t shake the feeling that something big would soon happen.
She can feel it in her bones.
So she made sure Orion understood that.
Now that she is done, all she can do is take the last sip of her drink and wait for Orion to work on the artefact.
Although he said he would work on it quickly, to a god who had lived for billions of years, the concept of time is not so important anymore.𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢
It will take him close to 2 months to finish it, but Vexthra has time, and so she will wait. Kent is on his way to Liora’s homeworld.
However, for the time being, he is spending time with her sisters.
That is also good enough for her. Soon, when she gets what she came for, she will join them.
By then, Kent would have traveled much closer to the edge of the galaxy.

Vexthra didn’t show any reaction, but she was happy that Orion felt that way.
This means what she came for can be secured, and she can even get a bonus.
"Thank you, Goddess Vexthra.
What you had given me is more than enough to see my rise to the peak of Celestialhood."
This time, Vexthra smiles...
"Let’s not get ahead of ourselves, Space God.
The journey ahead is complex and much more profound than you think.
So you might want to slow down a bit.
Of course, I will be happy to see you rise to the peak one day."
"I will.
I will not waste your generosity." He finally stored away the manual not in his space ring, but deep inside his god space.
Every god has a private god space.
Though not advanced like the Primordial Space Vexthra and her sisters have, it is good enough to keep the secrets of a god who had just received the best gift of his life.
Once the book was secured, he turned back to Vexthra...
"I will quickly recalibrate the artefact since I already have one.
It will lead the person to the star gateway closest to them.
Also, when inside the star gateway, it will shield them from Immortal King beasts and above.
However, there is a chance they might encounter an Immortal Kin.
But there is a one-in-a-hundred-million chance of that happening."
"That is good enough for me.
The person who will be using it isn’t exactly an ordinary person." Vexthra smiled again.
However, she quickly returned to normal and looked carefully at Orion.
"I honestly don’t know what will result from today’s meeting; however, should something big that is related to today’s meeting happen, you will do your best not to speak a word of it to anyone.
In fact, going into a million years of seclusion will be ideal.
I know you have a place where time is accelerated.
You can even go into a hundred million years’ seclusion because trust me, you would love not to be on the wrong side of this person."
Orion smiled and shook his head...
"Today never happened.
As far as I am concerned, I was visited by the goddess of Hatred and Resentment, who heard I had secured a bottle of Stardrop Noir, and she came to ask for it politely for the whole bottle."
"I like smart people." Vexthra smiles slyly.
Orion wiped an invisible sweat off his forehead and quickly went back to calibrating the artefact.
Vexthra chuckles inwardly, knowing Orion is handled.
She wants Kent to be safe, and so she made sure Orion knows his place.
Although she had no idea Kent was once known as the Ruthless Bandit, a part of her couldn’t shake the feeling that something big would soon happen.
She can feel it in her bones.
So she made sure Orion understood that.
Now that she is done, all she can do is take the last sip of her drink and wait for Orion to work on the artefact.
Although he said he would work on it quickly, to a god who had lived for billions of years, the concept of time is not so important anymore.𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢
It will take him close to 2 months to finish it, but Vexthra has time, and so she will wait.
Kent is on his way to Liora’s homeworld.
However, for the time being, he is spending time with her sisters.
That is also good enough for her.
Soon, when she gets what she came for, she will join them.
By then, Kent would have traveled much closer to the edge of the galaxy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1208: Leaving The Underworld
paragraphs: "So this is the underworld," Vargus asked, gazing at the vast city before him from a window in Nyx’s Dark Castle. Avotha and Lene stood on his left while Uncle Drew was on his right.
"Yes," Uncle Drew answered.
"Not quite as insidious as I expected, but quaint."
"That is the beauty of the underworld, I suppose. In any case, it is much more beautiful if you travel and interact with the people."
Vargus nodded and turned away from the view... "When we have time, I will come here for a vacation."
"Suit yourself. Not many I know would willingly come to the underworld for a vacation. I myself prefer the land of the living where real people live," Uncle Drew said with a small smile.
They arrived in the underworld 10 hours ago. However, instead of leaving immediately, they had to wait for Nyx, who couldn’t pick the best gifts to send to Kent.
It wasn’t that she didn’t have anything; it was that she didn’t know what to pick from her vast array of treasures.

So Uncle and his people had to wait for her while she debated on what to pick. Of course, it was annoying to have to wait for her, but Uncle Drew had spent most of his life in the underworld, and so he knew her character all too well.
This was why he wasn’t bothered.
If anything, he was happier knowing that once he left today, he wouldn’t be coming back for another thousand years.
Uncle Drew sat down and started taking tiny sips of his favourite underworld wine.
’Too bad I can’t bring people to the underworld. I would have brought Master to tame this wild one before she makes my life any more chaotic.’
He smiled inwardly, already planning how to get his master to the underworld much faster.
’Once he is done with his latest mission and ascends, I will visit those fishermen and see if I can get a secure way to help him come here.’
He took a sip of the wine... ’But then again, once she manages to form her god core, she can leave. However, looking for a way for him to come is not off the table.’
A day passed, but Nyx wasn’t back.
Uncle Drew remained in the same place. He had waited for her much longer before, so a few hours wasn’t something he would be worried about.
Thankfully, three days later, she finally found something. She stored everything inside a special space ring and brought it to Uncle Drew.
"I was expecting you to last a year, but I guess this is a new record. You should be proud of yourself."
Nyx just smirked and disregarded Uncle Drew’s joke...
"Be sure to tell him to open the space ring when he is alone."
Uncle Drew didn’t say anything and just stored the space ring away. He knew better than to ask anything, knowing this demoness was more dangerous than any monster he had seen so far.

"Tell Kent I miss him and I still stand on business. Soon, I will master the 4th form of the technique he gave me. When I do, and he is not here, then he shouldn’t blame me for taking drastic action."
"He is already aware."
"Tell him again. That will show him I meant business."
Uncle Drew glared at Nyx for a few seconds and sighed, "Why not. I will tell him."
Nyx smiled happily.
"If you want to leave, then be quick to form your god core and awaken your own domain. That way, when you finally leave, the law and order of this level of the underworld won’t fall into chaos."
Nyx nodded with a determined expression.
She knew if Uncle Drew took her away now, her entire kingdom would come undone in her absence. That will be catastrophic.
So for now, she could only wait for Kent, who may not seem like it, but actually wanted to reunite with her soon enough.
A couple of minutes later, Uncle Drew, Avotha, Lene, and Vargus were ready to leave.
"I have never used this method to leave the underworld before, so be ready for anything." Uncle Drew warned and then added, "We might end up in the lair of monsters."
That didn’t seem to move the three people standing beside him. Seeing this, he smiled and put on his mask.
He brought his hands together and formed a seal,
In an instant, a chaotic portal opened before him.
"Take care, Nyx."
"I will," Nyx replied, "And do your best to protect my husband in my absence."
Uncle Drew wanted to say, ’bitch, you haven’t even kissed him before...what gives you the right to call him your husband?’
However, as if she knew what he wanted to say, she gave him a gentle push into the portal, and the three demigods were pulled with him.
Nyx smiled and quickly left the scene.
Now that she finally had the chance to send something to Kent, the next important thing was to resume working hard to reunite with him someday.
[Unknown Planet]
A figure uncontrollably flew through space like a meteor heading toward a particular blue planet. Perhaps because of how fast he was moving, stabilizing his body was becoming an issue.
So he can only fly aimlessly toward the planet.
In no time, he entered the planet’s atmosphere.
BOOOOOOM
He crashed into a mountain of ice, raising a cloud of ice mist.
Aerion, the storm god, slowly stood up, wiping blood off the corner of his lips. Looking at the blood on his hands, his eyes turned bloodshot.

With just a flick, Vexthra sent the poor bastard flying through the air like a cannonball. He had been flying for several hours without gaining the ability to stabilize his fall. Finally, he managed to crash into an unknown planet.
He gritted his teeth, causing more blood to pour from the corner of his lips.
"I will squeeze the life out—"
"WHO DARE WAKE ME UP"
Suddenly, a chilling voice spoke, and an absolute aura seized Aerion in place. He immediately turned pale, sweat breaking on his forehead.
His body was practically trembling as he knelt on the ground.
’Ah, my bad luck,’ Aerion cursed his bad luck for finding himself in this situation.
He tried to move his head to the side to look at the person walking toward him; however, he was too scared even to turn.
Soon, a redhead beauty with red eyes that held so much danger appeared before him. Aerion had already prayed his last prayer, so when the lady appeared, he knew he was done for.
’Ah, dying at the hands of a Universal God is much better than being hurled through space like a doll for hours.’
Even so, Aerion gathered the courage to look at the face of the person about to kill him. When he saw that beautiful face and eyes, instead of being mesmerized, his heart sank. He knew he was fucked.
"What is your name?" the lady asked.
"A-Aerion."
"Aerion, which Era is this?"
Aerion was taken aback, but he quickly answered, "It-it is the Infinity Era."
The lady didn’t say anything. She retrieved a device from her god space and channeled her divine energy into it. After a few seconds, she turned to Aerion, "Has anything big happened recently?"
Aerion blinked a few times, unsure of what to say. To him, Vexthra’s making an appearance in public for the first time after millions of years felt like something big.𝘧𝓇𝑒𝑒𝑤ℯ𝑏𝓃𝘰𝑣ℯ𝘭.𝘤ℴ𝘮
However, he dared not say that. Instead, he thought long and hard about it and answered,
"A 14th name appeared on the Sword Dao Tablet."
Her red eyes widened, then narrowed, hearing what Aerion said. "When, who, and where?"
"About a year ago, by somebody named Kent Madson. It is rumoured that he is still in the High World."
After hearing that, the lady looked up, and then she vanished. Aerion collapsed on the ground and lost consciousness. He was spared, but the fear he felt knocked him out.
A few minutes later, the redhead lady appeared on another planet several light-years from where she met Aerion.

"Looks like I’ve been woken up much earlier than anticipated," she smiled, "This is good too. At least this time around, I will find you first and make you mine as I promised. Let’s see how you resist a Universal god this time."
With that, she vanished.
Somewhere far away, Kent sneezed..."I should be careful; someone is probably plotting against me."

chapters.title: Chapter 1209: Welcome To The Tower
paragraphs: BOOOOM
A kid was hurled through the air, his left cheek and other body parts were injured, letting out green blood. Humans on Earth will call him an Alien.
Of course, he has the appearance of an Alien. His eyes are green, his hair green, and there are even green scales on his cheek.
At first glance, one would see him as a 12-year-old. However, despite his look or age, his cultivation had already reached the Life stage and was even on the verge of reaching the Death stage.
Obviously, he is no 12-year-old.
As he flew through the air, a figure with features similar to his appeared below and caught him. He teleported and appeared 4000 km away.
Behind them, five Immortal Kings and an Immortal Emperor were hot on their tail. Two of them also have green skin; however, four of them have deep green, almost black skin.
The two with the green skin held nothing in their hands, but the four held bows in their firm grip, eyes locked on the kid and his brother.
They were moving at several km per second.
"You are just running from the inevitable, Kaelen. The Queen will have your brother, and there is no hole you can hide in that we won’t find you"
The Immortal Emperor said, firing a 3-meter-long black arrow.
However, the young man holding the child is also an Immortal King, so he easily evaded the arrow. The determined look in his eyes said all that needed to be known.
...he is determined to keep the kid safe, and no matter what, he will make sure of that. With every leap, they are propelled several km ahead, widening the gap between him and them.
The kid looked at him and gently wiped the green blood off the corner of his lips.
"B-big brother, maybe let them take me and save yourself," he is worried about his brother. The entire chase was to get him. So if he surrenders, the chances of him saving himself are high.
"Shut up, Lio, I promised Father I would keep you safe, and I intend to do that."
The kid sighs, his expression turning sombre. He is powerless in this regard, and so all he could do was stay quiet and let his big brother save him and himself.
Suddenly, an arrow struck his brother’s back, sending him stumbling forward. However, he didn’t fall flat on his face like it was intended.
If he did, the enemy would catch up to them. However, as if the arrow were made of poison, his body began to weaken.
"Futile. You can save yourself by leaving that brat behind... Yet—"
Another arrow was fired by an Immortal King, finding its mark on the young man’s back again. This time, his vision turned blurry, so when he stumbled, he fell.
However, he held on to his brother in his firm grip, gritting his teeth as he rolled across the floor.

When they stabilised, the kid pressed his tiny palm on his brother’s chest, sending his green energy into his body. However, as a Life stage warrior, healing an injury caused by an Immortal King and Immortal Emperor is no easy feat.
"Save your energy, Lio, I am not that weak."
"Big Brother..."
Lio’s voice broke as tears began to fall down his face.
"Don’t worry, Lio, I will keep you safe." He tried to stand up, but the pain and weakness made him fall to his knees.
However, watching their pursuers closing in, he forced himself to stand and move.
But before he could move, another arrow embedded itself into his right foot, sending him back to his knees.
The young man let out a hoarse scream, forcing the pain to the back of his mind and stood up to run again.
Even the people chasing him were stunned by his dedication and strong will. However, his speed had slowed after taking two deadly arrows in his back and one in his leg.
Soon, they would be only 400 meters away, closing in on them fast.
However, before they could get to a grabbing range, the world suddenly turned cold. The young man slowed down, feeling the change.
"What is it, big brother?"
"I don’t know"
Although he felt the chance, he didn’t stop running. The six immortals chasing them, eager to get their hands on them, ignored the change in the air and used the moment to get closer.

However, before they could get their hands on them, the space cracked, and a wave of heat broke the coldness. From within, a dark-haired young man stepped out in a stumbling motion, almost like he was pushed.
The moment he came out, three others followed, and the portal closed. Everything happened in under two seconds, bringing the whole region to a standstill.
The kid and his brother stopped 3 meters away from the new arrivals, their expressions grim.
As for the six immortals, one of them released an arrow before the portal opened, and because of the sudden distraction, the arrow found its mark at the young man’s head.
However, before it could connect, Avotha moved and caught it. Then, with no effort, he broke the arrow in half.
This action caused the six immortals to halt and instantly retreat—or tried to.
Before they could move even their fingers, an invisible force enveloped them, freezing them in place. Avotha turned to Uncle Drew, but the latter was pissed off by what Nyx did to him.
Nyx did push him into the portal, so he was pissed.
Avotha didn’t want to disturb him, so he turned to the kid and his big brother and asked, "Is this an immortal world?"
"Yes," the young man with his pale face answered, holding his brother even tighter. He can’t get a read on Avotha’s aura.
Naturally, that scared the shit out of him.
Avotha narrowed his eyes at them, causing the kid to turn his gaze from him. Even his brother is afraid, considering how his body was twitching.
"Stop scaring the kid, Avotha," Uncle Drew suddenly said, stepping up to the kid and his brother.
"My name is Drew, but you can call me Uncle Drew. These are my friends, Avotha, Lene, and Vargus."
The kid turned to Uncle Drew and hesitated before speaking, "I am Li0, and this is my big brother Kaelen. We are running from the bad guys who want to kill my brother and take me away."
Uncle Drew smiled, commending the kids’ smartness in his heart.
’This kid is much more intelligent than he looks.’
Since Avotha asked whether this was an immortal world, he knew these people weren’t from their world. Of course, they can tell they aren’t from their world.
This means they can help them. So he quickly used the moment to reveal what shit they are in.
"Avotha, take care of those scums." Of course, Uncle Drew didn’t need a genie telling him the six immortals are scums of society. Chasing after a kid is already enough to tell their character.
Avotha waved his hand, and black flames ignited the six immortals. Then, with a snap of his finger, they all turned into black orbs and flew toward his space ring and entered.
"Well, Lio and Kaelen, do you want to come with us, or should we send you back home?"
Lio looked at his brother, who was still in pain, before answering, "Our home was destroyed."
"Sorry to hear that. In that case, come with us. Your brother needs healing."
They hesitated for a moment, and then Lio nodded.
Uncle Drew smiled and waved his hand, and the next second, they were standing in a completely different environment.
"Welcome to the Tower, everyone."
