The kid and his brother stopped 3 meters away from the new arrivals, their expressions grim.
As for the six immortals, one of them released an arrow before the portal opened, and because of the sudden distraction, the arrow found its mark at the young man’s head.
However, before it could connect, Avotha moved and caught it.
Then, with no effort, he broke the arrow in half.
This action caused the six immortals to halt and instantly retreat—or tried to.
Before they could move even their fingers, an invisible force enveloped them, freezing them in place.
Avotha turned to Uncle Drew, but the latter was pissed off by what Nyx did to him.
Nyx did push him into the portal, so he was pissed.
Avotha didn’t want to disturb him, so he turned to the kid and his big brother and asked, "Is this an immortal world?"
"Yes," the young man with his pale face answered, holding his brother even tighter.
He can’t get a read on Avotha’s aura.
Naturally, that scared the shit out of him.
Avotha narrowed his eyes at them, causing the kid to turn his gaze from him.
Even his brother is afraid, considering how his body was twitching.
"Stop scaring the kid, Avotha," Uncle Drew suddenly said, stepping up to the kid and his brother.
"My name is Drew, but you can call me Uncle Drew.
These are my friends, Avotha, Lene, and Vargus."
The kid turned to Uncle Drew and hesitated before speaking, "I am Li0, and this is my big brother Kaelen.
We are running from the bad guys who want to kill my brother and take me away."
Uncle Drew smiled, commending the kids’ smartness in his heart.
’This kid is much more intelligent than he looks.’
Since Avotha asked whether this was an immortal world, he knew these people weren’t from their world.
Of course, they can tell they aren’t from their world.
This means they can help them.
So he quickly used the moment to reveal what shit they are in.
"Avotha, take care of those scums." Of course, Uncle Drew didn’t need a genie telling him the six immortals are scums of society.
Chasing after a kid is already enough to tell their character.
Avotha waved his hand, and black flames ignited the six immortals.
Then, with a snap of his finger, they all turned into black orbs and flew toward his space ring and entered.
"Well, Lio and Kaelen, do you want to come with us, or should we send you back home?"
Lio looked at his brother, who was still in pain, before answering, "Our home was destroyed."
"Sorry to hear that.
In that case, come with us.
Your brother needs healing."
They hesitated for a moment, and then Lio nodded.
Uncle Drew smiled and waved his hand, and the next second, they were standing in a completely different environment.
"Welcome to the Tower, everyone."

chapters.title: Chapter 1210: Home At Last
paragraphs: "Uncle Drew"
Cheerful and childish voices called out from behind, causing Uncle Drew to let out a defeated sigh...
’Ah, my bad luck.’
Gaia, Akira, Dori, Purity, and Yuna jumped high, their arms wide open as they approached Uncle Drew, who, to their luck, suddenly appeared when they were getting bored.
He had no choice but to indulge the tiny humans in one big hug.
He opens his arm wide, and they jump in like a bunch of crabs.
"Uncle Drew, Gaia misses you so much," Gaia said, wrapping her tiny hands around Uncle Drew’s neck.
"Dori misses Uncle Drew."
"Akira also misses Uncle Drew."
"Yuna also misses Uncle Drew."
"Purity also misses Uncle Drew."
Of course, they all had to say it one by one to show just how much they miss him, and they had to do it in the third person, too.
Uncle Drew just hugged them since that was what they came for.
"I miss you all too."
He had only been gone for less than three days. However, a month had already passed inside the Tower. Of course, they spent most of their time in the cities.
However, since Gaia and her two sisters are always building things here and there, they go to the Guardian Tower to work from time to time.
Even so, missing him that much is overly excessive.
But then again, they want to spend some time with him. So now that he is back, nothing is stopping them.
Uncle Drew is somewhat happy, too. After all, he really wants to be in the land of the living, where actual living humans are. That is enough reason for him to be happy.
"Uncle Drew, who are these people?" Yuna asked, raising her head to look at Avotha and the rest who came with Uncle Drew.
"They are my friends I brought back from my travels."
"Can we play with them?" Akira asked.
"Of course you can play with them. However, we now have something important to do, so go back and continue what you were doing. Once we are done, I will call you."
"Promise?"
"I promise."
The troublemakers nodded and ran off, and soon left the mountain garden. When he made sure they were finally gone, Uncle Drew took a deep breath.
He turned to Avotha and the others who stood staring at him. When he saw the expressions on their faces, especially Vargus and Lene, he immediately reprimanded them.
"Not a word to anyone."
"I mean, if the great Kael Duskbane had finally turned into an Uncle of five lovely kids, then why not?" Lene said with a cute smile, which made Uncle Drew chuckle.
He turned to Lio and his brother... "This place is akin to a high world. So you will be suppressed to the limit of a high world. This also means you can use your healing abilities on your brother."
Lio nodded and started healing his brother.
Seeing this, Uncle Drew nodded, then tapped into his connection with Kent and informed him that he had returned.
After that, he led everyone to a lavish sitting area in the newly built Mountain Garden. It is much more beautiful now. Gaia and her sisters had outdone themselves this time.
The air is clean. The plants, flowers, fruit trees and even the chirping birds are some of the most beautiful things you will ever find in the universe.
After they settled down, Lene quickly asked... "Where are we?"

"It is a pocket world owned by the young master. In here, he is the supreme ruler. Unless you have his permission, you cannot enter. I was only able to bring you with me since he gave me the authority to come and go as I please."
"Cool," Vargus said, looking around the garden.
Uncle Drew turned to Avotha with questions written all over his face.
...he studied him for a few seconds before asking:
"We Night Riders don’t have to worry about the limitations of planets. We are immune to that restriction. This was why I find it normal that Lene and Vargus are still demigods even in a high world.
However, you are not a Night Rider, so how are you still a demigod even in here?"
Avotha, who was already puzzled by the same thing, thought for a moment before answering... "I have no idea why."
He didn’t ask Lio and his brother whether they were in an immortal world for no reason. He expected to be instantly suppressed when they appeared in the eternal world.
Since he wasn’t a Night Rider, his cultivation was naturally supposed to be suppressed. However, even after arriving in an immortal world, he remained a demigod.
Now, even inside a High World, he is still a demigod.
That doesn’t make any sense.
However, he had no answer as to why, and Uncle Drew most certainly didn’t either. So with no answer in sight, he had to drop it and investigate later.
Kent is busy having fun with his wives, so it will be a while before he comes to them. But in the meantime, Uncle Drew decided to tell them more about the Tower World
Of course, with Lio and his brother now at the peak Heavenly Ascension stage, healing his brother from the arrow wounds wasn’t too hard.
Kaelen had recovered from the effect of the arrow.
"What do you think about them?" Uncle Drew asked Avotha.
"They are clearly running from a powerful enemy, considering six immortals were after them when we arrived.
However, as to why, they would have to tell us. I can also sense extreme Life energy coming from both of them. But the kid also has Death energy coming off him.
The immortals I refined also have Death energy. So maybe these two are important people."
Uncle Drew nodded and focused more on Lio and his brother. After a few minutes, they stood up and walked toward them.
When they got close, they knelt and bowed. Kaelen, the big brother, spoke... "Thank you for saving us. If there is anything we can do, please tell us."
"No need to bow before us. We only did what was right."
Lio and his brother nodded and stood up.
"Though you can tell us why they were after you."
Lio looked at his brother before he started to answer. Within five minutes, he was done, and the reason became clear to him.𝘧𝓇ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝘣𝓃ℴ𝓋𝑒𝑙.𝑐𝘰𝑚
It turned out that the two of them are Mortavians. This race has two distinct types of people: Life Mortavians and Death Mortavians.
One part has Life affinity, while the other has Death affinity. The two live on separate islands, and Cross-marriage is not allowed since nobody dares to bear any abomination.
Lio’s family is Life Mortavians, all of them, except Lio. He is both a Life and a Death Mortavian. His unique constitution allows him to harness both Life and Death energies.
His family, who knew that if he was discovered, his life would be in danger, tried to take him away when his bloodline awakened 3 months ago.
However, the Queen of the Life Mortavians caught wind of it and sent people after them. His father, mother, two brothers, and sisters were killed or captured - they are not sure about that.
Only Lio and Kaelen managed to escape the island, and if they hadn’t met Uncle Drew and the others when they did, they would have been caught by their pursuers.
"Tragic," Uncle Drew said with a sigh, "In any case, you can stay here for the time being. Later, we will go look for your family"
They nodded and chose to relax on the side.
Five hours later, Kent arrived in the Mountain Garden, causing the three demigods to become happy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1211: Reunion
paragraphs: Kent only recognised Avotha the moment his eyes landed on the three demigods.
However, looking at Lene and Vargus, he couldn’t shake the feeling that he had known them for millions of years.
Deep in his heart, a feeling of camaraderie fills him, making him wonder where he knows them from.

Of course, he is already aware that he was once the master of the Night Riders. He became aware of this when he awakened Uncle Drew’s True Name and also from Chaos when he met Him in one of his visions.
He knew that during the Great War, when he shattered his soul and called deep into time and space, the Night Riders Legion and the other 12 legions answered his call and came.
Chaos told him at one point in time that all 13 legions were his creation, so he knew the Night Riders were, at some point in time, his team.
But he doesn’t know just which life that was.
However, he knew they were important to him, and that feeling only intensified as he walked closer to them.
To Kent’s shock, the colossal Vargus just got up from his seat and, using his tall and heavy body, lunged at him for a hug.
Kent saw him coming, but he couldn’t dodge.
It was impossible to dodge.
Vargus wasn’t using his demigod strength; however, he couldn’t find an opening to dodge. So, in the end, the hug happened, but because of Vargus’s weight, Kent fell onto his back.
"I miss you so much, master." Vargus was practically at the point of tears. Unlike Kent, he has memories of his previous life, and so he knew things many don’t.
These things are now fuelling his emotions when he sets his sights on Kent.
Kent pat him on the back, almost choking... "I miss you, too, big guy, even if I have no idea who you are at the moment."
Vargus didn’t mind. Hearing he misses him, too, was enough. In the end, he broke the hug and lifted Kent off the ground.
Lene and Uncle Drew just sat on the side watching the brute, who, in the past, was Kent’s favourite. They have the same idea of how battles should be fought.
One could say that while Kent was ruthless, he was destructive. They shared a more friendly connection back then.
Kent looked at Vargus for a few seconds before smiling. He then turned to Lene... and asked, "No hug from you?"
Lene shook her head. "Hugging the master is inappropriate."
"How is hugging inappropriate? Hugging is the best feeling in the universe, so calling it inappropriate is an understatement."
Lene turned to Uncle Drew, who winked and muttered, "Enjoy while you have the chance, Lene."
Of course, Lene was hesitating since the version of Kent he knew had no love in his heart. In fact, most of the Night Riders — Lene included — were more afraid of him.
So while Kent looked harmless like a kid, she knew better, and so she was forced to hesitate — past trauma and all.
However, hearing what Uncle Drew said, she gathered the courage and went for a hug. Obviously, she quickly became absorbed in the hug.
’Well, it does feel nice’
Kent just smiled while Uncle Drew shook his head. Among the 69 Night Riders, he was the only one who still saw Kent as a normal person.
The Ruthless person people knew in his eyes was a normal person. His mental fortitude is strong enough to see past ordinary things.
Maybe that was why he was their leader.
Suddenly, a thought appeared in his head, causing him to smile. When Kent saw the smile, his back broke into a cold sweat.
’Ah, what is with me feeling like somebody wanted me dead these past few days?’
He had been feeling chills down his spine the past couple of days. In his mind, he hadn’t offended anyone that deeply to warrant such feelings.
’I am probably overthinking things. I haven’t offended anyone... well, those I’ve offended don’t know my true identity.
Then again, Jest and Chaos had probably offended some monsters, and now, in a way, they are stirring to come for revenge.’
Kent shook his head, ’I am overthing here. I will be just fine as long as I am in the High Worlds’
With himself convinced, he decided to keep his focus on the moment. After breaking the hug with Lene, he turned to Avotha.
"Sorry, buddy, I only hug ladies. Vargus was an exception simply because I have a soft spot for brutes. In any case, how are you?"
Avotha, the abyss dragon, merely smiled and answered... "I’ve been well, Lord Kent. As you can see, I have become a demigod."
"I can see that," Kent smiled, a part of him feeling proud of the Abyss dragon he decided to spare back then. He came this close to killing him if not for Gaap’s intervention.
Avotha smiles also.
He is proud that he met Kent when he did. After meeting him, his life completely changed. Now, not only is he a demigod, but in the realm of demigods, not many can contend with him.
He had formed 9 Death Tattoos, each holding the power of a demigod. When all nine are unleashed, not even Bilad or Nyx could last a minute against him.
That was possible because of Kent.
He gave him the first two forms of the [Genesis Of Death] Technique.
The rest was his own hard work.
Kent turns to Lio and his brother Kaelen...
Seeing this, Uncle Drew spoke.
"The little one is Lio, and that is his brother Kaelen. We saved them when we returned from the underworld. Since they have nowhere to go at the moment, I let them stay here."
Kent nodded and walked toward them.𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶
"Welcome to the tower, Kaelen, Lio. I am Kent Madson, the owner of this place. And since you have nowhere to go, feel free to stay here."
Lio and his brother widened their eyes when they heard Kent’s name.
"Kent Madson?"
"Like the Kent Madson everyone had been looking for?"
"The one and only," Kent said with a smile.
He is already aware of his reputation and knows that all who hear his name will be shocked.

After all, while he didn’t place the Sword Dao Tablet in his eyes, the universe does, and the many people living in it most certainly would like to know more about the person whose name appeared on it.
"No need to look shocked, guys. I am just a simple dragon who loves to have fun."
They nodded promptly.
Kent smiles and summons Gaia.
"Gaia dear, kindly take them to Nature City and give them a nice residence and provide whatever they need."
Gaia nodded, but she turned and glared at Kent for a few more seconds, "You are still owing me precious tower points, big brother."
Kent smiles and ruffles her hair. "I will pay back soon. So give them what they need and put it on my tab."
Gaia smirked and left with Lio and Kaelen. Once they were gone, Kent focused his attention on the three Night Riders and the Abyss Dragon.

So give them what they need and put it on my tab."
Gaia smirked and left with Lio and Kaelen.
Once they were gone, Kent focused his attention on the three Night Riders and the Abyss Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1212: Impossible to Say
paragraphs: Uncle Drew quickly recaps to Kent on what transpired when he went to hell.

He started with his duel in which he soloed five true immortals. Of course, he led with that and even emphasised the one vs five part. After all, it is not every day a Death Stage Cultivator gets to fight and defeat five True Immortals.
Then he focused next on when he discovered that the Overlord of hell is also Night Rider. This discovery took Kent aback. He had met Laziel before when he was challenging the Hell Road.
Of course, back then, he felt nothing for him, unlike when he saw Lene and Vargus just now.

However, while that was the case, he most certainly didn’t expect a god to be one of his legion of Night Riders. This thing made him wonder just how many of his legions from past lives are now gods and even Supremes or Celestials.
’I mean, the Eternal Wrath Legion, all of them are immortals. So there is no telling just how many of them would be gods by now.’
With that in mind, Kent started to look forward to when he would meet the various legions he commanded in the past.
Uncle Drew added the rest of the details about his trip to hell. In a couple of minutes, he was done.
"Sounds like it was one hell of a trip. I mean, meeting your teammates sure felt nice, right?"

Uncle Drew smiled and nodded... "It was the best feeling. However, since I couldn’t bring all of them, I had to take only Lene and Vargus with me. They will help rescue your friend and handle other things you need help with."
Sounds like a plan to Kent. Kaelith, from what Uncle Drew said, had suffered enough. It was time to rescue him and punish those involved.
Just thinking about it made his blood boil.
So he let his emotions settle before focusing on the crucial points of Uncle Drew’s report.
"The Dark City, you said it still exists, huh?"
"Yes. Although it was destroyed after the Dark War, its ruins remain. However, aside from Night Riders, nobody else could enter. It takes one to hold absolute control over darkness to enter.

Laziel is the only one who can enter with relative ease and bring back the 12 Night Riders staying there. They thought the veil was thinning and feared the lock holding the Dark Creatures would break, releasing them.
However, the Dark Creatures are long dead. They were wiped out by Rakshasa many years ago."
Kent raised his brow.
He didn’t even have to think twice to believe all Uncle Drew said. He knew that if Uncle Drew said Neomi had wiped out the dark creatures, it was the truth.
Rakshasa was a legendary warrior. Before she wielded the spear, she was known as Shara, the mother of a killer. So her legend cannot be questioned.
Learning this, Kent became even more proud of his wife... ’I will reward her later.’
"It is good to learn that everything is settled. You guys did an amazing job, even if I have no memory of it. Once they are back, we will find something interesting for them to focus on."
Kent turns to Avotha next and said: "I promised you we would get revenge for your mother, and I still stand on that decision. However, for now, you must focus on other things.
We don’t know the extent of the Abyss Dragon’s power, so launching an attack now would be bad.
We also don’t know who should be handled. So for now, we can only bide our time and strike when we have all the details.

This means you should focus more on becoming stronger, and once I become an immortal, we can handle them. However, for now, our immediate mission is to wipe out those bastards who dare imprison my buddy."
Vargus’ eyes flared into flames, immediately raising the temperature in the garden... "Can’t wait to smash some brains to bits."
Of course, his enthusiasm may have caused the millions of people living in the tower cities to shudder.
"Hey, big guy, you are now living with mortals, so know when to release your demigod aura," Kent said, causing Vargus to smile and apologise... "Sorry."
"It is fine. Just take it easy when inside the tower."
He nods with a small smile. He, of course, is on the same wavelength as Kaizo, so battles are his favourite hobby. Hearing they would soon wipe out an entire family of immortals made him giddy.
"So what now?" Lene asked.

"Nothing much. I will be going to the homeworld of one of my wives. From there, I will move to a different planet to check a few things out." Kent paused for a moment and then added... "It turned out I was once known as the Faceless Assassin, so I am going back home to see if I can recover more of my memories."
They just let the information sink in. The idea that the handsome dragon standing before them was once a legendary assassin made them all look at him in a different light.
Of course, he is now nowhere close to his past selves. However, with how fast he was growing, it wouldn’t be long before the gods started running into hiding.
"How much do you know about your life when you were our master?" Lene suddenly asked.
Kent shook his head, "I know nothing of that life. And well, since there is Karma, you also cannot tell me. Until I start to remember myself, none of you can reveal or tell me anything."
They, of course, knew that, so they wouldn’t mess up their lives just because they couldn’t keep their mouths shut.
"Though I want to know. Was I cool and handsome back then?" Kent couldn’t help but ask. He had already met Chaos and Jaqen (Faceless) and knew he was one handsome bastard in both lives.
Of course, although he hadn’t met Jet in person yet, he saw his memories and knew that bastard was also good-looking.
So he was eager to know whether his other life was eye candy too.
Lene looked at Uncle Drew, who turned and looked at Vargus. The brute then turned to Lene. Seeing that she had no choice, she answered.
"Well, you were extremely handsome. However, about being cool, it depends on how you define cool."
Kent looked at her for a few seconds before he said:
"You know, like, did I have a lot of friends, women and admirers?"

Uncle Drew and Vargus turned away to hide their laughter, while Lene is left with a complicated expression on her face... She honestly didn’t know how to tell Kent he was the most hateful, dislikable and worst person ever to walk the face of the universe.
Lene had a few internal struggles, but in the end, she couldn’t bring herself to say what had to be said.
Instead, she asked a question, "How is the Veil Lady? I learnt she is called Nara now."
Of course, Kent knew something wasn’t right, but being asked about one of his wives, he quickly answered.

"She is fine. She is currently in seclusion, attending to something. Once she is done, she will come see you. However, Eryndor and Saden are in the Legion tower. Uncle Drew will take you there later."
In the end, Kent didn’t know what he was like in the past. But that was for the best. He would have to find out for himself.
Later, Uncle Drew gave him the items he’d asked him to get when he went to hell, along with Nyx’s gift.
Once everything was handled, they left for the legion tower while Kent went back to the Harem tower to hold the True Name awakening ritual for his new wives.

chapters.title: Chapter 1213: Veirynthia, The Mirror of Shattered Realms
paragraphs: After the intense sessions Kent had with his wives, most of them entered seclusion to break through to the Heavenly Ascension stage.
They had absorbed enough juice to break through. So they all entered.
The only ones left are those he had yet to awaken to their True Names. There is also Unity, Zaila and Selene, who were assigned by the rest of their sisters to stand in support for them.
So the moment Kent returned to the Harem Tower, they quickly surrounded him.
Enzi, Liora, Arien, Indie, Runa and Adina would be the ones getting True Names this time around.
Kent had already awakened close to two dozen True Names, so this wasn’t something new to him. However, he most certainly is looking forward to what will become of his women.
"Who would be going first?" he asked, and the ladies pointed at Enzi without any hesitation. Of course, she joined the harem much faster than they did, so it was only right that she go first.
They all wanted to see what became of the glass lady.
"Well then, looks like we have a winner," Kent gestured for Enzi to come to him. She did as she was told and walked into Kent’s waiting arms.
"Just relax and let the process flow naturally."
Enzi nodded.
Kent retrieved a True Name awakening token and activated it. Just then, the process began, aiming to awaken Enzi’s true self.
Most of the time, people say that walking the path that hasn’t been walked before is a waste of time. One cannot go against the rules already set by nature, they say.
Of course, there is a substance to what they say. After all, there are billions of examples to pick from. Many tried to walk their own path, only to hit unmovable and unbreakable walls in no time.
So even rises much higher only to stagnate in the end.
However, some went against the odds and prevailed.
A typical example was Lord Genesis. When there was no path, he carved his own and walked to the peak, where nobody had ever dared to reach before.
Thanks to him, many are now walking the path of swordsmanship with their shoulders held high.
And there are many others.
Aelvara Shardheart was one of them.
Before the Chaos Wars, the great Crystal Rift War was fought between the Crystal Angels and the Creatures of the Beyond.
Years before that battle, a young Crystal Angel decided to walk her own path when she was denied entry into the most prestigious Angel Sect.
She had the qualifications to join the sect; however, she lacked the background. Even if a genius, being born into the lower class and without solid backing, entering that sect was impossible.
So she was denied entry, something that broke her fragile heart.
So out of anger and the need to prove herself, so that one day she could look down on everyone, she embarked on a journey to create her own path.
And so soon she was gone. Nobody knew where she went or whether she was having any success on the path she had chosen.
Not that anybody cared for that. Since she chose to abandon the path the Crystal Angels threaded, she only had herself to blame for her failures.
In their eyes, she was of no importance. The legacy they built wasn’t one she could measure up to. So they didn’t mind her and even forgot she existed.
Years later, when the sky shattered and the Creatures of the Beyond arrived, the battle that forever defined the fate of the Crystal Angel began.
It was harrowing, dangerous and far beyond anything they expected. In no time, the battle entered a state of chaos, one where fighting crystal with crystal was impossible.
The Crystal Angels had an affinity for crystals, the same as the Creatures of the Beyond.
Unfortunately for them, while in the universe, their control over the crystal element was unmatched, but when against the Creatures of the Beyond, they were lacking.
So what could have been their most significant victory had become a threat that threatened to wipe them out, one destined to bury them beneath thick layers of crystal.
However, just when everything was turning upside down, reality suddenly turned to glass.
Legend spoke of the day the first shattering sound filled the air. They talked of reality bending, turning into pure glass and with every shatter, a creature of the Beyond died.
However, while one would expect to see blood everywhere, considering the creatures’ shattering, no blood was left behind. The only thing that remained was pure glass.
They called it the Night of the Shattered Reality, for on that day, the path never walked before was achieved by a young warrior who had long been forgotten.
She came back as she promised, and with her path as a Glass Manipulation, she proved to everyone she deserved entry into the Angel Sect.
When the Chaos War began, she led the Crystal Angels into battle, and with the help of other powerhouses, the war was won.
In that battle, she earned her True Name, a name that defined her true nature as one who transcended the limitations of her own race and created a path that had never existed before.
Her legend spread far and wide, empowering countless others to take the path that had never been walked before.
Kent and his wives raised their heads, looking at the figure in the air—each wearing a puzzled expression.
"Uh, is it just me, or is reality turning to glass?" Adina asked, looking at the countless glass boxes shifting and turning like a Rubik’s Cube.

"I know, right. Just looking at it is making my stomach turn weirdly. It is like countless realities are merging, shattering and reforming over and over again," Runa also observed, intensifying the weirdness everyone was feeling.
Liora narrowed her gaze at this sight, recalling something her master told her.

"My master once spoke of a warrior who fought during the Chaos War. She said from what she knew, that legendary warrior could permanently turn reality to glass. She even said she commanded one of the most dangerous domains in existence."
"Do you know the name..."
Before Liora could answer, the process began.
Kent stepped forward and started to speak.
"The path that had never been threaded before remains unthreaded simply because no one is brave enough to walk it.
She chose to walk it, and in the end, she created a legend. They called her the Crystalborne Sovereign, for she rose above and became a sovereign of her own kind.
They called her the Mistress of Shattered Realms for her duelling lines in the realm of the shattered mirrors, an existence with infinite reflections.
Many called her by many names, but the universe called Veirynthia, The Mirror of Shattered Realms.
Rise Veirynthia, and reclaim your destiny."
The moment Kent invoked her True Name, the sound of shattering glasses filled the air.
In an instant, Kent felt his body pulled into a realm where countless mirrors surrounded him from all sides. It was all too sudden for even him to react.
Suddenly, a voice that sounded like millions spoke it entered his mind.
"Aurelion Vaelros, glad to see you still draw breath...bastard"

chapters.title: Chapter 1214: Aelvara Shardheart
paragraphs: When the voice called, Kent felt something snap in him.
It was as if that voice had called him countless times before, and every time, he was annoyed by it. However, Kent, as much as he would love to say he recognised that voice, his mind was blank.
The voice was a reflection of itself, all jumbled together to form something new.
He looked up, and from one of the mirrors, Enzi flew out. However, while the previous Enzi was undoubtedly beautiful, this version of her was an angel—literally.
She had three pairs of angel wings made of glass, milky-white gold hair falling down her back, and a body that would cause gods to fall to their doom.𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂
However, while Enzi smiled at him, Kent saw right through it and knew she wasn’t the one in control of her body. The smile looked more twisted than it should be.
That, coupled with the fact that she called him ’bastard’, told him what he needed to know...She isn’t his Enzi.

"Aurelion Vaelros, you look much more dragon than before," the one in control of Enzi’s body said, her voice echoing millions of times, each echo making Kent want to smash his head against the countless mirrors.
The haunting effect of her voice started to get to him.

He narrowed his gaze at the person and asked in a concerned tone, "Possessing the body of my wife is not something I take kindly to. So maybe introduce yourself first before attempting to sound friendly."
The lady turned her head sideways, a squint appearing on her face. "Oh, so I am your wife now, huh. Finally, it seems I have managed to worm my way into your dark and twisted heart."
Kent narrowed his gaze even further, hearing what the lady said. "So you are Enzi’s past self."
"Duh."
Kent didn’t say anything. For some reason, he felt like he had been conspired against by Enzi, or at least her past self.
The way the lady spoke hinted that maybe she had tried very hard to fall in love with him, but he didn’t bulge. ’She did say she had found a way into my dark and twisted heart.’
Kent smirked, ’Maybe I was too good to fall in love with her back then.’
"Oh, please. You were mesmerised by my good looks back then. You only played hard to get simply because of those annoying twins. I wonder where they are now."
Kent didn’t reply to her on that. He had come to learn that ladies are as complex as a star enigma. Ignoring them is the best way to live with them.
She can read his mind, and so if he starts thinking about the unknown twins, she might get mad.
"Clearly, you didn’t travel through time and space to come tell me how I was too good to fall for a glass lady."
"Bastard," the lady narrowed her dangerous eyes at Kent.
She moved, and before Kent could react, she was standing right in front of him, a glass dagger held to his throat.
"Call me Glass Lady one more time and see what I will do to you."
"Chill, Glass Lady... I am your husband."
She pouted, but she couldn’t bring herself to cut him. Naturally, Kent had already anticipated that.
"Relax, lady. I know you are Enzi, but at the same time, not her. So why don’t we start with your name and why you called me here?"
She stared dangerously close at Kent before a smirk formed on her lips... "You are just too hateful. I wonder why I fell for you in the first place."
"Maybe because I was too good-looking and awesome."
"Oh, please. The Aurelion Vaelros I knew was a bastard, a playboy and one of the laziest people ever to walk the face of the universe. I wonder how you even got all those beasts to follow you."
Kent chuckled and took the lady’s hand. Then, in a somewhat soothing tone, he said:
"I get it. It is said, and it is heartbreaking, but sometimes you have to let go. You tried to fall in love with me, but you weren’t good enough to move my heart.
However, while I may have broken your glass heart into countless pieces, that isn’t enough reason to paint me black. Don’t let your hatred for me compel you to speak ill of my majestic self.
I know myself, and I know I was an awesome, extremely handsome and hardworking person. You don’t have to look down on me simply because I have yet to recall who I was."

"Oh, please," she smirked and then added, "You were a piece of shit who only knows how to play with the hearts of women and dump them. I admit I was young and stupid for falling for you. However, when I found out who you truly are, I blame myself.
I wanted you dead for a while, you know....I still do."

Then a smile appeared on her face. "Though I have to admit, you were intelligent back then. When I met you, I was on the verge of giving up on the glass path, but you took me in and helped me reach my goal.
Perhaps that was the reason why I never hunted you down like the other ladies you toyed with."

The smile then turned into a grin. "But I sure would love to see what will become of you when they find you. Many would have long become gods, Aurelion Vaelros. They will come for you, and I would very much enjoy seeing you suffer."

Kent smirked. "I now see why I didn’t let you in. You are just too wicked to become my lover." Kent looked at her closely and added, "The only reason why a wife will love seeing their husband suffer is if she is wicked herself."
"I am not wicked, Aurelion Vaelros, but I would enjoy seeing you suffer when they come. Wash your neck, Aurelion Vaelros. They are much closer than you think"
"They won’t because I am no longer the person you knew. I am now the Chaos Dragon, so joke’s on you."
The lady laughed out loud, causing the many glasses to reflect her voice... "Keep telling yourself that. You already said that destiny has a way of playing ball with you.
Perhaps, this time, she will score you seven to nil. And yes, that is the total number of heartbreaks you alone had caused innocent women, you hateful playboy bastard."
She flew back and laughed again... "I am Aelvara Shardheart, your first and only disciple. But I guess I am now your wife, so take care of me because if you don’t... hehe."
Suddenly, a light flickered in Enzi’s eye, and the air cleared.
"Kent," Enzi called out, and Kent instantly knew his glass lady was back.
"I feel violated in my own body," Enzi said. Kent tried to speak, but he forced himself to rethink his words.
In the end, he said the ones that came to mind, "Don’t worry, love. It was just some crazy lady who couldn’t handle her heartbreak, so she came throwing a tantrum."
He opened his arms, and Enzi flew straight in. "Glad you are back," Kent said.
"Me too," Enzi also said. However, an evil grin appeared on her face.
’Oh, so I am now a crazy lady, huh?’
Obviously, the Primordial Chaos Dragon had just recorded his first Yandere, one who had some unresolved anger issues.

chapters.title: Chapter 1215: Jade Void Wings
paragraphs: Kent didn’t know which of his past lives had angered Enzi so much that she went against the cycle of reincarnation just to meet him today and express her frustration.
In fact, he had absolutely no idea what kind of pain could evoke such a reaction in a person.
That was, in fact, just too much for him to understand.
In his mind, none of what had happened was normal, and it most certainly wasn’t worth the effort.
I mean, to travel across the cycle of reincarnation to throw a tantrum isn’t at all normal. There isn’t any pain that should make a person sacrifice so much just to throw tantrums.
’Unless...?’ Something suddenly clicked in Kent’s mind, causing his back to break into a cold sweat. He pulls away from Enzi and looks at her dangerously close.
Seeing how Kent was looking at her, she also narrowed her eyes and asked, "Why are you looking at me like you want to swallow me?"
"Are you alright?" Kent asked, a little worried about Enzi and a lot more wary of her.
"Why won’t I be well? I have just gained a True Name and awakened my glass domain. If anything, I am more than fine." She paused and suddenly asked, "Are you alright, though? You seem a little pale."
"N-Nothing. I am perfectly fine," Kent hugged her again, but his suspicion wasn’t satiated just yet. A part of him thinks Enzi isn’t telling him everything.
Although she wouldn’t betray him or plot against him, he most certainly felt like she wasn’t the same Enzi he knew. Of course, she had become who she is meant to be.
She is now an Angel, she has awakened her true glass domain — Shattered Realm — and even seems to have awakened some powerful bloodline abilities that will grow with her.
If anything, she is now happier, well and safer than ever.

However, a part of him still thinks Aelvara Shardheart is hiding in there somewhere. Although she was Enzi’s past self, and that she would eventually remember that part of her, just from the way Aelvara spoke, Kent knew something wasn’t right.
She wouldn’t send a part of her consciousness to the future just to throw a tantrum. If anything, it seems she did everything for Enzi, and that alone is scary.
’Maybe I am just overthinking things.’ Kent chose to force everything back in his mind and instead focus on the present and how best to live a good life.
Enzi is in no way going to betray him. None of his wives will, for they love him more than anything to betray him. However, there are more ways to make him regret his life choice.
’First, it was Lene who dodged the question about my life when I was the master of the Night Riders. Now, it seems I was a bastard who toyed with the hearts of women.’
He smiled weakly...’I thought Chaos was a bastard, but it seems I was wrong. Now, I can’t help but wonder just what kind of person I was in all 13 lives.
’Was I a villain somewhere along the line?’
Enzi smiled, ’So you lived 13 lives, huh. Good to know then. I will share it with my sisters.’
Since they are still inside the Shattered Realm, everything Kent thinks of, she can hear. And so she learned something her sisters had been wondering about.
This made her happy, but the crazy look in her eyes said it all. She is not the same Enzi Kent knew.
The current her is far more complex than she was before.
After a few minutes just resting in each other’s arms, Kent broke the hug and took a better look at Enzi... "You are now a peak Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator. Congratulations."

"Thank you," Enzi responded. She was a Peak Spirit Lord before the True Name Awakening. Now, she had jumped to the peak of a High World, ready to become an immortal the moment Kent Ascends to an Immortal world.
She turned toward one section of the mirrors and made a grabbing motion. A door opened in that section, revealing an endless expanse of glass.𝘧𝓇ℯ𝑒𝓌𝑒𝑏𝓃𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘭.𝒸ℴ𝓂
From within, three pairs of glass-metallic wings appeared and flew toward her.
Kent raised his brow, watching the wings move through the air. ’These wings, the vibration, it feels so familiar,’ Kent thought, causing Enzi to smile.
"This is the Jade Void Wings. I have no idea where it came from, but I know it was meant for you. I also have no idea how to fuse with it, but I know you will figure something out."
She gestured, and the wings flew toward Kent. When they got close, the tower quickly stored them for Kent.
"Thank you."
Enzi moved toward Kent and kissed him. Then she waved her hand, and the Shattered Realm started to disperse. Down below, her sisters looked stunned, gazing at the crystal beauty hovering in the air.
She has human flesh, but the attire and wings behind her are crystal (glasslike). Aside from that, the aura around her is profound, much more potent than a normal Heavenly Ascension stage expert.
She is now a tall, thick beauty, so beautiful that angels will even admire her. She had undergone a complete makeover, earning a body that Kent would love to see naked all day, every day.
When they landed, the rest of her sisters surrounded her and began examining her.
It was something they always do whenever they awaken their True Names.
"You have become gorgeous, Enzi," Liora said, brushing her hand through Enzi’s hair. She turned and looked at her friend and smiled,
"It is your turn next. Let’s see what kind of shadow beauty you become then."
Liora smiled.
It is indeed her turn next.
Although she is nervous, she is also prepared to become who she was meant to be.
Having a True Name is something not many can boast about. The only time a person gets a True Name is when they do something that impresses the universe.
So having one was an honour they are proud of. Now, when they are in trouble, just invoking their True Names will give them some assistance from the universe.
All these women in Kent’s life had, in one way or another, done something super great in their past lives, and so they earned their True Names.
Even Lani, who was a menace back in the day, ended up receiving a True Name when she chose to be selfless and think of others instead of herself for once.
So in a way, Liora was just nervous about what she would become. She is already aware that once she gets a True Name, she will start recalling her past life, and that, in a way, scares her.
"No need to be nervous, Liora. Regardless of who you turned out to be, I will not stop loving you. So lighten up, and let’s see what kind of badass you were in your past life."
Kent managed to calm her beating heart down.

"Kent is right. Relax and let greatness find you. Trust me, I am happier than I was before," Enzi encouraged her friend, too. The two of them share a great bond and have been best friends for many years.
Liora nodded to Enzi’s words. She turned to Kent and said, "I am ready."
He retrieved a True Name awakening token and activated it. The next second, Liora was enveloped in absolute darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1216: Vae Mortis - She who Walks Between Shadow and Death
paragraphs: Long before the war that ended the Chaos Era, when the underworld was in chaos, when hell had turned upside down, the one meant to bring order was just a quiet child born to a family of healers.
Vel’Zai was a quiet child, the kind that every mother would want their daughters to be like in times of great peril and chaos.
However, Vel’Zai was not loved like one would have expected. If anything, she was hated the most.
As a child born into the family of healers, awakening the power of death and shadows made her an outsider in her own family.
Her powers were to take and not to give. So she was shunned by her parents, siblings, and other family members, unaware that her destiny was much bigger than they could fathom.
Sometimes, to save the universe, one had to kill instead of heal. As they say, there are different types of healing. Her own was to use killing to heal it.
Instead of using precious energy to heal what is already rotten, cutting it down will be a much better solution.
However, no matter how hard she tried, she could never fit in. So with no other choice left, she decided to leave and never return.
She realised her path was not in her family, so she might as well seek her destiny elsewhere.
She journeyed to the farthest reach of the universe in search of her own destiny.
Of course, she planned to live a quiet life. However, with chaos everywhere, she had no choice but to walk the path she was born to walk.
Years later, the Chaos Reaper Assassin appeared in the universe.
Legends speak of her insidious nature as one of the most beautiful yet dangerous assassins to ever walk the face of the universe.
Her legacy was measured against the mother of assassins.
They said she comes with shadows and leaves with death.
Immortals and gods fell to her dagger.

In the hidden records, an account of the death marks was said to originate from her. They said that along the way, the universe made her their weapon, just as they did long before the primordial era, when they weaponised the Poison Queen.
Vel’Zai became their weapon, and all who they marked were killed by her, no matter how well they hid themselves.
Legend even speaks of her as the second coming of the Faceless Assassin, for she gets the job done, no matter how dangerous and stacked the odds are.
However, one day she vanished and wasn’t heard from for thousands of years. It got to the point that her name started to vanish from everyone’s mind.
However, when the Chaos Beast arrived, and the powerhouses rose to the occasion, Vel’Zai appeared and fought the harrowing battle with them.
In the end, nobody knew what happened to her. She just vanished, and with her, the legend of the Chaos Reaper Assassin died.
However, the universe didn’t want her to die just like that. They needed their weapon to rise again and continue her good work.
So they gave her a True Name, and that name is now about to be called. This time, they want her to rise as the Veil Assassin, for her death, darkness is needed again.
Kent and his wives stood back. The darkness swirling around Liora is not simple at all. In fact, they all can tell that just being touched by this darkness will consume their life like a hungry lion.
So to be on the safe side, they moved further back.

"When Kent awakened Vari and Lani’s True Name, only shadows were manifested. They were assassins, but they awakened shadows. So why is Liora manifesting darkness?" Unity asked, looking at the thick darkness surrounding Liora.
None of them could see what was happening within the darkness, for it was impenetrable. However, they knew something big was happening within the mist of darkness.
"I don’t know what is happening within the darkness, but I do know Liora will be coming out a completely different person," Adina muttered.
Enzi smiled evilly and replied, "You have no idea."
Just then, the moment for Kent to invoke her True Name came, so he stepped forward. When he was much closer to the darkness, he started to speak.
"She Who Walks Between Shadow and Death. The blade that shaped the ending of a beautiful era. You answered when called and fought through the thick and thin."
Kent paused, feeling a chill run down his spine. He turned and looked at Enzi, who smiled and winked at him. This sight made him super alert; however, he had to continue.

"You were once the blade of the universe. They gave you a mission, a purpose, and you accomplished it as it should be. So they gave you a name, a beautiful name that would give you back what they owe you, for you deserve to be paid.
Rise, Vae Mortis, your life has just begun."
"Huh"
Just when Kent invoked the name, the darkness expanded and enveloped him.
Far in the distance, Enzi smirked and muttered under her breath... "Punk."
Her sisters didn’t hear her because they were busy wondering what had just happened to their man. One minute, he was invoking Liora’s True Name; the next, he was swallowed by Death’s darkness.
If not because a similar thing happened when he awakened Enzi’s True Name, or that Unity and the others had already been through this before, they would have long run into the darkness.
However, aside from panicked expressions, they seemed okay.
[Inside the Darkness]
Kent, who was suddenly pulled into the darkness, expected to appear in a pitch-black space.

However, while the environment was dull and dark, what greeted him was a sight he never expected to see in his life. Naturally, the same coldness he had been feeling of late struck him, causing him to pause and hesitate.

Just like with Enzi, the lady sitting on a dark throne made of bones with a dark, dangerous look in her eyes, and an eagle standing on the armrest of the throne is Liora, but at the same time, not her.
She crossed her long, slender legs, using one hand to support her chin.
Just when Kent halted his steps, the eagle opened its wings as if it were trying to lunge at him. However, the lady brushed her body, calming her down, before looking at Kent.
"You look very different in this life, Aurelion Vaelros." She smiled, causing Kent to swallow his breath and narrow his gaze at her.
"Let me guess, I broke your heart, too, and now you are here to throw a tantrum."

"Wow. Slow down, Aurelion Vaelros — no need to point fingers where they are not needed." The smile on the lady’s face told Kent something else. She isn’t smiling to please him. The smile, if anything, contains so much darkness.
Kent blinked a few times and asked, "So are you saying you are not here because I did something bad to you?"
"Oh, you deserve to die for what you did to me. However, I am not here to throw a tantrum. I am much bigger than that. I am just here to examine if you are worth saving from what is coming to you..."
She grinned and stood up.
Then, in graceful yet silent steps, she approached Kent. Her slender fingers moved across Kent’s face and slowly moved across his chest before stopping at his dick.
"Hmmm."

chapters.title: Chapter 1217: Dangerous Obsession
paragraphs: Yet again, Kent had found himself in a situation he could not make sense of.
He knew he had lived many lives; that much he is aware of.
However, he has no idea the kind of life he lived in those many lives. This means all the mistakes he made in those lives were something he had no idea about.
However, those mistakes somehow found their way back to him.
Talk about one’s past catching up to them. His past had indeed caught up to him.

First was Enzi, who, from what she said, turned out to have fallen in love with Kent’s past that she referred to as Aurelion Vaelros. From the little she said, this Aurelion was some kind of Beast Master.
However, while she fell in love with him, Aurelion Vaelros didn’t, which left her feeling used.
Obviously, that shouldn’t have been the only situation that led her to travel across the cycle of reincarnation to throw a tantrum.
However, now that he is looking at Liora’s past self, who is here for the same reason, he feels like things aren’t as simple as they seem.
There is something else afoot.
Vel’Zai let go of his dick and licked her lips... "So far so good, you seem to have what it takes to make things up to me — that is, if you haven’t already."
She winked seductively at Kent.
The sight caused his heartbeat to quicken for a moment.
Kent cleared his throat and asked a very important question... "Can you tell me what I did wrong to you or anyone? Make me understand"
There was no arrogance or threat in his tone. He genuinely wants to know just what the hell was going on. If it were once, he would have brushed it aside.
However, this is the second time it has happened, and from a woman he loves too... That didn’t seem right to him, and so he wanted to know.

Vel’Zai looked at his expression for a few seconds before a chuckle escaped her mouth... "And why would I do that?" she asked... "I mean, you had hurt me so much that I became too bitter to be around anyone.
So I had to go into seclusion and meditate for 35,000 years. Do you know how long and lonely that was? So why would I tell you anything? You deserve to go through what I went through"

Kent became calm for a moment before he replied, "Obviously, you wouldn’t want your husband’s attention to be divided, which I don’t know if you are aware, but that will be dangerous for me. Especially now that I am about to embark on a dangerous mission"
Liora didn’t say anything. She walked back to her throne and sat down. The emotional manipulation tactic Kent used seems to have reached her dark heart.
Using Elina to stir the conversation in his favour seems to have worked.
"Isn’t it ironic. I was so obsessed with you simply because you made me fall in love with you. But when we were meant to be happy, you ran away without a word.
I tried to find you, but later learned that getting to you would be extremely hard because you were one of the most dangerous people in the universe back then.
Even so, I tried very hard to get your attention. But no matter how hard I tried, I never even came close to making you see me.
Eventually, I became depressed and decided to isolate myself from society simply to save them from me. Then one day, I learned I wasn’t the only victim of your sneakiness.
It turned out that while I was obsessed with you, you were somewhere else, playing games with other women. Then, when you were satisfied, you ran away from them, too.
Naturally, that obsession turned into an intent to kill." She smiled weakly, "But in the end, getting to you was impossible, so here we are."
She chuckled... "Very ironic, isn’t it? Now, I now have your attention, but you didn’t even know what you did to me... to us."
Kent remained still, unsure of what to even say.
From what Vel’Zai just said, it seems he, at some point in time, crossed paths with her and others. However, he left and never returned.
Obviously, from the way she spoke, it felt like the time he spent with them, while maybe he had seen it as casual, they saw it differently, and so they started obsessing over him.
Kent didn’t know what kind of person he was, but he knew he wouldn’t use someone and dump them. Kent could feel it deep in his bones. He wasnt that kind of person.
This then left him with only one question.
Did they fall in love with him one-sidedly?
’I mean, that couldn’t be the case, right?’
If so, then just what kind of person was he to make a damsel like Enzi and Liora fall in love all the way just from spending time with him?
Kent most certainly didn’t have an answer to that.
However, if that’s the reason he’s been feeling those chilling sensations lately, then he most certainly needs to sit them down and give them a crash course on what falling in love is.
Obviously, falling one-sidedly in love is not something practical at all.

Perhaps he may have only flirted with them, which he meant to be harmless. However, in the end, they might have interpreted it as love, and perhaps when he left, which he had every right to, they saw it as a betrayal.
’Ah, what a headache... being handsome and awesome sure has its side effects.’

Kent studied Vel’Zai for a while, making sure that when he speaks, his words will resonate with her. However, even after five minutes, he didn’t know what to say, so he asked for a different proposal, one that would make him and everyone happy.
"First of all, I will apologise for the pain I caused you...I am sorry. However, since I have no memory of what I did to you, resolving it by making promises would just be me saving my skin.
So how about this... Before you and your team make my life miserable, why don’t you first wait for me to recover my memories?
Once I get back my memories and know what happened, I will take responsibility for my actions in their entirety. Punishing me while I have no idea what I did wrong isn’t fair, and you know that."
Vel’Zai studied him for a few minutes, unsure of what to say. What Kent said did make sense. It was just that she was too hurt to accept this.
However, she isn’t an unreasonable person.
A part of her knew things were much more difficult than they seemed, so she nodded in the end. However, she had a stern warning for him.
"You may have played with my heart in the past, Aurelion Vaelros, but if you dare try it again this time around, I will kill you for sure."
"I do not doubt that."
"Great," she waved her hand, and the darkness started to clear.
"I will talk to Crystal, so don’t worry about her for the time being. However, better watch your back... She tends to trap people who hurt her in her Shattered Realm."
Kent raised his brow... "So she still has her memories, huh?"𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢
"I have no comment," Vel’Zai smiled, and then she blinked a few times. Liora was finally back, but the smile on her face told him she remembered everything.

paragraphs: When the darkness cleared, Liora stood up calmly.

The bone throne transformed into three pairs of wings and merged with her, spreading behind her. In an instant, the air around her thickened and grew even more sinister. The feathers are bone-like and sharper than daggers.
The eagle also transformed into a pentagon-shaped gem and merged with her forehead. It is purple in colour and holds so much death energy that a human should not have.
Not that Liora is exactly human at the moment.

On the outside, she is a human, but at her core, she has been transformed, or more accurately enhanced, by the primordial shadow essence that once belonged to the umbral race during the primordial era.
This infusion created a new bloodline that merged her human side with the umbral, making her a new race called Nyxblood Human.
She is probably one of her kind.
Her bloodline affinity is shadow and death. Back then, she had reached a stage where Death even had to answer to her. Shadows bend to her will.

The True Name awakening had now transformed her, making her who she is meant to be. Her features are much sharper than before, and this time around, she seems to hold some coldness in her eyes even when smiling.

Of course, Kent had already discovered she had memories of her life as Vel’Zai, so that was a factor. Of course, she had yet to get back all her memories. But what she had now was enough to teach her how to handle the abilities he had awakened.
And within those little memories she has now, it seems Kent had hurt her somehow.
Not that he had anything to worry about. It was just that he felt troubled that the life he had led had caused damsels to endure so much pain from heartbreak.
The current him will never do that. The current him is more interested in making people happy, so he would never cause a woman to be heartbroken enough to hold a grudge across space and time.
’I need to know more about that life and fix things before they escalate.’
One downside of having many incarnations is that the grudges from that life always find their way back to you.
Enzi did say there are seven of them. He had no idea where the other five were, but he knew he would be finding out soon.
Once she got close to him, Liora jumped into his arms and started kissing him deeply.
"What a bitch," Enzi smirked, feeling annoyed that what she envisioned didn’t happen.
However, while she would have loved to see Kent being chased around by Liora, she didn’t mind seeing them kissing instead.
She is already content with the life she has now, so she wouldn’t hold on to the past that was full of pain and heartbreak.
They now have a fresh start, so they all want to focus on making something good of it.
After taking her precious time to get acquainted with Kent’s lips, Liora pulled away and looked at Kent closely.
"This is not over."

Kent smiled and dragged her toward him by the waist... "Not by a long shot. I have to make up for old time’s sake" He kissed her again and said, "But for now, let the rest of your sisters have their own awakening before we get down to it."
She nodded, and hand in hand, they walked toward the rest of his wives.
As expected, they quickly surrounded Liora and started examining her body as if looking for something wrong. However, after a full minute, they saw nothing.
"How do you feel?" Selene asked, holding Liora’s left hand while Elsa held her right.
"I feel complete."
Her sisters smiled, hearing her reply.
They didn’t want to jinx it, but after their True Name awakening moments, they all felt like a part of them that had eluded them for long had finally merged back with them, making them whole again.
It is the best feeling, actually.
Kent turned to Arien, who is next on the awakening list.
Her seven fluffy tails billowed in the air behind her as she walked toward Kent. Because of the awakening, and since Adina and Runa are with them, they chose to put on pants and a bra.
Of course, they will take it off the first chance they get.
However, her boobs are barely contained in her bra, causing them to bounce as she walks toward him.
She walked straight into his arms, pressing her soft and firm boobs against his chest. Kent smiled cutely and kissed her before taking out a True Name awakening token.
"Before we start, I have something to tell you," Arien suddenly said, making Kent pause the activation.
"Go ahead, I am listening."
Arien nodded and started to speak:

"Before my grandma died, she said a very long time ago, on one of her trips to a Supreme High World, a diviner told her a member of her family would possess spatial abilities instead of the illusion we foxkins are known for.

Of course, having the ability to manipulate space sounds like a good thing. However, she said the diviner told her that awakening such powers would bring a curse on me that if I don’t break it before growing my 9th tail, I will die.
So I guess I am scared this awakening will trigger this curse. She said she had researched what the diviner said and found that he hadn’t deceived her.
All foxkin who awakened other abilities instead of illusion didn’t live long."
Kent smiled and cupped Arien’s cheeks... "Have you met Alina?" Kent asked.
Arien nodded.
"You see. When I met her, she was only a manager at an auction house. She was broken and bitter from a past encounter with a now-dead scum.
Back then, before the incident, she only wanted to become a formation expert. However, due to the evil of men, she couldn’t pursue that career.
So we changed her fate, making her one of the greatest formation and array experts in the universe..." Kent smiled and added, "Yes, the entire universe."
"Do you know how that was possible?"
Arien shook her head.
"It is simple, actually. The reason why her fate changed was because of her True Name." Kent smiled, feeling some sense of pride.
"For some reason that I have absolutely no idea how, every last lady I fall in love with was once a legendary figure. Every last one.𝑓𝑟𝑒𝘦𝓌𝑒𝑏𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝘭.𝒸𝘰𝑚
So while Alina wouldn’t have even been looked at twice if she had tried to join a formation sect, after her True Name awakening, sects would have been the ones chasing after her.
Her True Name changed everything about her.

So I guess what I am trying to say is that she was once a legendary figure who played a key role in the safety of the universe and earned a True Name, and that True Name gave her a new and wonderful life.
This means True Names bring out the good in people, not the bad.
I fell for you wholeheartedly. This means you were also a legend back in the day, and as such, the fact that the True Name token had activated says all there is to say."
Kent pricked Arien’s finger and dropped her blood on the True Name awakening token... "Relax and let the process flow freely."
Arien nodded, feeling slightly better. The next second, she was lifted into the air.

So the next best thing for them was to leave and go spend some time in the Love Pool while the rest of their sisters had their fun with Kent.
They did, and that solved most of their problems.
Naturally, Kent had learned some tricks from his bag of sex tricks, and so now, he can release his dragon juice every 30 minutes, a much bigger improvement compared to a few weeks back.
This allowed him to alternate between his women several times before they finally had enough. In the end, they each had their fill of the dragon juice.
"One day, you ladies are going to suck me to my death."
Kent said, watching the beautiful faces of his women, each licking their lips from the delicacy they had tasted over the past couple of hours.
"Then you better be prepared because even in death, we will follow you and continue where we left off," Selene said with a giggle.
The rest of her sisters also smiled.
They can’t live without the dragon juice. If possible, they want to have it every morning when they wake up and at night before going to bed.
"I wonder what he will taste like when he dies," Arien wondered, genuinely looking like she wanted to find out. This expression caused her sisters to laugh.
Indie chuckled and grabbed Kent’s hand, "I prefer him alive and full of energy."
"Me too," Unity seconded, and the rest followed.
"Well, if there is any consolation, know that I am not going anywhere. There are a lot of ladies waiting for me to make happy, so relax, girls, there is more fun to be had."
They smiled and nodded.
Soon, they are ready to continue with the True Name Awakening ritual.

"Finally... some peace." Adina and Runa appeared the next second after Unity had called them. Seeing their man is done making their sisters happy, they also felt relief. At least their torture is finally over.
Kent planted a kiss on their foreheads and hugged them... "It will just be between the three of us. Once we can take the next step, I will go one full year with you both."
"Really?"
"Yes. I owe you two too much, so prepare for a year of sex. It is going to be a wild adventure for sure."
Adina and Runa nodded with innocent expressions despite being promised a year of sex. The rest of her sisters are happy for them. They can’t wait for them to take the next step, too.
Kent turned to Indie next... "I believe you are next on the list."
She nodded, and soon, the True Name Awakening token was activated, signalling the awakening of yet another True Name.
This time, it is another assassin whose past was wild.
To this day, nobody knows who killed General Jax - one of the powerhouses who led the Void Beasts during the Great War.
His death caused a chain of events that tilted the war in favour of the Great Army led by the Primordial Chaos Dragon. However, the one who killed him was never known.𝕗𝚛𝚎𝚎𝐰𝗲𝗯𝗻𝚘𝚟𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝕞
During the Primordial Era, when the threat of the Void Beasts reached the powerhouses, many began seeking ways to transcend the confines of this known universe to save their skin.
Nobody wants to die fighting creatures powerful enough to make even the Chaos Dragon enter a million-year seclusion to prepare.
So when they came, and the battle entered a dangerous phase, many betrayed their fellow warriors and truly transcended — one of the reasons the Primordial Era was destroyed.
Before the Great War, the universe selected 14 warriors and made them Universe Guardians, tasked with defending the universe.
However, when it came time to fight, because they feared dying, they ran and left the universe to fend for itself.
Legends speak of the moment the Chaos Dragon alone couldn’t contain the seven Dreadful Void Generals that were leading the Void Beast.
They said just one of those generals was enough of a threat to put them on the same scale as the Chaos Dragon or even higher.
They were Calamity rank Beasts.
So one of them slipping away from the Chaos Dragon and going after his teammates was a disaster. Many died, and this gave many the push to run as well.
So in no time, those the Chaos Dragon trusted betrayed him and, in doing so, betrayed their Universe.

However, the dreadful general couldn’t rampage for long. It was said that when his threat was reaching the breaking point, he suddenly stopped moving, and after a wind blew over him, his body slowly fell with a thud.
It was one of the greatest mysteries of the Great War and also the first spark that told the Chaos Dragon that the war could be won.
He had no idea who killed that general, but that kill gave them hope.
Of course, if any of them were told the one responsible was the legendary Underworld Queen, Indira, they probably wouldn’t have believed it.
Indira was an assassin who even the Chaos Dragon dared not antagonise.

It wasn’t that he was afraid of her; it was more like he didn’t want to invoke the wrath of the underworld. Be as it may, one of the most significant supports during the harrowing moments of the universe came from the underworld.
However, in that battle, no one saw Indira, and no one cared.
In their minds, she wasn’t even qualified to join such a noble cause.
As someone born into a life of crime, her core personality is that of a scum to society. She was a master thief, a great criminal, and the queen of manipulation.
Her assassin side was something she goes by. However, if the Primordial Era were this modern era, they would have said she had an IQ of over a million points.
She is brilliant, and although she was a criminal, nobody dares challenge her.
The first time she met the Chaos Dragon, she had stolen something from him, and so it turned into a cat-and-mouse game that lasted 20 years.
When Chaos finally caught her, he locked her in the underworld, only for her to work her way to becoming the queen there.
Under her rule, the underworld became a force to reckon with.
In the end, she came through for Chaos and, in the process, became worthy to receive a True Name that documented her achievements and rewarded her in the new life the universe gave her.
To many, if there are still records, her legacy was one of crime and mischief. They never placed her in their eyes for she was indeed a insidious fellow, one who made many fear for their lives.
But to the universe that witnessed her bravery and intelligence during the chilling moments of the Great War, they gave her a name befitting her character.
Today, that name will be called again... only that this time, instead of hiding in the shadows, she will step into the light where fate wants her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1222: The Empress Has Risen
paragraphs: "Even in her last moment, everybody saw her as a criminal, a delinquent of society. However, the universe saw her as worthy of a name that is only hers.
They called her Nyx’Indirra Felis Umbrae - She Who Is Born of Claw and Shadow. Her legend is written in the Underworld Diary, and her authority is supreme to all.
Rise Nyx’Indirra Felis Umbraem, your rule had just begun."
Kent invoked Indie’s True Name, causing the entire Harem Tower to shake.
The sky split, and from within, an ethereal beauty stepped out, each step shattering the void. The air around her is thick with Malice.
Kent was frozen in place as he watched Indie catwalk toward him, her shape swaying from side to side.
GULP
Kent gulped, his breath coming out ragged as Indie stopped before him, and with her catlike nature, she stretched her slender hand and placed it on his shoulder.
Her voluptuous body moved and hugged Kent before locking lips with him. Their kiss quickly turned intense, prompting the other ladies watching to chuckle.
They have all done, and will be doing, what Indie is doing. However, there is just something about this Cat that is making them feel uneasy.
"This cat is almost on the same level as Alina now," Unity said, clearly jealous of the heaviness behind Indie.
"True. I propose we separate the two of them from ever having Kent to themselves. Who knows what they will do with those butts?" Arien proposed, and the rest of her sisters nodded.
"Even though we are yet to cross the extra mile with Kent, we second what Arien suggested. Alina and Indie together is a disaster we cannot allow to happen."
"Then it is decided. Indie and Alina are officially not worthy to be paired ever."
Indie had no idea she had just become a threat to her sisters. To her, having Kent’s tongue in her mouth was all she needed at the moment.
[The Underworld]

While the living saw the underworld as a dreadful place, those who live there are much happier with their dwelling. Of course, they would be thrilled to come back to the land of the living, where most of them came from.
However, that is just not possible.
So they do their best to make a life for themselves, or else their suffering will never end.
Of course, with the Underworld Kings and Queens keeping order, they have a thriving society down there.
So one can only wonder and even panic when, out of nowhere, the entire 13 levels of the underworld would start shaking like a massage chair.

Every last underworld being stopped whatever they were doing, lifted their heads and started gazing at the dull sky. From the heavens, a large mansion made purely out of gold and jade diamonds appeared, surrounded by a dome.
The moment it appeared, a supreme authority descended on all 13 levels of hell. The under Kings and Queens felt it. The force was one they could not go against.

However, even with the chilling nature of the force, Millions still rushed toward it the moment it appeared. However, even the strongest of them, being the demigods, couldn’t even get within 100 km of it.
The Underworld God even appeared, his shoulders held high. However, even with his strength and authority over the underworld, he couldn’t come close to the dome.
It was like he had no authority there again.
This occurrence plunged the universe into chaos. Many started panicking, and those who sought to destroy started causing chaos everywhere.
However, just when things were about to get out of hand, three ladies, each with cultivation bases that cannot be fathomed, appeared from the mansion, instantly calming every living soul.
"You will maintain law and order, for the Empress has risen, and she will be ruling the underworld again. All those who fall out of line will be executed without any chance of ever reincarnating."
The words were arrogant and commanding; however, not even the Underworld God dared question them. They could only nod their heads and watch the three ladies teleport away.
Inside Nyx’s meeting hall, the seven underworld elders under her command gathered to hold an urgent meeting.
She folded her hands on her chest, her expression calm, yet one could see the worry in them.
"What did you find, Offin?" she asked, directing her question to an elder holding a tattered book. The cover of the book is worn, indicating it has been in use for a very long time.
Offin, also a demigod, raised his head and started to speak...

"This is a small copy of the Underworld Diary. It was written by a legendary figure who lived during the Divine Era. The records state that during the Primordial Era, the underworld indeed had a Queen.
However, that was before the fracture, resulting in the underworld becoming a 13-level kingdom ruled by Underworld Kings and Queens.

I don’t know much about her, but I learnt that under her rule, the underworld was one of the most powerful kingdoms in the universe... even the legendary Chaos Dragon personally came here to acknowledge her rule.
However, she vanished during the Great War, never to be heard from again.
The name recorded here is Indira."
Nyx blinked a few times, processing the info dump that Offin had offloaded on her. The idea that there was once an Underworld Queen who ruled all over the underworld baffled her.
As long as she could remember, there were 12 underworld queens and kings with an Underworld God ruling over everything. There had never been a Queen who dominated everything.
"It says in the diary that she was a queen. Why did the two ladies call her an Empress?" Orlando, one of the elders, a bald fellow with wickedness in his eyes, asked.
"I guess they saw the underworld now has 13 different kingdoms, so they wanted to make it plain she is now the Empress, and there is no denying her authority."
The elders nodded, each feeling like the underworld would soon undergo a qualitative change.

"The underworld would soon change," Nyx stated with a calm expression. "However, as to whether this change will impact us negatively, I don’t know. But we can only hope this Underworld Empress will be someone we can relate to. This means we’d better stay on her good side."
The elders looked at each other, and then Matalo asked, "Does that mean we are not attending the Underworld Assembly?"
After the mansion appeared and the announcement was made, the Underworld God called an assembly to address the change.
"It is evident that the bastard wants to rebel. With the arrival of this new authority, his position as the overlord is threatened, so he wants to get ahead of it.
I, on the other hand, have no plans on going against an Underworld Empress. My ambition was to become an Underworld Queen, and you seven helped me realise that dream.𝑓𝑟ℯ𝘦𝓌𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝑐ℴ𝓂
So I don’t know about you, but I am content with what I have now. I would not risk it just because someone else couldn’t bend the knee to a higher authority."
The seven elders looked at each other for a few seconds before they all let out a deep sigh of relief. They then burst out into uncontrollable laughter.
"What a relief. We thought you would also join that bastard, so we were worried for a second there."
Nyx glared at her seven elders and smirked... "Cowards."
They didn’t mind. In their mind, "We would rather face a god with no authority than an Empress with supreme authority over all of the underworld."
"I guess there is smartness in there somewhere." Soon, their meeting ended. Nyx stayed in her meeting hall for a few hours before she left to handle her own issues.
A significant change is coming, and she might have to fight a big battle. So it was best she start to prepare...
