chapters.title: Chapter 1223: Big Reveal, Kent’s worry
paragraphs: After Kent and Indie spent a good time exploring each other’s mouths, they broke the kiss and gasped for breath. It was a wild marathon that lasted forever.
Indie was ready for that kiss, so when she had her chance, she went for it and looking at the happiness on her face, she seemed happy and content.
Kent was also charmed by her body.

One can say that just the body alone is not enough to make someone like Kent, who had seen many gorgeous bodies, be charmed by Indie’s new looks. However, as it stands, he was indeed charmed, and that alone explains what kind of beauty Indie is.
Her curves are magic.
Alina had finally gotten someone who could contend with her in the ass department.
Of course, per size, Alina is still ahead of her. However, there is something unique about her that makes Kent’s body heat up just looking at her.
Perhaps it is because she is a Catkin, or maybe her body is just too alluring to hear.

Naturally, her body is now akin to a cat’s. She can stretch and move between cracks like a cat. Well, with her ass, sneaking between cracks is impossible. Those round melons aren’t going to let her move between cracks easily.
However, she looks stunning, and maybe because of her nature as a Catkin, she has that body Alina doesn’t have. She has that cat-like body that makes stretching very easy.
So, in a way, she has something unique about her. Of course, while Alina is ahead of her in the ass department, that uniqueness has also set her apart, giving her something unique only she possesses.
She wouldn’t be in Alina’s shadow.
’Well, I for one would love to have both her, Mara and Alina shaking those asses to music. That would be a relaxing afternoon for sure,’ Kent smiled just thinking about what a sight it would be.
"Are you alright?" he asked with a caring smile.
"I am fine, Kent. I am very fine," Indie responded with a calm and polite smile. Kent nodded, feeling happy for her.
Now that she has her own True Name, Kent knew her journey had just begun. All his wives had their own journeys to embark on thanks to their True Names.

Of course, while Kent already knew one day they would have to rise to the occasion when they are needed, just the fact that they now have their lives back and enough time to prepare is already good enough for him.
They at least have a purpose. Once they are ready to leave and claim their legacies, he will be there by their sides every step of the way.
He took hold of Indie’s hand and walked toward her sisters, who couldn’t wait to meet the new her.
They surrounded her and began asking many questions. They all want to know what has changed about her since her True Names had awakened.
Kent already knew the rodeo, so he stayed on the sidelines while his women had the Q&A. Indie hid nothing from them since she had no reason to.𝓯𝓻𝓮𝙚𝙬𝓮𝙗𝒏𝙤𝒗𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝒐𝓶
All Kent’s wives had been transparent to each other, so she sang like a bird, already happy to tell them everything.

After a few minutes, Indie revealed something big, something that Kent seemed already aware of. After all, he was the one who invoked her True Name. He spoke the words, and he invoked the authority that binds them.
"Although I am not having all of my memories at the moment, I already know I am the queen of the underworld. I can sense my authority in the underworld even as we speak.
If I want, I can go to the underworld and back as I please. In fact, I have to go there soon to complete my transformation"
"Wow, that is big," Unity exclaimed, hearing what Indie had revealed. The rest of her sisters were also stunned by the reveal.
Being the Queen of the Underworld is terrific, and so they are happy for her even though they are also stunned.
As for Kent, he furrowed his brow, hearing what Indie said. He most certainly wasn’t looking to hear something that big...
A question quickly popped up in his mind, and so he asked, "When you say the queen of the underworld, are you insinuating that you rule over a specific level of the underworld or all 13 levels?"
"All thirteen," Indie answered, then she paused before a smile appeared on her face... "I guess I should be called an Empress instead."
She laughed, and her sisters laughed with her. Even Kent smiled, feeling both happy and a little worried for her.
As long as he could remember, the underworld has 13 levels, each ruled by an underworld king or queen. Every last king or queen is a demigod with several demigods under them.
However, all 13 of them answer to a higher authority: the Underworld God.

This means while the underworld is a domain of its own, there is someone who holds all the power. The underworld domain powers the Underworld God’s divinity, and as such, he holds all power in the underworld.
So if such a person suddenly felt threatened by the appearance of the True Empress, the best thing for them to do was take her out of the equation before she became a problem.
Kent isn’t worried because not even a Celestial can enter the tower without his or his wife’s permission. So as long as she is inside the tower, she will be safe.
However, what if, because she is the Underworld Empress, she had to go to the underworld to handle some things there? Indie just said she would soon go there to complete her transformation.
Once she is gone, the chances of her being in danger are very high, and for that, Kent is worried. He is not strong enough to protect her from a god.
Of course, there is Vexthra; however, while she is a goddess with strength that only a few gods could resist, she will be facing a Universe God in his domain.
That, in all aspects, will tilt things in his favour.
And who is to tell if that bastard will play fair? For all they know, he will seek help from external sources, all in the name of winning.
Such a person would undoubtedly have his hands deep in many places, so Kent cannot risk it. Not when his wife will be in danger while he is powerless to do anything.
However, seeing the worried look on Kent’s face, Indie merely smiled and said,
"Unless someone has a death wish, then coming against the Underworld Empress while in the Underworld is the last thing they would want."
She snapped her fingers, and at once a dark door with runic markings appeared and slowly opened. From within, a crown flew and landed on Indie’s head, instantly changing the aura around her.
In less than a moment, she transformed from a mortal to an empress whose authority extends far and wide. Kent could sense the coldness of the underworld radiating off her.
Indie then formed a hand seal, and the door swung open wide this time. Then, from within, seven ladies, each wearing masks made of bone, stepped out.
They each held a deadly weapon.
They walked toward Indie, then knelt and bowed.
They then said in unison... "The Seven Underworld Guards greet the Empress."
Kent furrowed his brow again, and the silent tower immediately whispered into his ears, words that would break many if they knew.
⟦Master, they are Universal Gods from the Primordial Era... every last one of them. They are the Seven Silent Claws, loyal guards of the Underworld Queen.⟧

chapters.title: Chapter 1224: The Seven Silent Claws
paragraphs: During the Primordial Era, when the Underworld Queen rose to prominence as one of the powerhouses in that era, she was always followed around by seven dangerous ladies, each a force to be reckoned with.
They called them ’The Seven Silent Claws’ back then.

Nobody has ever seen their faces since they like to walk around wearing masks. In every battle fought by the Underworld Queen, the seven of them took the vanguard. Because of them, the Underworld Queen ruled unopposed for millions of years.
However, when she vanished, they were also not heard from again until today.𝒻𝓇𝑒𝘦𝘸𝑒𝒷𝓃ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝒸ℴ𝘮
The Primordial Era was destroyed, but it seems just like most; they also survived.
And now that their queen had awakened again, they answered her call and came. Their arrival immediately calmed the worry in Kent’s heart.
Something else took root. Something he believes is tied to the Chaos.
Looking at them kneeling and bowing before her, Kent wore a complicated expression. For some reason, he feels like the seven ladies on the ground don’t like him very much.

Of course, he quickly linked it to Chaos, since when the Primordial Era is mentioned, he was the one to call. Clearly, it seems to him that Chaos may have done something to them to make them hate him.
"Stand, ladies, we are not in the Primordial Era anymore," Indie said with a smile. Then, in a high, cheerful tone, she welcomed them: "Welcome to the Infinity Era, Cats."
The seven ladies stood up and started looking around with happy expressions... The beautiful environment inside the Harem tower instantly captured their attention.
"Beautiful," one of them, by the name Sorynn, said, gazing at the Love Garden.
Perhaps because all seven of them are happy with the environment, none of them noticed Kent early. Their focus was drawn entirely to the beauty around them.
However, a few seconds later, they saw him, and all seven of them paused on him and narrowed their gaze at him.
Kaelis, the poison expert in the Seven Silent Claws, took off her mask, revealing her beautiful face with a frown... "You look familiar," she said, taking a few steps toward Kent.
Kent smiled despite being stared down by seven Universal Gods. He cleared his throat and replied, "I don’t think so, lady. This is my first time meeting you."
He turned and looked at all seven of them before introducing himself, "I am Kent Madson, a dragon and the husband of your Empress."

Hearing his words, all seven turned toward Indie as if asking if it was true... Indie smiled and nodded... "He is telling the truth. I have given my heart to him, and I don’t regret that decision. So you will treat him as you would treat me."
They nodded and turned back to Kent. The frown is still on their faces, for deep within them they recognise Kent, and that makes them suspect him.

Well, he did lock their queen in the underworld, never to return to the land of the living again. Although he later lifted that ban, they had already developed hatred for him and tried to kill him many times.
It was their queen who told them to stop before they did.
However, if they sense Kent is the same bastard who locked their Empress, he will probably take some beatings.
However, Indie wouldn’t allow that to happen. Kent is more important to her than even her role as the Empress of the Underworld.
Seeing them look suspiciously at Kent, she decided to take their minds away from him.
"Girls, these are my sisters. The adorable one is called Unity. She is everyone’s favourite." Indie smiled, and so did the rest of her sisters.
The Seven Silent Claws also smiled, knowing they would pamper Unity anyday. She just looked too adorable.
All seven of them had taken off their masks, revealing their beautiful smiles.
Kent joined them, but he didn’t draw the attention of the seven goddesses to himself since the more they looked at him, the higher their chance of recognising him.

"The pale one is Elsa; she is a Soul Sentinel, one of the greatest soul cultivators in this era." They nodded toward Elsa. Even though Indie exaggerated a bit, she would indeed rise to her past self one of these days.
The legendary Soul Sentinel would one day ride into battle with her legion of Soul Sentinels.
"The cheerful one is Selene." Indie pauses and picks her words carefully, "I wouldn’t play with her if you don’t want your backs on a soft bed and legs spread open."
Her sisters burst into uncontrollable laughter, while the Seven Silent Claws wore confused expressions. They had no idea why they were laughing.
Indie, of course, didn’t explain anything to them. Selene had already marked her prey, and regardless of the gap between them, she would work her magic on them.

"She is called Enzi, a Crystal Angel and a Glass Elemental Manipulator. Personally, I think you shouldn’t antagonise her since she likes trapping people in glass dimensions." Enzi said hi to the seven guards, ignoring the latter part of what Indie said.
"And that is Liora, a dangerous assassin that none of you should underestimate."
Nyssara, a crimson-haired beauty, turned her head to the side and studied Liora. After a few seconds, she nodded... "She has all the qualities. I will train her from now on. You can call me Nyssa."
Liora nodded and smiled, "I will be glad to learn from you, Senior Nyssa."

"No need to call me that. You are the Empress’s sister, so we naturally serve you all. Training will be a way of making sure the Empress has powerful people around her that she could trust in times of need."
There is no denying the logic in her words. Liora nodded with a smile. Having a Universal God as her teacher is a boon few can boast of.
Indie turned to Arien, but before she could speak, Nyssa spoke, cutting her off...
"We know you," she said, pointing at Arien.

Elwen, another beauty with long ash-brown hair, took over, "Although you are a mortal now, I can never forget the scent of a legend like you." They recognised Arien’s past self as the Nine-Tailed Void Fox.
"Intriguing, who would have thought a legend as you would now be sisters with the Empress?" She paused for a few seconds and revealed something intriguing...
"You were rivals, you know."
Indie turned and looked at Arien, who smiled weakly, already aware of that. She had crossed paths with Indie’s past long before she met Chaos in the Blood Region.
Now, it seems she later met her again, and they even became rivals.
"I don’t know about the past, but Indie and I are best friends and sisters now."
"That is good to me. Having two of my favourite people back is good enough for me."
Indie smiled and turned to Runa and Adina. However, yet again, the seven guards recognised them... well, they recognised the kind of people they are.
"Extreme Pure Yin Body, huh. That is rare, but to think there are two of you here at the same time... very interesting."
This time Kent intervened and asked...
"Please, what do you know about the Extreme Pure Yin Body Constitution?"

"A lot, actually," Elwen answered and then made a ball of pure ice float on her palm... "After all, I am also a bearer of the Extreme Yin Constitution, only that I have already awakened the True Extreme Yin Divine Body."

chapters.title: Chapter 1225: Extreme Pure Yin Body
paragraphs: It wasn’t just Kent; even his ladies were drawn to the answer Elwen gave them.

Hearing that she also has the Extreme Pure Yin Body, they all seemed eager to learn more about it. Even Runa and Adina were anxious to know more about their body constitutions and see what lies ahead for them.
Being prepared early is always better than entering the chaos without a plan. Vexthra managed to get them some info on their body constitution.
However, she wasnt able to get much since the Extreme Pure Yin Body is very rare.
Now they have someone with the same constitution, and, judging by what she has said and revealed, she knows more than they could ask for.
So instead of getting down to business on why Indie has called them, she told Elwen to speak more about the Extreme Pure Yin Body constitution.
"We all want to know, Elwen, so why don’t you tell us what you know?"
Elwen nodded and started to speak...

"Naturally, there can only be one Extreme Pure Yin Body in an era. The only time a second Extreme Pure Yin Body appears in the same era is if the one wielding it dies or contaminates their body before awakening the True Extreme Pure Divine Yin Body."
Everyone turns and stares at Runa and Adina.
The two are in the same era, yet they both have the Extreme Pure Yin Body. It is strange, and coming from someone who has the same body, the ladies were a little taken aback.
As for Kent, he linked it to their past, and so he knew this all had fate’s handwriting over it. Fate likes to play games, and perhaps this is one of her games.
"Of course, as to why they both have the Extreme Pure Yin Body, I can’t explain. However, what I do know is that the Extreme Pure Yin Body is one of the greatest body constitutions in the universe.

It gives us supreme control over the Yin Qi, which, in other words, gives us control over ice. However, those are just added bonuses to what the True Extreme Pure Yin Body can do." Elwen paused for a moment and let what she said sink in.

"At the core, most will say having the Extreme Pure Yin Body makes you pure and unblemished. However, as someone who has had this body constitution my whole life, I know that its true potential appears from the immortal stage through to the god stage.
It will make things a thousand times easier for us.

Forming Immortal Qi becomes as easy as cultivating spiritual Qi. In fact, with such a body, once you become an immortal, the Yin Qi stored in your core automatically forms Immortal Qi for you, allowing your control over ice to reach the next stage.
You will become undefeated at the Root Immortal stage right off the bat.
Second, once you awaken your body constitution and attain ice affinity, you will have control over the Absolute Ice from the start."
"Really?" Runa asked, her expression showing she was happy to hear that... "I learnt Absolute Ice is the peak of ice a cultivator can attain."
Elwen smiled and shook her head, "Maybe to you mortals. However, from what I know and have experienced, that is not even close."
"How so? Are there other forms of ice higher than Absolute Ice?" Adina asked. It is not every day that what one believes turns out to be wrong, so she wanted to know.

"Absolute Ice is the start. The next ice, even colder and more potent, is the Extreme Ice. That is what I have now. However, from research, I found out there is another called Ultimate Ice that comes right after the Extreme Ice.

But aside from that, there is even one that was only rumoured, but I never saw it. It is called Primordial Ice. Naturally, without the Extreme Yin Pure Body constitution, most can only reach the Absolute Ice.
Of course, there are other ice constitutions out there that can go beyond the Absolute Ice stage. However, the Extreme Pure Yin Body is a sure way to reach Ultimate Ice one of these days.
However, if you manage to awaken your constitution without tainting your body, then trust me, once you become an immortal, you two will become a force to reckon with."
"Looks like you ladies are monsters in human form," Unity said with a broad smile. Her sisters were also thrilled to hear that two of them have this much potential.𝘧𝑟𝑒𝑒𝘸𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝓁.𝘤𝘰𝓂
"I can only wait and see what you ladies turn out after your True Name awakening," Selene said, her expression brightening up.

"What did you just say?" Elwen asked, her brow furrowed, eyes locked on Selene. The latter smiled and turned to Kent, who just shrugged. He was more focused on the chilling potential of his two virgins.
Selene turned to Elwen... "We all have True Names, you see."

"But that shouldn’t be possible," Elwen said, looking even closer at the ladies now... "True Names are something the universe gives to those who have made significant contributions. The last I checked, to earn that, it takes a lot."

"Maybe we have done excellent service to the universe, so she rewarded us." Unity smiled and added, "In any case, we all have True Names, and since we have someone who can invoke True Names as our man, Runa and Adina will soon be getting theirs."
"True. Our husband is not an ordinary person, you see," Indie added, making sure she gave Kent a wink.
The seven silent Claws turn to Kent and narrow their eyes at him once more...
The Chaos Dragon merely smiled, feeling some pride bubbling in his chest.
"I think we know you," Thira, one of the silent Claws, said, walking toward Kent. She got too close, in fact, allowing her to sniff him.
"Although you are not him because you have no Chaos aura, I know you are him." She moved and stood behind Kent.
"Thira, play nice," Indie warned, knowing Thira’s character. She wasn’t worried they would kill him, but she was concerned about what they would put him through.
"You are Lord Chaos, aren’t you?" Thira said, or more like asked.
Kent smiled and responded:
"I don’t know what you are talking about."
"I knew it," Thira’s eyes sparkled with interest. The rest of her sisters also walked, surrounding Kent and shielding him from his wives.
"So you are Lord Chaos, huh. Looks like destiny didn’t play a game on us this time around." Nyssa placed her slender hands on Kent’s shoulder and gave him a smile that didn’t reach her eyes.
Indie quickly teleported to Kent’s side and glared at her guards...
"Relax, Empress. He is much weaker now, so we wouldn’t do anything to him." They all smiled wickedly.
This time, Kent felt a chill run down his spine.

"Knowing him, his strength will soon skyrocket. So we will wait for him to reach the stage where we can have some sparring sessions." They moved away from Kent with smiles that made the Chaos Dragon decide instantly.
’I have to tame these wild ones before they break me,’ Kent smiled quietly.
This time, it was the seven ladies who felt chills down their spines.
Selene, who saw this smile, became happy. She tapped into the connection between herself and Kent and gave him her support.
’Fear not, love. You will have them screaming soon enough.’
Kent smiled and replied, ’I will depend on you, cupcakes.’

sentences.text: It wasn’t just Kent; even his ladies were drawn to the answer Elwen gave them.
Hearing that she also has the Extreme Pure Yin Body, they all seemed eager to learn more about it.
Even Runa and Adina were anxious to know more about their body constitutions and see what lies ahead for them.
Being prepared early is always better than entering the chaos without a plan.
Vexthra managed to get them some info on their body constitution.
However, she wasnt able to get much since the Extreme Pure Yin Body is very rare.
Now they have someone with the same constitution, and, judging by what she has said and revealed, she knows more than they could ask for.
So instead of getting down to business on why Indie has called them, she told Elwen to speak more about the Extreme Pure Yin Body constitution.
"We all want to know, Elwen, so why don’t you tell us what you know?"
Elwen nodded and started to speak...
"Naturally, there can only be one Extreme Pure Yin Body in an era.
The only time a second Extreme Pure Yin Body appears in the same era is if the one wielding it dies or contaminates their body before awakening the True Extreme Pure Divine Yin Body."
Everyone turns and stares at Runa and Adina.
The two are in the same era, yet they both have the Extreme Pure Yin Body.
It is strange, and coming from someone who has the same body, the ladies were a little taken aback.
As for Kent, he linked it to their past, and so he knew this all had fate’s handwriting over it.
Fate likes to play games, and perhaps this is one of her games.
"Of course, as to why they both have the Extreme Pure Yin Body, I can’t explain.
However, what I do know is that the Extreme Pure Yin Body is one of the greatest body constitutions in the universe.
It gives us supreme control over the Yin Qi, which, in other words, gives us control over ice.
However, those are just added bonuses to what the True Extreme Pure Yin Body can do." Elwen paused for a moment and let what she said sink in.
"At the core, most will say having the Extreme Pure Yin Body makes you pure and unblemished.
However, as someone who has had this body constitution my whole life, I know that its true potential appears from the immortal stage through to the god stage.
It will make things a thousand times easier for us.
Forming Immortal Qi becomes as easy as cultivating spiritual Qi.
In fact, with such a body, once you become an immortal, the Yin Qi stored in your core automatically forms Immortal Qi for you, allowing your control over ice to reach the next stage.
You will become undefeated at the Root Immortal stage right off the bat.
Second, once you awaken your body constitution and attain ice affinity, you will have control over the Absolute Ice from the start."
"Really?" Runa asked, her expression showing she was happy to hear that...
"I learnt Absolute Ice is the peak of ice a cultivator can attain."
Elwen smiled and shook her head, "Maybe to you mortals.
However, from what I know and have experienced, that is not even close."
"How so?
Are there other forms of ice higher than Absolute Ice?" Adina asked.
It is not every day that what one believes turns out to be wrong, so she wanted to know.
"Absolute Ice is the start.
The next ice, even colder and more potent, is the Extreme Ice.
That is what I have now.
However, from research, I found out there is another called Ultimate Ice that comes right after the Extreme Ice.
But aside from that, there is even one that was only rumoured, but I never saw it.
It is called Primordial Ice.
Naturally, without the Extreme Yin Pure Body constitution, most can only reach the Absolute Ice.
Of course, there are other ice constitutions out there that can go beyond the Absolute Ice stage.
However, the Extreme Pure Yin Body is a sure way to reach Ultimate Ice one of these days.
However, if you manage to awaken your constitution without tainting your body, then trust me, once you become an immortal, you two will become a force to reckon with."
"Looks like you ladies are monsters in human form," Unity said with a broad smile.
Her sisters were also thrilled to hear that two of them have this much potential.𝘧𝑟𝑒𝑒𝘸𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝓁.𝘤𝘰𝓂
"I can only wait and see what you ladies turn out after your True Name awakening," Selene said, her expression brightening up.
"What did you just say?" Elwen asked, her brow furrowed, eyes locked on Selene.
The latter smiled and turned to Kent, who just shrugged.
He was more focused on the chilling potential of his two virgins.
Selene turned to Elwen...
"We all have True Names, you see."
"But that shouldn’t be possible," Elwen said, looking even closer at the ladies now...
"True Names are something the universe gives to those who have made significant contributions.
The last I checked, to earn that, it takes a lot."

"Maybe we have done excellent service to the universe, so she rewarded us." Unity smiled and added, "In any case, we all have True Names, and since we have someone who can invoke True Names as our man, Runa and Adina will soon be getting theirs."
"True.
Our husband is not an ordinary person, you see," Indie added, making sure she gave Kent a wink.
The seven silent Claws turn to Kent and narrow their eyes at him once more...
The Chaos Dragon merely smiled, feeling some pride bubbling in his chest.
"I think we know you," Thira, one of the silent Claws, said, walking toward Kent.
She got too close, in fact, allowing her to sniff him.
"Although you are not him because you have no Chaos aura, I know you are him." She moved and stood behind Kent.
"Thira, play nice," Indie warned, knowing Thira’s character.
She wasn’t worried they would kill him, but she was concerned about what they would put him through.
"You are Lord Chaos, aren’t you?" Thira said, or more like asked.
Kent smiled and responded:
"I don’t know what you are talking about."
"I knew it," Thira’s eyes sparkled with interest.
The rest of her sisters also walked, surrounding Kent and shielding him from his wives.
"So you are Lord Chaos, huh.
Looks like destiny didn’t play a game on us this time around." Nyssa placed her slender hands on Kent’s shoulder and gave him a smile that didn’t reach her eyes.
Indie quickly teleported to Kent’s side and glared at her guards...
"Relax, Empress.
He is much weaker now, so we wouldn’t do anything to him." They all smiled wickedly.

She tapped into the connection between herself and Kent and gave him her support.
’Fear not, love.
You will have them screaming soon enough.’
Kent smiled and replied, ’I will depend on you, cupcakes.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1226: Kent’s Decision
paragraphs: With Kent’s identity as the Chaos Dragon revealed to the seven silent Claws, he knew one of these days, he would have to answer for what he did to Indie in her past life.
However, that is an issue to be handled later. So they quickly returned to the subject they were initially discussing.

The Extreme Pure Yin Body has more benefits than Kent, and any of his women initially thought. In fact, just possessing the unawakened form of the Extreme Pure Yin Body has many advantages that Adina and Runa aren’t harnessing.
Of course, it isnt their fault. However, they lack the knowledge of how to cultivate the Extreme Pure Yin Body properly.
From what Elwen said, at this point in their life, and thanks to the peace they have, finding the coldest place to cultivate is the next best thing for them.
According to her explanation, when they reach the bottleneck between the Death stage and the Root Immortal stage, they would undergo a tribulation called Black Frost Lightning.
This tribulation will test their resistance to ice. So while they still have the time, the next best thing is to cultivate in an icy location.
No gods and supremes are chasing after them now, so they have all the time in the universe to cultivate it well.
As it turns out, Elwen has a place for them to do just that. After all, they didn’t survive the Primordial Era and live this many eras just lying around doing nothing.
They were celestials back then, but many eras had passed, and to preserve the legacy of the Underworld Empress, they had to sacrifice their cultivation.
Now, they are universal gods, but as beings who had once lived as celestials, reaching that stage again is only a matter of time.
So when Runa and Adina are ready, she will take them there to train. It is for their own good, and Kent had no problem with that. The stronger his women get, the better for him and them.
"So what now?" Kent asked after learning all he could about the Extreme Pure Yin Body from Elwen.
"We have to take the Empress to the underworld to undergo her initiation ritual. Of course, she isnt required to come with us right now. Whenever she is ready, we will go for her.
The process will take time, and so she should be done with everything here before going," Nyssa replied, taking a seat on a bench.
She is more relaxed than the rest of her sisters.
Indie nodded to her words and turned to Kent, "Don’t worry, until Elina is rescued, I won’t leave. I want to meet her first... we all do."
"Then it is decided. We will go back to make sure things are in order before coming for you," Nyssa spoke again, causing Kent and his wives to turn toward her...
"Is something happening there?"
Thira answered, "Yes. As it turns out, after the Empress died, a no-name calling himself the god of the underworld, had somehow gained authority over hell and is now ruling it.
However, now that the Underworld Mansion has arrived, his influence is slipping, so he started to organise a resistance with his fickle dream of retaining his dominion."

Luneth, another catkin, chuckled... "He is a very laughable fellow. I can kill him before he blinks. All I need is the go-ahead from the empress, and his head will be rolling to the floor in no time."
Indie smiled, feeling amused. Although she can’t challenge even an immortal at her current level, she knew for a fact that whatever those people are doing won’t amount to anything.
She holds all the power now.
"Just give the go-ahead, and we will kill every last one of them," Veyra said, sitting beside Elwen.

"No. I want to see those who would rebel with him and those who will acknowledge my rule. It’s been a very long time, so I need people who know more about the underworld and are loyal to be by my side.
I will return the Underworld to its former glory, and I need loyal allies for that to happen"
"Of course," Soryn and her sisters nodded.
"We have actually acknowledged three of them."
"Oh, really," Indie seemed interested in hearing what Soryn said.

"Yes. The Queen of the 3rd Underworld, King of the 7th Underworld, and the Queen of the 9th Underworld don’t seem to be interested in joining the Underworld God. In fact, my personal favourite is the 9th Underworld Queen.
She is cold and doesn’t seem to place the Underworld God in her eyes."
"Oh, that is indeed interesting."
"Yes, Empress. However, they might be in danger since the Underworld God will have 10 underworld kings and queens with him."
"Of course, with your order, we can protect them."
Indie turns to Kent and asks, "Should they?"
"Why not. They can protect the other two, but let them keep their distance from the 9th Underworld Queen. However, she or her trusted subordinates cannot die."
Knowing Nyx isn’t interested in joining the Underworld God made him happy and proud. However, he also wants to see what she can do on her own.
Uncle Drew has sung her praises many times, so he wants to see what she can do. Of course, he wouldn’t put her in danger since she is someone he cares about.
So the seven cats will protect her from the shadows.
"We can do that. However, if that bastard takes it too far, then we wouldn’t mind cleaning house."
Kent didn’t doubt Thira’s words. She is a wild one, judging by the look in her eyes. In fact, all of them are unique in their own way.
They are universal gods after all. But looking at them, one wouldn’t know unless they tell them.
"We will be leaving now, Empress. Once you are ready to come and take your throne, call us. Of course, if something happens, we will let you know immediately."
Indie nodded.
"When you are bored, you can come over to play with us," Selene said with a mysterious smile. The seven Silent Claws nodded, not knowing what kind of evil was going through Selene’s head.
She would love to have them around for a while, but she knew they had to go back before something bad happened.
Indie’s empire is the underworld after all. If something bad happens to it, she would, in a way, be affected.
They stood up and started walking toward the gate.
Before walking through the doors, they turned to Kent and smiled... "Take good care of the Empress, Lord Chaos. You owe her that much."
Kent smiled and nodded... "I will."
"Good." Just when they entered the gate, Thira’s voice entered Kent’s head, ’You wouldn’t want to have me chasing after you like that last time.’
’Ah, why even bother at this point. First, it was Enzi, then Liora, and now Indie,’ Kent said inwardly and just smiled weakly.
Indie is not yet aware that the one who locked her away in the underworld was the same man she had given her heart to. When she remembers, perhaps, she will handle it better than Enzi.
After all, she was a criminal who had stolen quite a lot of valuables before she was caught.
"Runa baby, it is your turn," Kent said to the Elven Priestess, who giggled and jumped into his arms. She wants to feel complete, so this is her chance.
Soon, her True Name awakening ritual began.

chapters.title: Chapter 1227: Aelthyrion Ruun’Vaelae
paragraphs: She was born an orphan and was later sold into slavery. They escaped with 13 others who chose to take their destiny into their own hands and make a life for themselves.
They were later called the 14 Chronicles of the Storm, legendary warriors in their own capacity. In the end, every last one of them fell during the Great War on their own terms.
This is the story of a warrior who used her life to bring back hope to the dying universe.
Aelthyr was left at the doorstep of a farmer whose life couldn’t be any poorer than it was. He was struggling, and with the blessing of a new baby, he gained hope to turn his life around.
So without any hesitation, he sold her into slavery, earning a few gold coins.

When she learned to talk, she had a collar around her neck with no sense of freedom or peace. Her entire teenage years were spent serving others to the best of her ability, yet she wasn’t praised or rewarded... not even once.
By the age of 25, she had suffered so much that life was starting to be meaningless to her.
However, as someone who hadn’t known freedom, she longed for that.
So she chose to chase freedom, and with her, 13 other slaves joined.
It was daunting and dangerous, but they succeeded. They changed their fate, and with that change, they started building a life for themselves.
Soon, a group of 14 archers, all females, rose slowly from the shadows and soon became a sensation. They called themselves the 14 Chronicles of the Storm.
14 female archers. Each possesses an affinity for lightning and Absolute Ice.
Whenever they appear, a storm follows.
Eventually, they became a team that, when the Void Beasts appeared, many counted on them to deliver.
The leader of the group, Aelthyr, was the greatest of them and one whose death gave hope to the universe.
When the Universe Guardians betrayed the universe, and the Chaos Dragon and everything was falling apart, an arrow that turned the tide was fired, and it came from the bow of Aelthyr.

She sacrificed her soul and life to unleash an arrow that not only killed 2 Void Generals, but also reversed time by a whopping hour, something that gave the Chaos Dragon the time he needed to complete his spell.
She used her life to give the universe one hour of hope. That one hour gave the universe time, and in her dying breath, they whispered a name that would forever be hers.
"They called her Aelthyrion Ruun’Vaelae, the one who gave the universe hope."
Kent smiled, and on top of his voice, he invoked Runa’s True Name... "Rise Aelthyrion Ruun’Vaelae, your destiny is calling."
Rumble
Lightning surged, and a storm enveloped the entire Harem Tower. At once, it feels like the whole space was a single storm formed by divine lightning.
Inside the storm, a silhouette of a lady clad in silk armour keeps flashing whenever the lightning flashes.
"It feels like a storm deity is descending," Arien muttered, looking up. The rest of her sisters were gazing at the surging storm, each wearing a happy smile.
"I think she is a deity. Maybe even a storm goddess that had once graced the universe with her honourable presence," Unity muttered.
She also wields the bow with lightning. So she knew what she was talking about. Just gazing at the storm makes her feel as if someone who once held supreme control over lightning is being reborn.

Unity was rather unfortunate in all the lives she had lived. She never got to reach the peak of her life before tragically dying. So while she was destined to ride the storm, she never got the chance to.
Watching Runa command the storm, a part of her is happy for her, but there is also a sadness deep within.
However, she suppressed her sadness and let the moment of joy blossom.
RUMBLE

Storm surged, and through the silhouette, a large, magnificent bow appeared and slowly lowered to Runa, who caught it and instantly unleashed an arrow that separated the storm, revealing an ethereal beauty, a bow in her firm grip and a quiver hanging on her back.
Green, lush hair fell down her back, crackling with energy.
For a moment, time came to a stop.
CRACK

But then she took a step forward. Space cracked and froze solid, lightning dancing through the ice. At once, nobody knew where the chill came from, but in an instant, the entire Harem Tower turned bone-chilling cold.
Kent immediately waved his hand, and a dome of fire surrounded all his wives. But even so, the coldness didn’t dissipate.
They were still feeling it deep in their bones, causing Kent to send them away to the Sword Tower instantly. Perhaps, only Adina could withstand the ice...But he wasnt about to find out.
He formed a hand seal, and a large gate appeared behind him. Inside the gate, a large green flame core lit up, sending a wave of heat in all directions.
However, despite Kent manifesting his flame core, the cold didn’t waver. If anything, it starts to freeze the core, causing Kent to grit his teeth.
However, he remained standing, watching as Runa slowly walked toward him, every step causing space to crack and freeze.
"Runa dear, maybe lower the intensity a little so I don’t freeze to death," Kent said with a small smile despite his body slowly turning into solid ice.
Runa didn’t say anything. She just kept walking forward. By the time she was 30 meters from Kent, his flame core couldn’t take any more, so he deactivated it.
He wasnt about to damage his flame core when he knew nothing about how the Ice element works.
ROAR
Instead, he roared to life, turning into a colossal dragon. He flapped his wings and instantly engulfed himself in fire.
That move increased his body temperature, allowing him to last a little longer. His dragon body is much stronger than his human body and can withstand ice better.
Of course, since he is now a dragon, regardless of the form he is in, he would always be a dragon. But in his True Dragon form, he holds many advantages.
However, by the time Runa was 10 meters from him, he couldn’t withstand it. However, from sheer will, he remained standing, his colossal dragon body almost frozen solid.
Eventually, Kent’s vision started turning blurry. However, he willed himself to remain conscious. There is something strange about Runa’s behaviour, so he wants to experience it all.
Soon, Runa stood right before him. Kent turned back to his humanoid form, but with his wings active.
Runa cupped his cheeks and kissed him. Then, seeing he couldn’t hold on much longer, she whispered something in his ear before pushing him.
"Don’t fail, my love." Kent fell backwards, and just before he landed on the ground, a portal opened and took him away.
Right when he was gone, the coldness and storm dispersed, leaving only a stunning beauty with a cute little smile on her face.
[Are you sure about this, Aelthyr?] A voice suddenly entered her head, causing the smile on her face to brighten.
’He is my husband, Miryssa. So of course I trust him, and I know he won’t die.’
[Tch. Whatever]
Runa chuckled too and lifted her head to look at the sky... "I am back."

The rest of her sisters were gazing at the surging storm, each wearing a happy smile.
"I think she is a deity.
Maybe even a storm goddess that had once graced the universe with her honourable presence," Unity muttered.
She also wields the bow with lightning.
So she knew what she was talking about.
Just gazing at the storm makes her feel as if someone who once held supreme control over lightning is being reborn.
Unity was rather unfortunate in all the lives she had lived.
She never got to reach the peak of her life before tragically dying.
So while she was destined to ride the storm, she never got the chance to.
Watching Runa command the storm, a part of her is happy for her, but there is also a sadness deep within.
However, she suppressed her sadness and let the moment of joy blossom.
RUMBLE

Storm surged, and through the silhouette, a large, magnificent bow appeared and slowly lowered to Runa, who caught it and instantly unleashed an arrow that separated the storm, revealing an ethereal beauty, a bow in her firm grip and a quiver hanging on her back.
Green, lush hair fell down her back, crackling with energy.
For a moment, time came to a stop.
CRACK
But then she took a step forward.
Space cracked and froze solid, lightning dancing through the ice.
At once, nobody knew where the chill came from, but in an instant, the entire Harem Tower turned bone-chilling cold.
Kent immediately waved his hand, and a dome of fire surrounded all his wives.
But even so, the coldness didn’t dissipate.
They were still feeling it deep in their bones, causing Kent to send them away to the Sword Tower instantly.
Perhaps, only Adina could withstand the ice...But he wasnt about to find out.
He formed a hand seal, and a large gate appeared behind him.
Inside the gate, a large green flame core lit up, sending a wave of heat in all directions.
However, despite Kent manifesting his flame core, the cold didn’t waver.
If anything, it starts to freeze the core, causing Kent to grit his teeth.
However, he remained standing, watching as Runa slowly walked toward him, every step causing space to crack and freeze.
"Runa dear, maybe lower the intensity a little so I don’t freeze to death," Kent said with a small smile despite his body slowly turning into solid ice.
Runa didn’t say anything.
She just kept walking forward.
By the time she was 30 meters from Kent, his flame core couldn’t take any more, so he deactivated it.
He wasnt about to damage his flame core when he knew nothing about how the Ice element works.
ROAR
Instead, he roared to life, turning into a colossal dragon.
He flapped his wings and instantly engulfed himself in fire.
That move increased his body temperature, allowing him to last a little longer.
His dragon body is much stronger than his human body and can withstand ice better.
Of course, since he is now a dragon, regardless of the form he is in, he would always be a dragon.
But in his True Dragon form, he holds many advantages.
However, by the time Runa was 10 meters from him, he couldn’t withstand it.
However, from sheer will, he remained standing, his colossal dragon body almost frozen solid.
Eventually, Kent’s vision started turning blurry.
However, he willed himself to remain conscious.
There is something strange about Runa’s behaviour, so he wants to experience it all.
Soon, Runa stood right before him.
Kent turned back to his humanoid form, but with his wings active.
Runa cupped his cheeks and kissed him.
Then, seeing he couldn’t hold on much longer, she whispered something in his ear before pushing him.
"Don’t fail, my love." Kent fell backwards, and just before he landed on the ground, a portal opened and took him away.
Right when he was gone, the coldness and storm dispersed, leaving only a stunning beauty with a cute little smile on her face.
[Are you sure about this, Aelthyr?] A voice suddenly entered her head, causing the smile on her face to brighten.
’He is my husband, Miryssa.
So of course I trust him, and I know he won’t die.’
[Tch.
Whatever]
Runa chuckled too and lifted her head to look at the sky...
"I am back."

chapters.title: Chapter 1228: Chronicle of Ice Realm
paragraphs: Kent fell through what appeared to be a wormhole.
During the fall, he felt his mind going through a spectrum. Countless scenes flashed through his sight. Chilling scenes flashed through his mind, instantly overwhelming his senses.
He saw scenes of battles, beasts, terrifying cultivators, secrets, and the most chilling of them all: a dark golden eye that stared back at him.
This gaze gave him the chills.
From the scenes of battle, he saw vast battlefields littered with corpses of humans and monsters alike. Legendary warriors held their weapons high as they charged into storms of danger.
Kent saw Dark Creatures invading the universe. He saw Chaos Beasts unleashing terror into the universe. He saw the horror of the forsaken race laying waste to countless lives.
He saw many other scenes, and each is a horror that can’t be ignored.
As for the cultivators he saw, every last one of them held so much power that when his gaze landed on them, he felt his soul shake.
Just like how he saw billions of terrifying beasts, every last cultivator held some form of uniqueness that he could only translate as terror.
The secrets can’t be discerned since even Kent didn’t seem to know what he was seeing in the first place.

As for the eye, he had no idea what or who could have such a chilling gaze. However, locking eyes with it had, in a way, impacted him so much that when he came out from the portal and landed at the base of a very tall frigid stairway, he had no idea.
His mind became dull for almost an hour before Kent managed to make sense of where he was. The whole space is made of ice.
"Freezing."
He looked ahead and saw a tall stairway radiating intense chill and frost. The sight made his blood run cold.
"Where am I?" Kent muttered. The last thing he remembered was a whisper from Runa telling him not to fail, and the next, he was here.
Obviously, he didn’t expect to be here in the first place. Runa also said nothing and merely pushed him into a portal. In a way, he is here with no idea what to do.
Maybe he didn’t want to accept what he had to do despite it staring him in the face.

Looking at the stairway, he knew climbing it was why he was here. But he had to ask again. However, looking at the frost and coldness coming off from it, he knew things weren’t as simple as they looked.
Kent tried to use the soul map to examine the stairway, but to his shock, he couldn’t even send his senses to cover the first step. Something rendered his senses useless.
"Strange..." Kent said, narrowing his eyes.

"Strange indeed." Suddenly, a voice came from his left side, causing Kent to turn and look. Walking toward him is a beauty clad in white armour, holding a bow. She is radiating an icy aura filled with dangerous lightning.

"Welcome to the Chronicle of Ice Dragon... This is a realm created for the 14 Chronicles of the Storm and all who are worthy to walk the Absolute Ice Path." The lady smiled and introduced herself, "I am Miryssa."
Kent narrowed his eyes further, sensing something familiar about this lady. However, to avoid appearing impolite, he also introduced himself: "I am Kent Madson."

The coldness coming from Miryssa made his bones start to freeze. Just looking at her gave Kent chills that he could not describe. However, he put on his brave face and instead focused on what he had here.
"I have no idea why I am here. So, can you enlighten me, Lady Miryssa?"

She smiled and turned toward the stairway and said, "Many eras ago, this place was handed to us by someone very powerful. She said that walking the ice path means being one with the ice. And to be the ice is to defeat the ice.
Back then, we didn’t understand what she said. However, when we took a step and started climbing, we understood what she meant.

You are sent here to take the Trial of Absolute Ice, and to do that, you must defeat the Absolute Ice stairway. There are 1000 steps on this stairway, each designed to transform your body into one worthy of wielding Absolute Ice.
You must climb all 1000 steps, and only when you succeed can you wield the Ice. Failure will permanently seal your body from ever wielding the Ice element."
Miryssa walked toward Kent and asked in a challenging tone, "Do you dare take on this challenge, Kent?"
Kent didn’t answer her. His mind instead went back to what Runa said before pushing him into the portal... She told him not to fail. Now, it seems she wanted him to take this trial.
’So she wanted me to wield Ice, too.’
Kent smiled inwardly, imagining something, ’Breathing both Ice and Fire would sure take my abilities to the next level.’
He smiled and responded to Miryssa’s challenge with complete confidence... "Why not. It is not every day I will get to challenge my limits or freeze to death trying."
Miryssa smiled and pointed her finger at the stairway. To Kent’s shock, a thin, transparent layer opened, sending a sudden chill and prompting him to warm his body with his flame element.
Miryssa chuckled and said, "Know that the moment you step on the first step, you won’t be able to harness your flame. So prepare to fight the cold with your body and hope you don’t freeze to death."

Kent nodded, but he was troubled inwardly, learning he couldn’t use his flame. He is a dragon with the flame element, so if he is going to face the most chilling Ice he has ever felt, the least he can do is be able to harness his own flame.
But that is not possible anymore.
"Good luck, Kent... You are going to need it," Miryssa said and vanished from sight. Kent took a deep breath and gazed at the stairway.
"This is going to be a chilling climb. However, I must endure and pass." Deep down, Kent knew he would have to one day walk the path of Ice.
After all, one of the Six True Primordials who paved the way for him to rise to who he was meant to be was an Ice User. So the earlier he begins, the better.
"I’d better start early," he began walking toward the stairway.
Meanwhile, inside the Tower, Runa had summoned her sisters back to the Harem Tower.
"Where is Kent?" Selene asked, looking around.
Runa smiled and formed a hand seal, instantly manifesting a door. It swung open, revealing a mountain of snow. "Let’s go."
"Where are we going?" Unity asked, but Runa smiled and answered... "You will see in a second."
They didn’t hesitate and followed her. The moment they walked through the door, they appeared atop the snow mountain. Miryssa was standing there too. When the ladies saw her, they all turned to Runa.
"This is Miryssa, one of my sisters and teammates from my past life," Runa introduced her. She then introduced her sisters to Miryssa, too.
Afterwards, she pointed at the stairway in the distance...
"Kent," Elsa called out, watching the silhouette of Kent walking toward an Ice stairway.
"He is about to take the trial of Ice. If he wins, he will be able to command Absolute Ice; if he fails, he will forever be unable to harness Ice."
The ladies focused their attention on Kent, who stood in front of the stairway. Then, with a deep sigh, he took his first step.

chapters.title: Chapter 1229: Climbing The Absolute Ice Stairway
paragraphs: As a dragon, Kent’s main elemental affinity is the Chaos Flame. He had already witnessed how Chaos handled that flame in the past.

Although he had yet to awaken his Chaos Aura and Chaos Heart, his affinity for the chaos flame had already reached the Harmony stage. This means he can harness the Chaos flame much more efficiently this time.
So now that he has awakened 25% of his bloodline, and he can take on his True dragon form, using the flame for attacks like dragon breath is now possible.
He saw how dangerous his chaos flame got when Chaos went to train in the blood system. Back then, Kent saw that the stronger he became, the more deadly his flame.
It was one of the many reasons for his dominance in that region.

However, Kent couldn’t help wondering just what kind of ice he would awaken and how dangerous he would become if he were to wield both Ice and fire. Breathing ice is something only the Ice Dragons, or as they prefer to be called, the Crystal Dragons, can do.
The crystal breath is a dangerous attack that most dragons fear. So if he can harness such chilling powers, there is no telling just what kind of monster he will become.
’I mean, harness both ice and fire, and even going as far as merging both, sure has the prospect of becoming a megasonic attack.’
This is why he was prepared for anything right from the start.
He will not pass up the chance to become even more powerful. It is a golden opportunity handed to him, so his shameless self will take it without hesitation.
Kent walked forward and stopped at the first step, an extreme bone-chilling ice assaulting his body. He took a deep breath and deactivated his dragon wings and horn.
Then, with calculated ease, he deactivated all other forms of defence.

He wanted to face the ice with nothing but his bare body first, and then, if he needed to activate more of his defences along the way, he would do it. It is better to know what he is going against before making any sudden changes.
"Here goes nothing."

He raised his left leg and stepped on the first step. In an instant, his left leg froze solid, bone-chilling cold travelling through his body. However, Kent didn’t bother and instead lifted his right leg and stepped on it too.
"This is going to be a wild one."

The ice travelled through his body, threatening to freeze him from within. However, as it slowly moved within him, Kent began to sense it calming down bit by bit. It was as if he remained standing, nearly freezing to death, his body slowly started to adapt to the ice.
This is one of his many qualities. He easily adapts to things regardless of the danger he is in.
Naturally, he quickly adapted to it, prompting him to take the second step. He had 1000 steps to climb and a whole lot of danger to face. So, just adapting to the ice won’t be enough.
And since he can’t use his flame, it only adds to the danger. However, he would have to find a way to adapt and climb all 1000 steps without fail.
Kent’s bones crackled as the cold sank deeper, gripping every inch of him like a living creature hungry for warmth.
The second step was far colder, far harsher, almost as if it had a will of its own. He felt his muscles stiffen, his heartbeat slowing as frost gathered across his chest and shoulders.
Still, Kent pushed forward.

His will isn’t that weak. He had already faced so much danger before, and every time, the will to live trumps the desire to give up. Today is no different from any other day, so he will endure and win in the end.
After all, his wife told him not to fail.
He lifted his leg again and stepped onto the third step. The moment his leg stepped on it, a violent shiver ran through his body, nearly forcing him to kneel.
His breath escaped in short, sharp bursts, fogging the air around him.

A shockwave of ice burst forth, filling the surrounding area. Since the domain he is in is made of ice, nothing else froze. However, the cold is strong enough to freeze even someone with perfect flame affinity.
It is dangerous and life-threatening, but his eyes remained calm. His determination is firm and unwavering.
’So this is the trial of the First Ice... Good. I am going to suffer for sure, but I have to endure. The reward will be worth it’
He welcomed the pain, the cold, the threat to his life. The more it pushed against him, the more he endured and pushed back. This was how dragons evolve—through trials meant to break weaker beings.
Chaos had endured and overcome many adversities in the past. So he too will get through them and emerge a winner in the end.
Of course, it is not going to be a walk in the park.𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
By the fifth step, the world around him had turned completely white. Everything is ice. Every direction was a blizzard.
Razor-sharp winds lashed at him, each gust cutting into his skin and opening frostbitten wounds. His arms trembled. His fingertips were losing all feeling.
His legs had become numb, with no feeling whatsoever travelling through them.
’I can’t feel my legs.’ Kent muttered, a pale smile appearing on his white lips as he looked ahead at the hundreds of steps to climb.
It is already at this dangerous junction when he hadn’t even gotten anywhere.
Yet Kent refused to activate even a single dragon scale.
He continued climbing.
On the seventh step, a new pressure slammed down on him—an invisible weight that tried to crush his bones. He staggered forward, barely catching himself.
But his determination is much stronger than one might think. Soon, he had climbed 50 steps with his bare body. However, to continue, he had to activate his scale.
He coated his legs with his dark-gold dragon scales and slowly continued climbing.
Atop the mountain, the ladies continued to watch their man slowly scale the stairway one step at a time.
"Looks like he is much stronger than he looks," Miryssa said, looking at Kent step on the 70th step with ease, and then he moved to the 71st a second later.
"He is not a weakling like you might think," Unity said, feeling proud.
After Kent activated his dragon scales, he started climbing much faster—a clear sign that his dragon scales do more than take on powerful attacks.
They can withstand ice much better than most defensive skills.
"At this rate, he will clear this trial in less than 5 days," Selene muttered, watching Kent step on the 100th step.
In no time, he moved past it. But he slowly started covering his entire body with dragon scales since the higher he climbed, the more frigid the ice became.
"I give him three days," Elsa said.
Runa, however, merely smiled and shook her head... "We can only watch and see what happens. But I give him 2 days tops."
Miryssa could only look at the ladies, stunned. The way they are treating the trial made her wonder just what kind of monster Kent is.

chapters.title: Chapter 1230: The Last Step
paragraphs: In less than a day, Kent had climbed past 600 steps. However, the more he moved his legs, the stronger the pull—or, more like, the push—that kept threatening to send him flying backwards.
The ice, as he kept climbing, was so thick that his vision started to blur.
However, whenever he felt himself losing consciousness, Runa’s warning not to fail snapped him back to reality, forcing him to keep going.
So he continued to climb, and with every passing second, the ice seeping into his body kept bringing him closer to death. It showed no mercy toward him at all.
Eventually, Kent had no choice but to take on his complete dragon form. The cold is seeping past his dragon scales, prompting him to become a True Beasts.
ROAR
He roared, causing the air to shudder, as the mighty Chaos Dragon finally activated his strongest form to conquer the ice stairway.
’Just as I thought, with my complete dragon form, the ice lessens drastically.’ With this advantage, Kent started climbing even faster.
In no time, he reached the 700th step, but his dark-gold scaly body remained pristine; not even the ice would freeze it.
"Just what kind of dragon is he? Not even the ice is affecting him," Miryssa asked, a shocked look appearing on her face.

Elsa, Selene, Unity, Runa, Adina, Liora, Enzi, Arien, and Indie looked at each other and smiled. Only they knew that if Miryssa knew the man climbing the ice stairway was the legendary Chaos Dragon, she would probably go down on her knees and bow to him.
All beings who lived during the Primordial Era knew, had heard, and had experienced the overwhelming might of the Chaos Dragon.
He had no equal. Nobody came close to reaching his level of power.
And so, his climbing the ice stairway with his dragon body without freezing to death makes sense.
However, things aren’t as simple as they appear.
Back inside the tower, when Runa’s True Name had been awakened, Kent couldn’t take on her ice with even his dragon body. Of course, he managed to remain conscious, but he was at his limit back then.
If it were to be a battle, he would have been at a disadvantage, which in a way would have posed a dangerous threat to his life.
Yet here he is, perfectly fine and even full of energy as he climbs to the 800th step.
If Runa is asked why she did what she did, she would say it was to see if Kent could withstand that much ice without losing consciousness.
However, if asked, he would say his body adapted to that ice and developed some resistance to it, which he is now building on to climb.
In other words, while the endgame is to gain ice affinity, Kent had already started developing resistance to ice thanks to the coldness entering his body from the start of the climb.
In other words, he gets more resistant to the ice the higher he climbs.
It is unreal.
To resist this potent ice, one would need ice affinity first. However, Kent, despite not having it, was able to develop the resistance, and with that, he keeps climbing.
In a way, it makes him a monster in his own right. If Ice users find out this monstrous side to him, they would be left unsure of what to even say.
"Looks like conquering this trial in a day is possible," Arien said, wagging her nine fluffy tails in the air.
"It seems so. We may have underestimated him," Indie also said, and the rest of her sisters nodded.
It had only been 12 hours since he began the trial, but as he approached the 900th step, it was only a matter of time before he stepped on the 1000th.

"He is not someone we can use common sense to describe, so we didn’t underestimate him. We only took an educated guess, and his monstrous self has proven us wrong," Selene added, making her sisters feel better.
Though deep down, they themselves were taken aback by how monstrous Kent is. The higher he climbed, the faster he became.
One would expect him to slow down instead. However, he is doing the opposite.
By the 15th hour, he was already standing on the 998th step. By then, even his colossal dragon form had already started to be coated in ice.
However, Kent didn’t let the ice get to him.

He roared, shattering the ice coating his colossal form. He is close to victory, and so he would not stop until he had achieved his goal. Of course, getting to the 999th step is headache enough on its own.
It felt like he would turn to ice just stepping on the 999th step.

Kent lifted his massive claw, the talons trembling under the sheer cold radiating from the 999th step. It is both frigid and poisonous, yet there is something hidden within it that Kent knew if he endured, he would awaken something profound.
Even his dark-gold dragon scales started struggling to withstand the frigid cold.
One wrong move, one hesitation, and the cold would not just freeze him... it would claim him entirely.
He exhaled, a cloud of frost escaping his jaws.
The moment his claw touched the 999th step, a thunderous crack split the air.
BANG!
A shockwave of ice erupted violently, tearing through the frozen domain. The temperature plummeted so sharply that the blizzard itself froze mid-air for a heartbeat before resuming its wild frenzy.
Kent felt something new—something worse than bone-deep cold.
This ice invaded his soul.
A stabbing numbness pierced his mind, trying to slow his thoughts, trying to drag him to sleep.
His mind slowed down. His vision blurred. His wings grew heavy. His heartbeat faltered. His entire colossal form grew extremely dense and heavy.
His body became sluggish, the frost spreading faster than before, eating at his consciousness. If he lost consciousness, then all he had worked for would be for nothing.
On the mountain peak, all the ladies tensed at once.
They could tell Kent was struggling on the 999th step. Just looking at the ice bombarding his colossal form, they knew he was going through so much danger.
However, they were powerless to do anything. All they could do was watch him and hope he endured and stepped forward.
ROAR

Kent let out a mighty roar that rocked and shook the entire ice stairway. The air shook, and the feeling of unwillingness erupted from Kent’s colossal form, showing he was determined to see this through.
He suddenly turned back into his dragon form. His horns gleamed, wings flapped, and tail wagged, cutting the frigid air in half.
In his dragon form, he was as heavy as a planet. So he turned to his human form.
Then, with a mighty roar, he lifted his right leg, which felt like a mountain, and stepped on the 1000th step.

His left leg also moved and landed on the last step. Then, like he had lost all energy in his body, he fell face-first and landed with a crash. The ice-cold air stopped, and the entire environment turned normal.
His consciousness slipped away, leaving his body to be encased in ice, forming a cocoon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1231: Ylthariel Vaelcryss
paragraphs: Kent didn’t know how long had passed. However, when he woke up, his surroundings had completely changed.
Instead of the familiar frigid environment on the stairway, he is now resting on the shore of a blue beach. Crystal marbles line the beach, even acting as bedding for him to sleep on.
The gentle touch of the water against his body was what woke him. The air is clean, and the sense of peace could be felt from the calmness enveloping him from all sides.
Kent remained on the ground for a few minutes, just staring at the blue clouds.

’Back in middle school, they said water is colourless, that it only reflects the colour of the sky. Now watching this sky, I guess I understood why the sea is blue,’ Kent said inwardly, a small smile appearing on his face.
He had no idea where he was.
However, he wasn’t in a hurry to leave.
The place is just too magical and peaceful for him to go just like that. In fact, he remained in his relaxed position, just letting the current pass over him.
Watching the beautiful birds speed across the blue sky and the lovely sound of water dripping through the stones in the water, he couldn’t be any more relaxed.

Eventually, Kent slowly pushed himself into a sitting position, letting the cool breeze brush against his skin. The scent of the sea carried a strange sweetness, almost like flowers blooming somewhere beyond sight.
He took a deep breath, allowing the tranquillity to settle deeper into him, something he hadn’t felt in a long while.
’Maybe I should take up the Old Man’s offer and visit the Serenity of Life and Peace Garden. Even Vexthra speaks highly of them.’

That place is where one goes to tune one’s mind back to reality and find peace. Many cultivators lose their sense of self after thousands of years in seclusion or training. When that happens, they usually need a reality check to return to their true selves.
So they go to the Serenity of Life and Peace Garden for guidance on achieving that. Of course, many go there for the peace and tranquillity of the environment.
It is the only place where, regardless of how evil you are, once you step there, you must become obedient.
So, feeling the calmness and peace sitting on the shore of this beautiful beach, he couldn’t help but wonder how peaceful his life would be if he were to go there and experience their teachings.
As he looked around, he noticed that the crystal marbles scattered across the beach emitted a faint glow whenever the waves touched them.

Each pulse of light rippled outward like tiny stars winking to life. Kent reached out and picked one up, feeling a warm, soothing sensation spread across his fingertips. It was as if the marble itself was alive, responding to his touch.
The entire environment and objects are just magical.
"This is amazing," he muttered, further interacting with the marbles.
’This place... it doesn’t feel real,’ he thought, gently rolling the marble in his palm. Yet the more he stared at the scenery around him, the more grounded he felt.
The blue sky reflected perfectly on the surface of the sea, creating an endless horizon where the world seemed to stretch far beyond what he could imagine.

"I could get used to this place." Kent took a deep breath, letting the soothing air wash through his chest. He closed his eyes, as if to tap into the gentle healing nature of the breeze, and let it hit his body.
In no time, his mind was slowly drifting into the tranquillity of everything.
"When you are done having the time of your life, you can join me." Suddenly, a sweet, cold, and relaxed voice entered Kent’s head, causing him to turn to his left.
The sight that greeted him was that of a blue-haired beauty with two soft, luminous antennae on her forehead, walking toward a jade marble house that had miraculously appeared out of thin air.
Every step she takes freezes the ground behind her. Even her hair is leaving a trail of frozen frost behind her as she moves.
Kent instantly stood up and ran after her. In no time, he was standing before the jade marble building. The lady entered the makeshift house, but she left the door open.
However, Kent didn’t dare enter. He had this nagging feeling that entering the house would be bad for him. So for ten good minutes, he remained on the outside and let her take her time to come out.
Eventually, she did, holding two kitchen stools. She locked gaze with Kent for a few seconds before she handed him one of the stools.
She sat down, and Kent did the same.
For a minute, nothing else was said between them. However, Kent knew the lady would start the conversation, so he remained relaxed and let her have all the time in the world.
It is her domain after all.
"So you have already met Bhaalzhar," she suddenly said, and Kent nodded.
She nodded and smiled... "I am Ylthariel Vaelcryss, the Sovereign of Ice. One of the six True Primordials."
Kent didn’t seem surprised by this. A part of him had already come to this conclusion when he first locked gaze with her. So hearing her say it was, in a way, normal to him.𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
However, Kent went ahead and said something to avoid making things awkward... "I am Kent."
"I know. Kent Madson, the Chaos Dragon." She smiled and waved her hand, manifesting a scene of when Kent stepped on the 1000th step.
"You are smart, so I know you know why you are here. However, before that, I want you to tell me what you think of Ice. In simple terms, what is ice?"
Kent looked at her, then at the calm blue sea stretching endlessly behind her. Ice... of all elements, it was the one he understood the least.
When it comes to fire, he is currently wielding it since that is his soul flame.
Chaos energy, he embodied simply because he is the Primordial Chaos Dragon. Although he had yet to develop the ability to wield it in combat, he at least would survive in a chaotic region.
He would also interact positively with Chaos energy because, at his core, he can harness Chaos energy.
Lightning, he also has lightning affinity, though he has yet to make any progress cultivating it. He is also familiar with wind since it is what he harnesses for flight.
As for darkness, he had only recently gained an affinity for it, so he could harness it to some extent. In a way, he had touched most of the elements.
But ice? It had yet to gain some understanding of it. He is completely clueless about Ice. In a way, this is his first time taking an interest in the ice element.
"I think..." Kent paused, choosing his words slowly and carefully, "Ice is cold. Still. Detached. It preserves, but it freezes everything it touches."
Ylthariel listened without blinking, her luminous antennae dimming slightly as if absorbing his words. The faint frost under her feet spread a little farther.
"Ice is, in essence, the core of water."
She blinks.
