chapters.title: Chapter 1232: Sovereign of Ice
paragraphs: Ylthariel remained calm, though a slight smile tugged on her lips as she listened to what Kent was saying. From the onset, it was plain as day that what Kent was saying was bullshit.
There is no truth in it.
However, Ylthariel said nothing to show she was aware of his lies. She let him blabber for five minutes without stopping.
Even just saying ’ice is the core of water’ shows he is utterly ignorant of what Ice really is. His cluelessness, in a way, is also admirable.
After all, Kent not only made it sound like he knew, but he also showed the seriousness and the expression that said he believed what he was saying.
He even pumped in some knowledge of things that, when translated differently, would make it seem as if he knew.

So she allowed him to finish, her expression never shifting beyond that faint, amused calm. Only when Kent finally went silent—clearly satisfied with his own explanation—did she exhale softly, a misty breath that crystallised the air between them.
It was as if she were telling Kent something. However, the Chaos Dragon, who knew what he had done, remained satisfied with his explanation, making sure he stood by his words.
"Kent," she said gently, almost soothingly, "do you think I was born yesterday?"
"I do not follow," Kent said with a calm yet lost expression.

Ylthariel sighed and let out a chuckle... "You could have just said you have no idea what Ice really is. I mean, why go roundabout about something you have no idea about... even making it seem like you are an expert in that field."
Ylthariel even laughed, feeling amused by Kent’s sneaky behaviour.
Kent remained calm for a few seconds before he let a smile appear on his face. He stretched his body for a few more seconds before speaking.
"I am from a modern world, my lady. There, we used to say something like ’Fake it till you make it.’"
"But you didn’t have to fake it before a whole me, someone who was the source of all ice-related abilities, physiques, constitutions, and everything that had to do with ice."
"I suppose you could say when I met the Slaughter King, he ridiculed me with how little I know, so I just wanted to leave an impression."
Ylthariel chuckled and said, "You indeed left an impression. Just not the right impression."
"But I did leave one. In my heart, that is all that matters," Kent let out a grin, then a serious expression, showing he is ready to learn.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺

Ylthariel nodded to his words. "Forget about Bhaalzhar. He was just like that... always chasing after strength and power when he should be learning the basics and perfecting everything." She smiled, remembering the past when she and the True Primordial ruled the universe, creating a path that future generations walk and build upon.
"Maybe that was why there are fewer blood-related techniques and treasures out there."

Kent said nothing, but he felt better hearing Ylthariel’s words. The Slaughter King had made him appear as if he was not doing much when, in fact, he had already surpassed many expectations for someone at his level.
Ylthariel lifted her hand, and the sea behind her froze in an instant—not violently, not abruptly, but gracefully, as though time itself had chosen to slow and solidify.

The waves paused mid-crest, the ripples turned to crystaline glass, and the horizon transformed into a smooth, shimmering plain of blue-white crystal. Her luminous antennae brightened, casting a soft, celestial glow across the still world.
"I don’t know if you are aware of this. But water is formless and colourless. In the vast universe out there, most of the time, people do interpret water as formless.
However, water does indeed have a form, and that form is only manifested when it turns to ice. That ice can even be turned into colours of your choice.
Aside from that, special abilities and qualities can be imbued into it, transforming it into the form you wanted."
Ylthariel opened her palm, and a green ball of ice appeared... Kent instantly sensed a special healing essence coming from it. The soothing essence escaping from it instantly took hold of his body.
"This is ice; however, I have tapped into the healing laws of existence and crafted a special enchantment that now gives this ice a healing quality."
The green ice ball turned red instantly, leaving Kent pale. The amount of killing intent coming from it was just too much.

"Now, as you can sense, this ice is now imbued with killing intent, making it something to be feared. It can weave many enchantments into it simply because it has a form that can be manipulated at will"
She put away the red ice and let the water appear.

Kent sensed nothing from the water, even when it changed from green to red and even blue. Unlike what happened when she transformed the ice ball, nothing happened when he did the same to the formless water.
"It has long been established that anything with form can be transformed into anything you want. In fact, the core of everything starts with transformation.
Water has been transformed into ice, and as such, I was able to transmute it into both healing and killing ice."
Kent took in her words with complete focus.

Kent leaned forward slightly, his eyes fixed on the frozen horizon as Ylthariel lowered her hand. He could not clearly see what was happening; however, he knew that every movement Ylthariel made held some meaning.
It was this feeling he couldn’t describe, even though he could sense it.
As Ylthariel’s hand moved, the ice sea softened, melting back into gentle waves as though reality itself bowed to her will.
"Now," she said, turning her gaze fully on him, "tell me—what do you think Ice truly represents?"
Kent opened his mouth but stopped himself. He let out a quiet smile. This time, he didn’t try to fake it.
It was time to learn why he was here. After all, he knew Ylthariel brought him to this special realm to show him something.
He inhaled deeply, letting the cold breeze enter his lungs before responding.
So he gave a reply that captured what he had to do.
"I... don’t know," he admitted, his voice quiet but steady. "But I want to."
A slow smile formed on Ylthariel’s lips.
"It seems we can start then." She waved her hand, and the space spun for half a second. When it stopped, Kent was face-to-face with a monument.
"I cannot tell you what Ice is because everyone has their own understanding of Ice. You will have to find yours, and only then can you leave this place."

She pointed at the monument... "Inscribed on this monument are 699 True Names of Ice. The universe knew only 14 of them. You would have to figure out one of its True Names, and that name will grant you the power to wield Ice."
Kent nodded, but just before he began, a question popped into his mind, bringing a smile to his face...
"Has anyone from the 14 Chronicles of Ice ever succeeded in invoking a True Name of Ice?"
Ylthariel smiled..."All 14 of them, in fact. After all, they were my disciples"

chapters.title: Chapter 1233: True Name of Ice
paragraphs: The last time Kent learned the True Name of a Dao, the entire universe started looking for him. They all wanted to know who had accomplished such a monumental feat and, if possible, to learn from him or take it by force.
In the end, it was merely a wild goose chase that yielded nothing.
However, yet again, he stood at a crossroad where he would have to learn the True Name of another Dao... this time, the Ice Dao.

Naturally, if he succeeds, there is bound to be another wild ride... one that Kent knew would cause many to start questioning his existence. In fact, many will become even more invested in finding and connecting with his majestic existence.
Learning the True Name of something and invoking it is akin to wielding some form of authority over the thing — in this case, Kent will be learning the True Name of Ice.
But even while that is already shocking — aside from being presented with 699 True Names to select from — is the fact that 14 people had already invoked the True Name of Ice.
And these people were even disciples of a True Primordial. One of them is even his wife, Runa.
That is mind-bending.
It turned out that the 14 Chronicles of the Storm didn’t rise to fame and strength merely because they were the most talented or pitiful.
They were, in a way, experiments that a fragment of Ylthariel’s soul had used to cultivate 14 legendary Ice constitutions. One of the said Ice constitutions is the legendary Extreme Pure Yin Body.
She called them her disciples, but from how Kent heard her speak, he knew she merely used them to achieve a goal.
But that is also okay. She gave them a purpose and a reason to live for themselves. So using them as her experiment is, in a way, worthy of what she had given them.
Now, he is about to figure out a True Name out of the 699 names of Ice.
’I wonder if I am going to be one of her experiments, ’ Kent said inwardly. Hearing how silly his words were, he chuckled and wiped that thought from his mind.
Ylthariel vanished from the scene, leaving Kent standing before the large monument holding the inscriptions of the True Names.
Obviously, learning the True Name of Ice isn’t going to be as straightforward as reading the inscription.
He would have to dive in and fully understand the essence and true meaning of that inscription before he could decipher the True Name.
Kent sat down and tapped into his Mind Space, instantly appearing in a space where lines of runes, so ancient that deciphering even a single rune can take forever.
Contained within a single rune are dozens of other runes that he must understand to progress. And to figure out a True Name, he must first understand every last rune for that True Name.
Kent let out a cold smile and focused on the first rune, letting his mind completely enter the rune. He planned on letting everything there is to know about the rune pour into his mind.
As expected, his mind was overwhelmed with so much information in the next second, causing him to turn pale instantly.
It took him some time to regain colour in his face. However, as he remained seated for a few minutes, his mind started to expand, allowing more information to pour in.
’So that is how it works, huh?’ A calm smile appeared on his face... ’All I have to do is understand the complex information that my Soul Map has captured.’
It turned out his Soul Map is not for show.
It is extremely powerful.

Just now, he tried to comprehend the rune using the old-fashioned way, only for his Soul Map to activate something called Universe Enigma, which instantly deciphered the rune and overwhelmed him with the meanings.
Then it moved to the next rune. The Soul Map is the one responsible for understanding the complex runes, and Kent would have to make sense of it.
It is on autopilot, so the more space appears in his mind, the more information is poured in.
Now, all he had to do was fully understand the information, which, in a way, would ease the load on his mind, allowing more details to come to mind.
’I guess Paragon had done me a great service. I should thank him properly the next time we meet.’ He smiled, feeling thankful.
As the Soul Map worked, his adaptability quality as a Chaos Dragon also slowly worked to take him closer to figuring out a True Name.
Eventually, Kent figured out the nature of the True Name he had been trying to understand. It took him just 3 days, but he figured it out.
’Night of Frozen Stars,’ he said inwardly, feeling happy; however, he also didn’t feel the need to learn this Ice.

Every True Name holds a specific aspect of Ice. The one he had somehow managed to figure out is more Mage-worthy Ice. It allows him to create a starry Ice object that, when unleashed, explodes on contact, freezing a large swath of space.
Of course, there are many ways to harness that. However, the core way of using such Ice is to explode it. That, in a way, makes it an Ice that a Mage will be happy with.
He has only one chance to learn the True Name of an Ice element and awaken it. Naturally, that means he must get something that matches his dragon spirit.
So Kent abandoned the Ice and focused on another. This time, it took him two and a half days to figure it out. But in the end, he abandoned that idea for a third one.
Somewhere in the same realm Kent is in, Ylthariel became amused by how Kent was switching between True Names.
In her experience, nobody would have time to choose which True Name to learn. They would be happy with whatever Name they get.
However, Kent actually has preferences. This, of course, shows just how monstrous he is.
He learned the nature of the two True Names of Ice and, in the end, chose not to bother learning the last aspect of it, which is the True Name.
Naturally, her amusement and shock only continued to increase as more time passed. It got to the point she could only stare at Kent like she had seen a monster.
In the end, after 12 days and 15 True Names later, he finally found the one he was looking for.

A calm smile appeared on his face as he moved through the knowledge the Soul Map had deposited in his mind. As a dragon, finding an Ice element that matches his chaotic heart and nature is ideal. As such, when he finally did, he instantly knew this was what he wanted.

Ylthariel also knew Kent had found what he wanted. However, that also didn’t take away the shock she had been through for the past 12 days. Kent is just not normal, like most would like to quantify him.
His existence doesn’t make sense.
Eventually, the nature of the Ice was revealed to him, or more like he finally understood it.
’Breath of the Last Dawn’

chapters.title: Chapter 1234: Eirwyn Thal’Shiver - Breath of the Last Dawn
paragraphs: Just figuring out the nature of the True Name is already good enough for Kent. He could feel the overwhelming might of the Ice Element he would be awakening if he were to learn the True Name of said Ice.
’This is going to be crazy’
Kent said, feeling his body tremble from sheer excitement.
Ylthariel also seemed happy he had finally found something he wanted.

The type of element he had picked, if he managed to learn it, then aside from breathing Chaos flames from his mouth, he would also be able to harness an even more dangerous form of Ice, one that can freeze the dawn of both reality and imagination.
Kent inhaled deeply, steadying his racing heartbeat. This is his moment, and so, he must work hard to grab it before it slips away.
The moment he learns the True Name, everything will change. His core would shift, his spirit turn super cold, and the very laws of Ice would carve themselves into his soul.
Naturally, there is a chance his dragon physique will have to reconstruct itself, adding a second nature to it. So instead of merely being a Chaos Flame, he would also hold Absolute Chaos Ice.
’Oh, the allure of freezing life with my breath attacks.’ A grin formed on his face, allowing the moment to get to him. The feeling of absolute coldness washed through him.
He placed his hand over the glowing rune that represented Breath of the Last Dawn.
Instantly, the entire monument trembled.
On the outside, where his body was cocooned, a wave of coldness washed through his body, causing the Ice stairway to freeze even colder.
Runa and Miryssa turned and looked at each other, but said nothing. However, shock could be seen in their eyes.
They recognised what was happening. After all, they were known as the 14 Chronicles of the Storm in the past.
Inside the monument, a crack of frigid light shot through the space, and the temperature fell so sharply that even Kent felt his skin prickle.
His breath came out as white mist, swirling unnaturally and forming frost patterns that resembled dying stars.
Just feeling the coldness on his skin is enough to tell him the path he is about to walk is dangerous.
His Soul Map stirred.
Then it awakened.
A colossal torrent of runic light surged into Kent’s mind, so heavy and ancient that even his Chaos Dragon’s somewhat powerful mind strained under its weight.
His muscles tightened. His bones froze. His blood felt like liquid ice seeping through the cracks of stones frozen in a cold winter.
But he didn’t stop.
He let the power flood him.
He let the runes burn their meaning into his soul.
The monument shook more violently as though something ancient was being forced awake against the fabric of creation itself. The entire phenomenon is so wild that even Ylthariel started to panic.
Naturally, it soon got to the point that she started to look concerned.
Ylthariel watched with wide eyes, her heart quivering in disbelief.
"This boy... is insane," she whispered. "He’s invoking it directly... without preparation. Without understanding its core essence."
Even the 14 Chronicles of the Storm, who had walked far on the Ice Dao, never dared to do this. It took them between 130 and 300 years to figure out just the nature of the ice.

Understanding the True Name and invoking it took them more than a thousand years. However, in just a day, Kent had already figured out the True Name of Ice and was even invoking it using the most dangerous method known to man — physical contact.

It had to be known that the current version of Kent is just his consciousness, his soul. So while he may be a monster in his physical body, his soul isn’t that robust. A slight mistake and he will die in an instant.
But then again, physical contact to invoke a True Name grants him more control over the Ice than if he were to invoke it using other methods.
Also, maybe he knew what he was doing. His soul isn’t exactly weak.
Kent clenched his fists, forcing himself to remain conscious as the True Name unfurled inside him like a frozen sun collapsing inward.
A whisper echoed across the void—cold, distant, eternal.
"Eirwyn Thal’Shiver"
Kent’s eyes snapped open.
A halo of pale-blue frost ignited behind him, spinning like a dying star trapped between life and extinction. The air shattered around him in crackling fragments of frozen dawnlight.
ROAR

Even in his human form, a roar came from his mouth, freezing the entire space around him. Even on the outside, standing atop the mountain, his wives and Miryssa had to take several steps back to escape the bitter coldness washing over their skin.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝐰𝚎𝕓𝐧𝚘𝘃𝗲𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝕞
"He has done it," Miryssa said with a shocked yet happy smile.
"After a very long time, someone had finally managed to learn the True Name of Ice. This is a universe-bending incident," Runa smiled happily, feeling proud of herself and her husband.
Kent had done it, and as such, his command of the Breath of Last Dawn Ice is now supreme and uncontested.
The rest of Kent’s wives looked happy when they heard what Runa said. Awakening Ice means he has secured another power that will aid him in the journey he is about to take.
Vexthra had already talked to them, and she will have an in-person meeting to see how best they can help their man.
They can’t help him when he enters the Star Gateway, so while he is on the outside, they will do their best.
Inside the monument, Kent opened his eyes. Cold mist of ice spilt out, freezing the air around him.
"I’ve done it," Kent muttered, feeling extreme joy.
"Yes, you did," Ylthariel said, appearing from thin air... "Though you used a rather unconventional method, you indeed have become the 15th member of the Chronicles of the Storm."
Kent gave Ylthariel a pale smile... "Lucky me, I guess."
Ylthariel nodded... "This will be it for our first meeting. Awakening an Ice element is the first step. Soon, you will gain a better understanding of it as you continue to use it."
Kent nodded. "Thank you for everything. Once I figure out what Ice means to me, I will be sure to answer your question better next time."
"I look forward to it."
Ylthariel waved her hand, and on the outside, the cocoon exploded, revealing Kent’s majestic physique now radiating cold, freezing Ice.

So while he may be a monster in his physical body, his soul isn’t that robust.
A slight mistake and he will die in an instant.
But then again, physical contact to invoke a True Name grants him more control over the Ice than if he were to invoke it using other methods.
Also, maybe he knew what he was doing.
His soul isn’t exactly weak.
Kent clenched his fists, forcing himself to remain conscious as the True Name unfurled inside him like a frozen sun collapsing inward.
A whisper echoed across the void—cold, distant, eternal.
"Eirwyn Thal’Shiver"
Kent’s eyes snapped open.
A halo of pale-blue frost ignited behind him, spinning like a dying star trapped between life and extinction.
The air shattered around him in crackling fragments of frozen dawnlight.
ROAR
Even in his human form, a roar came from his mouth, freezing the entire space around him.
Even on the outside, standing atop the mountain, his wives and Miryssa had to take several steps back to escape the bitter coldness washing over their skin.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝐰𝚎𝕓𝐧𝚘𝘃𝗲𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝕞
"He has done it," Miryssa said with a shocked yet happy smile.
"After a very long time, someone had finally managed to learn the True Name of Ice.
This is a universe-bending incident," Runa smiled happily, feeling proud of herself and her husband.
Kent had done it, and as such, his command of the Breath of Last Dawn Ice is now supreme and uncontested.
The rest of Kent’s wives looked happy when they heard what Runa said.
Awakening Ice means he has secured another power that will aid him in the journey he is about to take.
Vexthra had already talked to them, and she will have an in-person meeting to see how best they can help their man.
They can’t help him when he enters the Star Gateway, so while he is on the outside, they will do their best.
Inside the monument, Kent opened his eyes.
Cold mist of ice spilt out, freezing the air around him.
"I’ve done it," Kent muttered, feeling extreme joy.
"Yes, you did," Ylthariel said, appearing from thin air...
"Though you used a rather unconventional method, you indeed have become the 15th member of the Chronicles of the Storm."
Kent gave Ylthariel a pale smile...
"Lucky me, I guess."
Ylthariel nodded...
"This will be it for our first meeting.
Awakening an Ice element is the first step.
Soon, you will gain a better understanding of it as you continue to use it."
Kent nodded.
"Thank you for everything.
Once I figure out what Ice means to me, I will be sure to answer your question better next time."
"I look forward to it."
Ylthariel waved her hand, and on the outside, the cocoon exploded, revealing Kent’s majestic physique now radiating cold, freezing Ice.

paragraphs: "He is so hot right now," Selene said, barely holding back her lustful desire to pounce on Kent and devour him.

The upgraded version of Kent, who had now awakened the elemental Ice, had indeed become a cold handsome.
The other him is fiery and chaotic, even super destructive. However, he is now both subtle and extremely cold.
Of course, he isn’t cold as in making everyone distance themselves from him. If anything, his coldness seems to attract them even more.
That ice mist around him seemed to hold some attractive power that was causing them to barely hold back their urge to surround him and always be around him.
He is handsome and attractive, showing the contrast between fire and Ice.
Kent remained in the air for an hour, getting used to his new ability. His entire dragon physique had been reconstructed and upgraded to harness both Ice and Fire.
Of course, he would have to create ice-related skills. However, since he is a swordsman, he can easily harness the power of the Ice into powerful sword strikes.
’I can even attempt to replicate the [Divine Flame Armament] technique with the ice. A lot had changed, but he wanted to handle the immediate stuff first before getting into it.
After he was okay with his new changes, he turned toward his wives, who were standing atop the mountain peak.
Now that he had conquered all 1000 steps, he could use his Soul Map to look far and wide. This made it easy for him to spot them standing with Miryssa.
Naturally, he was happy to see them, so he quickly teleported to their side.
As expected from his wives, they immediately surrounded him and started kissing all over his body. They missed him so much, even though it had only been 14 days (tower time).
Well, they can miss him by just an hour, so 14 days is already a long enough time.

Miryssa stood on the side watching them. Her expression was complicated, so nobody would really know what was going on in her mind. However, one thing is sure: Kent had left an impression on her heart, one that she would forever remember.
Conquering the 1000 steps in just a day was something she never would have seen coming.
After many rounds of kissing, the ladies decided to take a pause and handle what needed to be dealt with next.
"Congratulations, Kent," Arien said, holding his left hand.
Runa, who was holding his right hand, her head resting on his shoulder, also said, "I knew you would never fail. You are too awesome to fail."
The rest of her sisters held the same smile and the same thoughts. They are both proud of their man. What he had accomplished was enough to show he could make it through any obstacle.
Kent smiled at Runa and kissed her forehead, "Thank you for everything, Runa. I couldn’t have done this without you."
Runa smiled and nodded, appearing like a baby receiving candy... "Reward me when you return from your mission."
"I will do more than that," Kent kissed her forehead again before turning to Miryssa, ignoring the jealous pout on the faces of the rest of his wives.
"Thank you for allowing me to take the trial."
Miryssa nodded, but she pointed at Runa, "You should thank her more than me. If it hadn’t been for her sending you here, I wouldn’t have even known you existed."
Kent smiled, turning his head to Runa before returning to Miryssa... "I very much exist."

Miryssa turned to Runa, who merely smiled and turned to Selene, who grinned and moved toward Miryssa... "Our home is a magical place where life as you know it is in full bloom." She paused and brushed a strand of hair off her face... "You can even walk around without clothes, and nobody will mind."

The ignorant Universal Goddess who awakened from a very long slumber when Runa’s True Name was invoked nodded to Kent’s proposal.
She had nowhere else to go, so she might as well join them inside the tower. Runa is both her friend, sister and teammate.
"Then let’s go. I must awaken Adina’s True Name and spend some time with you ladies before I leave."

This, of course, worked in Selene’s favour. She will have a good time spoiling her mind for her own insidious reason.
[Celestial Planet Nivraxis - The Ice Council]

After the Primordial Era, when the Great War nearly destroyed everything, the few powerhouses that remained decided to form several councils to build up strength for the next time another calamity would arrive.
One of the said councils is the Ice Council.
They are a group of Ice cultivators who had walked the Ice Path to the peak and, using their experience, created a council for all who use the Ice element.
The headquarters of the Ice Council is located in a place that those without special Ice Physique or constitution cannot reach.
At the moment, inside a frost-sculpted castle where the law of Ice could be visibly seen in the air, 10 Celestials sat staring at a projection of a tomb.
On this tomb are 15 names, the last of which is one they recognised all too well.
It is Kent’s name, the same Kent Madson who had shaken the entire universe when his name appeared on the Sword Dao Tablet.
This time, his name had appeared on the Ice Dao Tablet, a feat nobody was able to accomplish since the fall of the Primordial Era.
Only the 14 Chronicles of the Storm were able to do it. Many tried to accomplish what led to the 14 names appearing on the Ice Dao Tablet, but couldn’t.

Now, Kent had done it, and looking at the expressions on the faces of 10 of the most respected and powerful Celestials in the universe, they clearly wanted to get their hands on Kent and find out how he managed to invoke the True Name of Ice.

"Send out word. Whoever can get to Kent Madson and bring him to any of the Ice Temples will be rewarded heavily by the Ice Council," Aethernox Vael, the Council Head, said, and the nine council members nodded.
Soon, another hunt for Kent had appeared.
Naturally, in every high world in the universe, the most influential and powerful of them all is now Kent. No name can rival him.
In fact, calling him the Overlord of the High World is ideal. After all, even now, Celestials had started looking for him, and they won’t stop until they get what they want from him.
Words quickly spread everywhere...

chapters.title: Chapter 1236: The Pink Lady
paragraphs: Once upon a time, they called her the Pink Lady.
Long before the Dark War, a young succubus loved by her people due to her talent in cultivation chose to walk a path no succubus had ever tread before.
She chose to cultivate the old-fashioned way rather than rely on the succubus’s path of absorbing essence from the men they sleep with.
Because of her decision, she was shunned and banished from her tribe, citing she was a disgrace to all succubus.
However, despite this humiliation, she didn’t give up.
She instead channelled the hatred and the need to prove herself into cultivating.

Soon, the legendary illusionist whose zither music could overwhelm all minds was born. Nobody knew where she gained the knowledge of such reality-bending illusions from. However, when she appeared again, her own tribe couldn’t recognise her.
The succubus they knew had changed.
During the Dark Era, when the Dark Creatures had invaded the universe, the warriors deployed forces to defend against the 12 Dark Gates. They believed those were the only gates that opened.
However, they were wrong... utterly wrong.
There was a 13th gate.
That gate was well hidden, and the creatures that came through that gate were so powerful that gods would have cowered before them.

However, while the rest of the universe was blinded by the chaos the 12 gates brought, the one the universe came to know as the Pink Lady saw through the illusion, and so she waited for them to arrive.
When they did, she poured herself into weaving the most intricate illusion, one that remains active to this day.
In the end, she sacrificed her life for the universe, making sure the 10,002 Dark Creatures remained forever trapped in the illusion that not even Celestials dare approach.
The universe, knowing this, gave her a True Name, believing that one day she would return to end what she had started.
She sacrificed, just like the many who fell in great wars, to save the universe, and, as such, she was given a second life, this time preparing well to end what she couldn’t during the Dark Era.
Kent and his wives looked up in the air, staring at a pink mist.
From within the pink mist, a bone-chilling cold could be felt. However, instead of freezing them to death like Runa’s ice, this coldness seemed to hypnotise rather than kill.
"My mind is spinning," Arien said, holding Kent’s shoulder for support.
"Strange, this coldness is entering my mind instead of affecting my body." Elsa narrowed her eyes at the mist. The more she breathes, the more bone-chilling coldness seeps into her mind.

"It is the Hypnotic Ice," Miryssa suddenly said... "I have only heard about this type of ice from my master. From what she said, the Hypnotic Ice was wielded long ago by an illusionist whose illusions couldn’t be distinguished from reality.
From what I know, the more you remain within its range, the more it affects your mind until your brain completely freezes solid. Once that happens, not even a Celestial could save you."
The ladies and Kent turned and looked at the pink mist again, suddenly feeling a chill run down their spines.
"Relax, ladies, Adina is one of you. She wouldn’t hurt you or anyone," Kent said with a chuckle.
"Somehow, I don’t believe you. I mean, Zaila once mind-controlled me just because she wanted to have her turn early with your dick," Selene said, looking suspiciously at the mist.
Inside the pink mist, Adina was undergoing her evolution. The evolution was turning her into a succubus whose illusion could bend reality itself.
Kent smiled and walked forward, ready to invoke the True Name.
Meanwhile, Miryssa just stood on the side watching all this with an unreadable expression. She was a foreigner there after all.
Once Kent was close to the pink mist, he took a deep breath and started to speak...

"Banished from her tribe, she chose not to compromise. Instead, she decided to walk forward with her shoulders held high. She chose to embrace the path she deemed worthy of her, and in the end, she became the saviour of the universe.

Many called her the Pink Lady, and some called her the Mistress of Living Illusions. However, the universe called her Velaryssae Nocti’Rosam Aethernox, She Who Sings the Rose-Veiled Night into Truth."
"Rise, Velaryssae Nocti’Rosam Aethernox, your destiny is calling."
TING
Just when Kent invoked her True Name, a single note from a zither entered his mind, instantly plunging him into an illusion.
He wasn’t even able to mount a single defence. The pink mist swallowed him whole.
His mind was overwhelmed in an instant. Before he knew it, he was inside the illusion, standing face to face with the most beautiful lady he had ever set his eyes on.
Adina had become even more beautiful. Her facial features had been enhanced to reflect her lustful nature as a succubus.
She had long, flowing, soft-pink hair, shimmering like silk under moonlight. Two smooth, rose-pink horns curved gently backwards, thin veins of soft pink light pulsing beneath their surface.
She had flawless porcelain skin with a constant warm blush. Just staring at her beautiful face was enough to mesmerise.
Her beautiful eyes are amethyst-pink, layered with illusion upon illusion. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say those who stared too long began to see things they desired... or feared.
Kent didn’t know if it was because he was there, but looking at her lips, they naturally curved into a gentle, dangerous smile.
She sat on a pink throne made of jade crystals. Of course, she wouldn’t be a succubus if she were short. She was, in fact, tall, voluptuous, and perfectly proportioned.
Her boobs were much bigger and firmer, standing on her chest like they possessed life of their own.
Only a thin layer of clothing held them in place.
However, Kent could see the pink nipples pressed against the nearly transparent lingerie she had on. This sight is magical, something only he was privileged to see.
GULP
The Chaos Dragon gulped, looking at the succubus smiling at him.
’Oh no. I guess I have hurt her too in the past, huh?’ The smile that Liora and Enzi gave him was the same one Adina wore.
Obviously, he had already attributed that smile to a bad omen.
All the ladies who had that smile were hurt in the past by a version of him. So he could already see that happening again.

"I am going to take a wild guess here," she said, standing from her chair and starting to catwalk toward him... "You somehow had managed to worm your way into my loving heart, and now, all you are waiting for is to claim me and finally make me yours."

She chuckled and gently tapped Kent on the shoulder... "That is cute and romantic, you know. Not many would have the patience to wait for me to reach the stage where having sex won’t affect my cultivation.
So the fact that you even went out of your way to make me happy while we wait, I suppose I am here now to say thank you."
Contrary to what Kent expected, the smile wasn’t a bad omen, but rather, one that showed how thankful the succubus was to have someone like Kent in her life.

chapters.title: Chapter 1237: Hope
paragraphs: The Pink Lady was banished from her tribe. Her parents, siblings, friends, and entire tribe despised her simply for choosing to walk a path no succubus had ever dared to tread.
Because of this, she was left to fend for herself, thereby becoming lonely and forgotten by all she would have loved to talk with.
Instead of the love and support of a family, she was cast out, and for millions of years, she never had the love she needed.
However, in this new life that the universe had given her, she had amazing sisters who not only loved her but also adored and respected her choices.

She also had a man in her life who didn’t dislike her because of the limitations on her body as a woman. If anything, now that she could remember part of her past life, she was more grateful to Kent than anything.
He was caring and loving. He even went out of his way to make her happy simply because he thought she wasn’t happy enough.
The emotion that such a selfless act of love and kindness created led her to embrace Kent in a tight, warm hug. She is grateful. Her past self is eternally grateful.
"I love you very much, Kent. I will always love, cherish, and respect you," Adina said, causing Kent to feel a warmth in his chest.

The men want the female Sky Foxes, and the women want the male Sky Foxes.

Aside from her, the rest have seven tails and below, showing her authority as the strongest among the Sky Foxes.
Although Tianpeng referred to her as Old Lady, she, in fact, looks relatively younger than most of the youngsters there, despite living for close to 60,000 years already.
She led her people to the floating island 5000 years ago. Today, she stood before them again with hope that today, too, shall pass.
"My Sky Fox race will not become a plaything to your kind ever again." She pointed at a Human man standing in front of the Humans who had come to attack the floating island.
He is about 40; however, he is much older than that. He is the leader of the Humans, Yun Wusheng and the one person Liora wanted dead more than anything.
"The Sky Priestess trusted you to protect my kind. However, you not only killed her, but you even colluded with the demons to kill her daughter, your own daughter.
She gave you everything you have today. However, instead of repaying kindness with kindness, you turned into a backstabbing cocksucker who only knows how to bend for the Beast.
Are you not ashamed to even show your face here?"

Yun Wusheng’s expression turned sour hearing what Yuyin said. Those words were bitter to hear. Although she appeared harmless and innocent on the surface, her words were in fact much more bitter than they should be.
However, what she said was indeed true.
In the past, the Humans protected them, and in return, they aided them with their cultivations using illusion. It was a profitable alliance, one that lasted for a while.

However, when the Fox Priestess who married Yun Wusheng was killed, the Humans revealed their true colours. Now, it seems they had fallen much deeper now that the Beasts had them wrapped around their pinky.
The Beasts had always had this predatory authority that made them think the entirety of Planet Tianxu was theirs to rule.
So while the Sky Fox posed no threat to them, suppressing them and using them as their pawns would, of course, benefit them in the long run.
It was just that the Humans aren’t weak either. In fact, the Humans are much more resilient than the Beasts would like to admit.
Yun Wusheng has many secrets up his sleeve that scare both the Beasts and the Sky Fox. So while Tianpeng addressed Yuyin, her reply was directed toward Yun Wusheng.
In her mind, the main threat is the humans.
"I won’t waste words on you, Yuyin. You and I know that at the end of the day, your kind would have to bow to us or risk getting annihilated.
It is a written rule that went into effect the moment your useless priestess stood in my way to greatness. So I will advise you to surrender and let us have what we came here for."
Yun Wusheng sneered, his expression showing signs of lust and evil.
"My Sky Fox race will not bow to your kind or anybody. So if you want a fight, then you will get one." Yuyin turned to her right, then to her left.
The expressions on her people’s faces broke her heart. They are afraid, but they didnt want to show it. They want to look brave for the young ones.
"We either fight or go back to being slaves. I refuse to be a slave to useless men. So I will fight with all I have... that includes my life."

Her words spread throughout the floating island, causing mothers to cover their children in their protective embraces, creating the illusion that they would be protected as long as they remained with them.
The warriors also tightened their holds on their staffs, ready to weave illusions that they knew deep down would only prolong the inevitable.

"If you carry the pride of the Sky Fox, then even in your dying breath, do not surrender to these filths calling themselves Humans. Show them the spirit of the Sky Fox and die with a smile on your faces."
She took a deep breath, then her eyes emitted a faint pink mist... "Activate the Sky Killing Array."
In an instant, a large array opened over the sky, manifesting a colossal Eight-Tailed Fox. The feeling of dread instantly fell on everyone.
"ATTACK!"
All around, the Beasts and the Humans activated their skills and techniques and charged forward.
However, before any of them could get near the floating island, a suffocating darkness erupted and instantly covered the entirety of the floating city.
All who were 200 meters away from the floating city were swallowed by the darkness and instantly erased from existence.

chapters.title: Chapter 1240: A Simple Question with Deadly Consequences
paragraphs: Their screams were loud but didn’t last. In less than 2 seconds, over 7,000 warriors were devoured by the darkness filled with the power of death.
Even the Heavenly Ascension warriors rushing to the city survived only because they reacted quickly. Some even burned their life force to free themselves from the insidious darkness.
Of course, not all of them came out alive.
For a moment, everything turned quiet.
CRACK
The sound of something breaking broke the silence. It echoed in the darkness, travelling as far as thousands of kilometres.
CRACK
A second crack appeared, and this time it was accompanied by a voice so chilling that when it was heard, everyone took a step back.
"So killing my mother isn’t enough. You had to kill her people, too." This voice, Yun Wusheng instantly recognised it.
Of course he did. After all, he had heard it many times in the past when he was a loving husband and a good father. He heard it many times when the owner was young and innocent.
Then, when she became a teenager, he heard it many times. Even when she became an adult woman ready to rely on herself, he heard it many times, too.
In fact, although he has many wives, he recognised the voice that spoke because, in the past, on one warm evening about 10,000 years ago, this voice promised to return one day and kill him.
So when he heard it again, he recognised it.
However, unlike 10,000 years ago when he sneered and ordered his lieutenant to shoot his own daughter through the chest, this time, he felt fear.
But his fear only deepened when a man also spoke in a somewhat joking tone... "Looks like you losers are fucked."
CRACK
A third crack sounded in the air, and that was when Liora made her appearance. She was clad in leather armour designed to look more stylish than armour should.
It clung to her skin, bringing out her sinful body.
Below where she stood, the void cracked, forming spider webs. Her expression was cold, and the aura of death could be seen emanating from her body.
She locked her gaze on Yun Wusheng, who trembled looking into the eyes of the daughter he had tried to kill 10,000 years ago after he killed her mother... his own wife.
"Hello, pops, looks like you have fallen even deeper than before." Liora chuckled... then added in a voice filled with disdain... "What a waste of life."
Yun Wusheng would like to be angry at Liora for calling him a waste of life. However, looking at the dark aura coming off her, he dared not.

Of course, while he wasn’t alone in the endeavour to suppress the Sky Fox race, he knew Liora didn’t come alone. He heard a second voice, that of a male. That voice may have sounded amused, but he had lived long enough to sense danger when he heard one.
So he only stood there with all his thoughts burning in his head. He dared not speak them out loud...
Liora smirked as if she could read his mind and instead turned to Tianpeng... "I have always disliked you," Liora said, her expression turning from disdain to intent to kill.
"I don’t know if it was your ugly looks or the fact that you dress like a woman, but I always dreamt of the day I would torture you by skinning you alive. Today, my dream will be fulfilled."

Tianpeng flinched and was about to say something or maybe make a run for it. Either way, before he could make any move, a handsome dragon man appeared and placed his hand on his shoulder...𝐟𝐫𝕖𝗲𝘄𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝕧𝐞𝚕.𝕔𝕠𝐦
"No, not so fast, buddy. My wife needs you alive to be tortured."
Kent’s hand moved and knocked Tianpeng out. It was quick and decisive — happened in under a second.
Seeing this, all the Beast warriors panicked. However, before any of them could move, Kent waved his hand, and a powerful pressure fell on them, halting everyone in their place.
Every last one of them broke into cold sweats instantly.
"It will be comforting to accept that none of you will be leaving here today, so relax and wait for your death." He turned and gave a wink at Liora, who blushed but quickly returned to her cold self.
Kent just smiled and threw Tianpeng into the mountain garden, where Uncle Drew and the four demigods were having their afternoon tea.
Naturally, staying with Kent was a better idea. Once he wakes up, he would wish he had never laid a finger on the Sky Fox.
But by then, it would be too late for him.

On Planet Tianxu, Liora turned back to Yun Wusheng... "I only have one question for you. You would do well to answer because failure to give me the answer I seek will result in a pain so painful your soul would wish death came early."
Yun Wusheng trembled; however, he didn’t have the luxury even to make a peep...
Liora went ahead and asked her question... "Why did you kill my mother?"
Yun Wusheng didn’t dare lie. He quickly answered the question he was asked...
"I killed your mother for the Supreme Sky Fox Inheritance."
Liora’s expression changed instantly. She made a grabbing motion, and from the ground, Yun Wusheng felt his life pierced by an invisible force.
The feeling was piercing and instant. He felt his body lifted off the ground, and before he knew it, he was face-to-face with Liora.
"You killed my mother because of a myth." Her voice was cold like ice and piercing like a dagger. Yun Wusheng felt his soul shudder, threatening to abandon him.
"It isn’t a myth. Your mother found the Supreme Sky Fox inheritance. However, she never got to use it because..."
"Because you killed her."
"She was supposed to give it to me as she promised. However, when she found it, she instead gave it to you." Yun Wusheng’s jealousy and lust for power gave him the energy to raise his voice at Liora.
A long time ago, he was supposed to receive the inheritance that every last Sky Fox wished to possess. In his mind, he was the one meant to have it despite being a Human.
It was a promise the Fox Priestess made him when she married him as a contract to gain the protection of the Humans.
However, when what he sought was found, instead of giving it to him, the Fox Priestess gave it to her daughter, who had no idea she possessed something even the Supremes would lust after.
"So you killed my mother over something that can never be yours in the first place. You are no Fox, yet you thought something that belongs to Foxes can be yours."
Yun Wusheng felt his back break into sweat. The confidence he gathered just now crumbled. Fear overwhelmed his mind and body.
"I am going to kill you, but first, watch me slaughter every last warrior that followed you here." Liora tapped his forehead, and his body was frozen in place.
Two daggers appeared in her hands, and a half mask that only covered her mouth up to her nose appeared on her face.
In an instant, she went from a beauty to a deadly beauty dressed in black,

chapters.title: Chapter 1241: Yun Wusheng’s Fate
paragraphs: In what should have been a happy reunion between a father and his daughter, it had now turned into a slaughter unlike any Planet Tianxu had ever witnessed.
The massacre that should have been dealt to the Sky Fox was instead being subjected to their oppressors.
Liora is like a shadow.
Wherever she moved, heads and blood flew into the air.

She promised a massacre of every last one, so with Kent’s assistance, using 1000 blood runes to suppress the Beasts and Humans, she was basically moving from one warrior to the next, cutting their heads off.
She wasnt even putting in much effort.
If only Yun Wusheng hadn’t got greedy over something that he could never have, all of this would have been prevented.

The Supreme Sky Fox inheritance is something rumoured to hold the power to make a Sky Fox Supreme. They said it contains the pure blood of a Supreme Sky Fox that once ruled a vast part of the Universe.
That legendary Fox, from what is known, was one of the 12 Calamity Beasts that followed the Divine Beast Tamer.
Naturally, a legacy from him was something that, when ordinary people get their hands on it, their lives will never be the same.
However, it was only a rumour until apparently it wasn’t.

It turned out that the late Fox Priestess had found it in the ancestral ruins of the Sky Fox race and given it to Liora instead of Yun Wusheng. That had triggered him into killing Liora’s mother and, in a way, nearly ended up killing Liora too.
Now, the decisions he had made have, in a way, come back to haunt him.
Liora came back for blood, and now that she had awakened her True Name and bloodline, she had no use for said legacy... just revenge that she had dreamt of many times over.
Kent stood on the side, a faint smile on his face as he watched Liora vent her frustration. She had long wanted to get her revenge after all.
Although she said nothing to him, she already had plans with her sisters to come back one day to take her revenge. Now, it seems only she is enough.
"What a pity. What could have been a father-daughter bonding session had now turned into a slaughter. Makes me wonder just what kind of scum you are."
Kent appeared beside the frozen Yun Wusheng, who was watching the slaughter happening around him, but he was powerless to do anything.
After his session with his wives, Kent decided to resume his mission. But first, he brought Liora back to visit her mother’s side of the family.
Her mom was a Sky Fox. Her father, of course, is the scum who was colluding with the Beast to suppress the Sky Foxes.
Kent only wanted to bring her back, and then he would be on his way after meeting the Sky Fox. However, just when they arrived, they noticed the Sky Fox race was in danger.

Naturally, with him around, this worked in Liora’s favour. So, without even holding back, she decided to vent her anger on all who stood against the only family she had. The only family linked to her mother.
There are only about 100,006 Sky Foxes on Planet Tianxu, so the idea that they would be facing odds about 20 times their number is just too barbaric. Their number would have reduced even further.
Thankfully, Kent and Liora arrived when they did.
"You can never honestly tell just what goes on in the mind of idiots. You killed her mother and tried to kill her. Now you want to oppress her family.
I dont know if you are just stupid or your brain cells are just completely useless. Among all the women you could have suppressed, you picked the one I love.
I mean, scums like you shouldn’t even be allowed around women. You don’t qualify to even smile at them.
Now, when she is done wiping out your warriors, I will make sure your name is forever wiped from every mind and forgotten.
However, instead of a painless death, I am going to take my time to kill you, making sure every passing second feels more painful than the last.
Of course, you will grow numb to the pain at one point. However, as long as I live and breathe, I will always find a way to make you scream."
Kent walked in front of him and looked him in the eye... "That is my promise to you, father-in-law."
The smile that followed made Yun Wusheng see Liora as an angel. The smile on Kent’s face is too evil for him not to break into severe panic.
However, no matter how much he panicked, he knew his life from here on would be painful. The dragon man before him is just too scary.
In less than an hour, every last soul was dead. Their headless bodies littered the ground. Like she promised, not even a single warrior was spared.
Their blood had been used to appease the weapon of the Universe. Liora was once the weapon the universe used to handle scums that sought to destroy everything.
She had killed abominations that can’t even be mentioned out loud. She alone had done the universe so much service that when she died, they became sad, so they gave her a second chance at life.
Now that she is back, she has done what she has always wanted to do. She came back to protect her people.

Although she isn’t a Sky Fox, despite her mother being one, at heart, they are her people, and so protecting them was a way of showing her late mother that she would never let anything happen to them.
Now, she had done just that.
"What should we do with this scum?" Kent asked, pushing Yun Wusheng forward just as Liora returned to his side... He then added, "Killing him will be mercy. I suggest we torture him first."
Liora looked at her father for a few seconds before she nodded, "When Velyra comes out from seclusion, we will get on that."
Kent nodded with a smile. He knew his redskin beauty was perfect for what he had in mind. With Velyra’s control over blood, unless she wanted to, Yun Wusheng would never die.
She can torture and skin him alive, but as long as he had blood in his body, she would be able to keep him alive for as long as possible.
Basically, Yun Wusheng is fucked for life.
Kent seeks only one thing: to make his wives happy.

He didn’t want to see them sad in any way. So whenever he finds out someone had done something to any of them in the past that still haunts them, then, as a good husband, getting back at them is only appropriate.
Yun Wusheng had killed his mother-in-law and tried to kill his wife. As such, he helped her get her revenge. However, the man in question would have to be subjected to a different kind of torture.
This time, he wants her happy, and if torturing her old man will do that, then he is also delighted. In the end, it is her happiness he seeks.

She promised a massacre of every last one, so with Kent’s assistance, using 1000 blood runes to suppress the Beasts and Humans, she was basically moving from one warrior to the next, cutting their heads off.
She wasnt even putting in much effort.
If only Yun Wusheng hadn’t got greedy over something that he could never have, all of this would have been prevented.
The Supreme Sky Fox inheritance is something rumoured to hold the power to make a Sky Fox Supreme.
They said it contains the pure blood of a Supreme Sky Fox that once ruled a vast part of the Universe.
That legendary Fox, from what is known, was one of the 12 Calamity Beasts that followed the Divine Beast Tamer.
Naturally, a legacy from him was something that, when ordinary people get their hands on it, their lives will never be the same.
However, it was only a rumour until apparently it wasn’t.
It turned out that the late Fox Priestess had found it in the ancestral ruins of the Sky Fox race and given it to Liora instead of Yun Wusheng.
That had triggered him into killing Liora’s mother and, in a way, nearly ended up killing Liora too.
Now, the decisions he had made have, in a way, come back to haunt him.
Liora came back for blood, and now that she had awakened her True Name and bloodline, she had no use for said legacy... just revenge that she had dreamt of many times over.
Kent stood on the side, a faint smile on his face as he watched Liora vent her frustration.
She had long wanted to get her revenge after all.
Although she said nothing to him, she already had plans with her sisters to come back one day to take her revenge.
Now, it seems only she is enough.
"What a pity.
What could have been a father-daughter bonding session had now turned into a slaughter.
Makes me wonder just what kind of scum you are."
Kent appeared beside the frozen Yun Wusheng, who was watching the slaughter happening around him, but he was powerless to do anything.
After his session with his wives, Kent decided to resume his mission.
But first, he brought Liora back to visit her mother’s side of the family.
Her mom was a Sky Fox.
Her father, of course, is the scum who was colluding with the Beast to suppress the Sky Foxes.
Kent only wanted to bring her back, and then he would be on his way after meeting the Sky Fox.
However, just when they arrived, they noticed the Sky Fox race was in danger.
Naturally, with him around, this worked in Liora’s favour.
So, without even holding back, she decided to vent her anger on all who stood against the only family she had.
The only family linked to her mother.
There are only about 100,006 Sky Foxes on Planet Tianxu, so the idea that they would be facing odds about 20 times their number is just too barbaric.
Their number would have reduced even further.
Thankfully, Kent and Liora arrived when they did.
"You can never honestly tell just what goes on in the mind of idiots.
You killed her mother and tried to kill her.
Now you want to oppress her family.
I dont know if you are just stupid or your brain cells are just completely useless.
Among all the women you could have suppressed, you picked the one I love.
I mean, scums like you shouldn’t even be allowed around women.
You don’t qualify to even smile at them.
Now, when she is done wiping out your warriors, I will make sure your name is forever wiped from every mind and forgotten.
However, instead of a painless death, I am going to take my time to kill you, making sure every passing second feels more painful than the last.
Of course, you will grow numb to the pain at one point.
However, as long as I live and breathe, I will always find a way to make you scream."
Kent walked in front of him and looked him in the eye...
"That is my promise to you, father-in-law."
The smile that followed made Yun Wusheng see Liora as an angel.
The smile on Kent’s face is too evil for him not to break into severe panic.
However, no matter how much he panicked, he knew his life from here on would be painful.
The dragon man before him is just too scary.
In less than an hour, every last soul was dead.
Their headless bodies littered the ground.
Like she promised, not even a single warrior was spared.
Their blood had been used to appease the weapon of the Universe.
Liora was once the weapon the universe used to handle scums that sought to destroy everything.
She had killed abominations that can’t even be mentioned out loud.
She alone had done the universe so much service that when she died, they became sad, so they gave her a second chance at life.
Now that she is back, she has done what she has always wanted to do.
She came back to protect her people.

Although she isn’t a Sky Fox, despite her mother being one, at heart, they are her people, and so protecting them was a way of showing her late mother that she would never let anything happen to them.
Now, she had done just that.
"What should we do with this scum?" Kent asked, pushing Yun Wusheng forward just as Liora returned to his side...
He then added, "Killing him will be mercy.
I suggest we torture him first."
Liora looked at her father for a few seconds before she nodded, "When Velyra comes out from seclusion, we will get on that."
Kent nodded with a smile.
He knew his redskin beauty was perfect for what he had in mind.
With Velyra’s control over blood, unless she wanted to, Yun Wusheng would never die.
She can torture and skin him alive, but as long as he had blood in his body, she would be able to keep him alive for as long as possible.
Basically, Yun Wusheng is fucked for life.
Kent seeks only one thing: to make his wives happy.
He didn’t want to see them sad in any way.
So whenever he finds out someone had done something to any of them in the past that still haunts them, then, as a good husband, getting back at them is only appropriate.
Yun Wusheng had killed his mother-in-law and tried to kill his wife.
As such, he helped her get her revenge.
However, the man in question would have to be subjected to a different kind of torture.
This time, he wants her happy, and if torturing her old man will do that, then he is also delighted.
In the end, it is her happiness he seeks.

chapters.title: Chapter 1242: Meeting The Sky Fox
paragraphs: Kent threw Yun Wusheng into the Mountain Garden. He could have sent him straight into the Tower Prison. However, he wants Uncle Drew and the others to have some fun torturing him first.
When he arrived, Tianpeng, who had already woken up, was hanging upside down by an invisible thread, blood coming off his nose, mouth, eyes, and ears.
It had already been a day inside the tower, so he had long woken up.
The sight of his most trusted allies hanging, blood coming out of his nose and other orifices, terrified him, causing him to make a run for it.
He was just too scared to face whoever was hanging Tianpeng. Although his legs and hands were moving as if he were running, he couldn’t even take a single step.
It was like he had been left in a suspended animation where he could move but couldn’t make a run for it.
Inside the garden, Avotha smirked.
This was his doing. The others didn’t want to dirty their hands, so the abyss dragon chose to do that for them.
He bent space around him, creating the illusion that he was running several miles per second when, in fact, he was in the same place from the start.

As for Tianpeng, he wove a deadly battle into his mind. In the battle, Tianpeng somehow managed to escape from the four of them and was slaughtering his way out. In his mind, he would soon regain his freedom.
When the illusion breaks, he is going to find himself suspended in the air, bleeding profusely. The freedom he seeks is something he would never obtain.
For the time being, he will keep them in this state. Once he grows bored, he will send them into the new and upgraded Tower Prison.
Meanwhile, on the outside, Kent held Liora’s hands, staring into her eyes... "Are you alright?" Kent may be okay with her getting her revenge.
However, he also knew he had to check on her mental health.
She had just slaughtered over 40,000 people in her quest for revenge. Of course, she was an assassin before she became an alchemist.
In that life, she had killed her fair share of scums. However, Kent knew this scale of massacre wasn’t something she had committed before.

So naturally, there were bound to be some side effects. However, he seems to have forgotten Liora isnt the same person anymore. She had changed, and with that change came her now robust mental strength.
Liora merely smiled and nodded, "I am fine, Kent. No need to worry about me."
"Don’t be silly, Liora. I am your husband, so of course I’m going to worry about you." He brushes a strand of hair from her face and wipes the sweat off her forehead.
"I will always worry about you"
Liora blushed, but she leaned in for a kiss.
"I promise I am fine, Kent. I finally managed to defeat my heart demon and saved my people, so I am fine."
Kent nodded.
However, hearing that Yun Wusheng was Liora’s heart demon, he made a mental note to take pleasure in torturing him.
Heart demons had ruined many powerful people. Once a cultivator develops one, they will face many roadblocks in their path to immortality. Of course, there are ways to remove heart demons.
Many had done it before, just like Liora had.
However, every heart demon has a unique way to remove them. If not removed in time, it could become permanent. And, to some extent, even transform the person into a twisted version of themselves.
Alina developed a heart demon from her past trauma when Kent met her. Thankfully, she was able to move forward after Kent helped her kill the bastard.
Now, Liora had also handled her heart demon, freeing herself from future struggles. Kent could only hope and pray she would be the last of his wives to have one.
Kent hugged her, but instead of feeling comfort, Liora shuddered as a cold aura emanated from him. The dangerous thoughts running through his mind seem to be influencing him.
The space around them froze solid. However, he quickly recalled the ice... He would need some more training to have a good handle on his ice element.
"Sorry, I guess I was just angry that bastard nearly ruined you."
Liora smiled, "It’s alright. He is now in our hands. Also, I don’t feel the heart demon again, so we will take our time to torture him."
"I like the sound of that," Kent grinned and kissed her again before turning toward the black mist. She also turned to the floating island, still covered by the black mist.
"What should we do with them?" Liora asked.
"Let’s talk to them first and see if they will be up to moving into the tower. If they decline, then we will figure something out for them."
She nodded and waved her hand, clearing the dark mist. When everything cleared, and the Sky Foxes saw the massacre that had occurred, they all turned pale, fear gripping them.
"Aunty Yuyin, glad to see you are still breathing," Liora said, turning Yuyin’s attention to her.
When her eyes landed on Liora, all fear was replaced by genuine happiness. Although Liora had changed in terms of appearance, Yuyin recognised her in a heartbeat.
"Little Lola, is that you?" She wanted to take a step forward; however, before she could move, Liora was already standing in front of her.
"Yes, Aunty, it is me, Liora." What followed was a big and heartfelt hug. Kent remained behind, staring at the two ladies’ hug.

The only living relative Liora has aside from the entire Sky Fox race is Yuyin. She is Liora’s mother’s little sister. When Liora was just a child, she always took care of her when her mother was away.
Since the Sky Priestess was akin to the Queen of the Sky Foxes, Liora was the princess. However, her mother was extremely busy, so Yuyin raised her.
Yuyin went out of her way to make sure she had everything despite her coming out as a human instead of a Sky Fox. Her mother was a Sky Fox, and her father was a human after all.
It can even be said that she shielded Liora from the rest of the Sky Foxes, who believe a human cannot be a princess and possibly a queen of their race.
So she is happy to see her again. She had been worried about her when she chose to run from her father thousands of years ago.
Now, as it turned out, the human they despised came back when they needed help, and now looking around, they can boldly say the peace they needed had returned to them... at least for a while.
After the hug, Liora quickly introduced Kent... "Aunty, this is my husband."
Kent smiled and moved toward them in a single step. His commanding presence instantly drew Yuyin’s attention.
Yet again, Liora didn’t tell him she still has an Aunty and a beautiful one at that. Although Kent already has a Nine-Tailed Fox in his harem, Arien is a Void Fox, while Yuyin is a Sky Fox.

Of course, Kent also didn’t know Liora was a princess and that her father killed her mother. All he knew was that she left to pursue her dream as an assassin, which she did, but later had to create a second identity.
It was through that life that she met her. Now, it seems he is bound to learn more about her from her aunt, whom Kent also found a liking for.
"Pleasure meeting you, Yuyin," Kent said with a smile, causing Liora to blush while Yuyin shook her head.
It took only a single glance for Yuyin to recognise the kind of monster shaking hands with her. However, she swallowed her fear.
"You can call me Yuyin... no need to add the Aunty."
Kent smiled and gave her a firm nod.
"In that case, you can also call me Kent Madson..."
Yuyin froze.
Liora giggled, and Kent merely smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1243: Yuyin
paragraphs: Kent, of course, chose to reveal his true self to Yuyin since she is Liora’s aunt.
However, as for whether he enjoys seeing the shock on the faces of all those he reveals himself to, the look on Yuyin’s face at the moment answers that.

It amuses Kent whenever people learn his true identity and become shocked. Of course, he understood that his existence, to many, is profound. However, as time passed, he expected them to at least relax a bit when learn of his true identity.
But since they always go through shock, he can only enjoy it and hope that one day his identity won’t make many people’s jaws drop.
All those after him with nefarious intentions, of course, have to wait until he reaches the immortal worlds. He had not yet done anything drastic to them... well, Uncle Drew did a number on them.
But Kent had yet to handle them. Of course, he also knew that going after them would be bullying them at this point. So the immortal words will be the best place to handle them.
There, perhaps spreading his name wouldn’t be something he would indulge much since, regardless of how he sees it, against demigods and immortals, he would need more than his own strength.
He would need help.
But to avoid putting his people in danger, he would have to decide whether revealing his identity was the right move.
Of course, as the chaos dragon, there is bound to be chaos wherever he goes.
After five minutes of getting used to the fact that the legendary Kent Madson is the one standing before her, Yuyin recovered.
She first turned to Liora, who only smiled and gave her a slight nod. This was all the confirmation she needed. The Kent Madson she had heard of is now her niece’s husband.
When she finally came to terms with that, a smile appeared on her face.
"Nice meeting you, Kent Madson."
Kent nodded and responded, "Nice meeting you, too, Yuyin."
"Please, come with me," she started, leading the way toward the centre of the island.
Thousands of Sky Foxes are still frozen in shock, staring at the lifeless and headless bodies of the thousands of humans and beasts that Liora had killed.
Some recovered, and so when Yuyin was leading Kent and Liora away, they spotted them. They could only wonder just what humans are doing on their floating island.
Of course, the quick ones caught up on who Kent and Liora are. Seeing the thousands dead, they knew someone was responsible. So they quickly pegged those someones to Kent and Liora.
Also, Kent’s dragon form calmed them down a bit. There are no dragons on Planet Tianxu. So this means they came from outside.
In a way, they are more trusting of outsiders than even natives in their own world.
The fact that they had suffered so much under the tyranny of their own people made them distrustful of them.

Soon, Kent and Liora were led to a building sitting at the centre of the floating city. After they settled down in a not-so-fancy hall, Yuyin immediately asked the question she had been meaning to ask on their way to the hall.
"Are you really Kent Madson?" Of course, she had to ask. The person she had heard so many rumours about is now sitting in the same hall as her.
To someone like her, who had only hidden behind illusions in fear of what the humans or Beast would do to them. She only heard the rumours but couldn’t act on them.
Now, she is acting on it, and her question was for Kent to confirm his identity.

"Aunty, please. I’ve been away for ten thousand years, and the only thing you wanted to know was if my husband was who he claimed to be?" Liora glared at her aunt, who smiled but remained focused on Kent.

"Relax, Liora, she is merely asking a harmless question." Kent smiled and gave Yuyin the answer she wanted... "My mom named me Kent Madson when I was born, so I think unless there is someone else out there who can do what I could, then you are staring at the one and only Kent Madson."
"I wouldn’t take a counterfeit as my husband’s, Aunty. He is the real deal. Of course, if you don’t believe me, you can find out for yourself."
"And how do I do that?" Yuyin asked.
Liora turned to Kent and blushed, then she turned back to her aunt, "By moving in with me and my sisters."
"Your sisters?" Yuyin was taken aback. However, Liora cleared her doubt by giving her the classic line.
"I can’t tell you much for now. But soon, if things play out the way I want, you will learn everything." Liora was obviously putting measures in place for her lovely aunt without even knowing.
Kent, however, pretended he didn’t know what Liora was doing.
Of course, he wasn’t bothered by it. He had already seen what his wives could do, and from what Vexthra told them, they wanted to add more sisters before they reached the immortal stage.
He welcomes the fun. After all, his harem had already become so powerful to the point that once they become immortals, there is no telling what can come against them.
"Don’t mind, Liora. She seems to be picking up some bad habits from one of her sisters." Selene’s image appeared in Kent’s mind, making him smile.

"However, if you want your people to live a life of peace and happiness forever, then prepare to move in with us. I have a place where they will forever know peace and grow stronger while out of harm’s way."

"Kent is right. I came here today to say hi and catch up with my favourite aunt. However, after witnessing what the humans and Beast are capable of, I wouldn’t be at peace if I couldn’t stay with you and keep a close eye on you.
So, better move in with us."
Yuyin only thought for a moment before agreeing.

She had always wanted to take her people away and find a peaceful planet to settle on. However, because of their weak combat power, embarking on such a journey would without a doubt be extremely dangerous.
So they only remained on Planet Tianxu. Now, a chance to leave had presented itself, and considering their current state, she readily agreed.
She also wants to find out more about Liora’s life, so moving in with her sounds like a good plan.
"Wonderful." Kent smiled, "Tell your people to start preparing. They will be migrating 12 hours from now."
Yuyin nodded and turned toward Liora... "I will be back. Keep Lord Kent company for me."
She sped away to relay the information to her people. Meanwhile, Liora could only smile and turn to Kent.
"Be careful with her. She is my aunt, and I don’t want her screaming for hours."
Kent smiled and nodded... "I will take my time. However, if she wants it wild, then don’t blame this dragon for complying."
Liora blushed.
She then quickly jumped on Kent’s lap and started kissing him. Kent, of course, welcomed the kiss by grabbing her butt and sticking his tongue into her mouth.
Inside the tower, Gaia and her minions started drawing plans to build a Floating City...

I’ve been away for ten thousand years, and the only thing you wanted to know was if my husband was who he claimed to be?" Liora glared at her aunt, who smiled but remained focused on Kent.
"Relax, Liora, she is merely asking a harmless question." Kent smiled and gave Yuyin the answer she wanted...
"My mom named me Kent Madson when I was born, so I think unless there is someone else out there who can do what I could, then you are staring at the one and only Kent Madson."
"I wouldn’t take a counterfeit as my husband’s, Aunty.
He is the real deal.
Of course, if you don’t believe me, you can find out for yourself."
"And how do I do that?" Yuyin asked.
Liora turned to Kent and blushed, then she turned back to her aunt, "By moving in with me and my sisters."
"Your sisters?" Yuyin was taken aback.
However, Liora cleared her doubt by giving her the classic line.
"I can’t tell you much for now.
But soon, if things play out the way I want, you will learn everything." Liora was obviously putting measures in place for her lovely aunt without even knowing.
Kent, however, pretended he didn’t know what Liora was doing.
Of course, he wasn’t bothered by it.
He had already seen what his wives could do, and from what Vexthra told them, they wanted to add more sisters before they reached the immortal stage.
He welcomes the fun.
After all, his harem had already become so powerful to the point that once they become immortals, there is no telling what can come against them.
"Don’t mind, Liora.
She seems to be picking up some bad habits from one of her sisters." Selene’s image appeared in Kent’s mind, making him smile.
"However, if you want your people to live a life of peace and happiness forever, then prepare to move in with us.
I have a place where they will forever know peace and grow stronger while out of harm’s way."
"Kent is right.
I came here today to say hi and catch up with my favourite aunt.
However, after witnessing what the humans and Beast are capable of, I wouldn’t be at peace if I couldn’t stay with you and keep a close eye on you.
So, better move in with us."
Yuyin only thought for a moment before agreeing.
She had always wanted to take her people away and find a peaceful planet to settle on.
However, because of their weak combat power, embarking on such a journey would without a doubt be extremely dangerous.
So they only remained on Planet Tianxu.
Now, a chance to leave had presented itself, and considering their current state, she readily agreed.
She also wants to find out more about Liora’s life, so moving in with her sounds like a good plan.
"Wonderful." Kent smiled, "Tell your people to start preparing.
They will be migrating 12 hours from now."
Yuyin nodded and turned toward Liora...
"I will be back.
Keep Lord Kent company for me."
She sped away to relay the information to her people.
Meanwhile, Liora could only smile and turn to Kent.
"Be careful with her.
She is my aunt, and I don’t want her screaming for hours."
Kent smiled and nodded...
"I will take my time.
However, if she wants it wild, then don’t blame this dragon for complying."
Liora blushed.
She then quickly jumped on Kent’s lap and started kissing him.
Kent, of course, welcomed the kiss by grabbing her butt and sticking his tongue into her mouth.
Inside the tower, Gaia and her minions started drawing plans to build a Floating City...
